theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.rdef_coord_eq : ∀ {N : ℕ} (a b : Fin N),
  DiamondIntegral.Section8.RingDefinable.RDef {z | z a = z b} :=

  Eq.mpr
    (eq_of_heq
      ((fun α X X' e'_2 =>

            X' = a →
              e'_2 ≍ x → DiamondIntegral.Section8.RingDefinable.RDef X ≍ DiamondIntegral.Section8.RingDefinable.RDef X')

                  e_2 ≍ Eq.refl X →
                    DiamondIntegral.Section8.RingDefinable.RDef X ≍ DiamondIntegral.Section8.RingDefinable.RDef X')

            (Eq.refl X') (HEq.refl e'_2))
        (Fin N) {z | z a = z b} {c | (MvPolynomial.eval c) (MvPolynomial.X a - MvPolynomial.X b) = 0}

DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.reindex_graph : ∀
  (X Y : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.DiagonalConstructible.Object) (π : Fin X.arity ≃ Fin Y.arity)
  (hd : ∀ (x : Fin X.arity → ℂ), x ∈ X.domain ↔ x ∘ ⇑π.symm ∈ Y.domain),
  DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.framedEquivGraph X.domain Y.domain
      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.reindexEquiv X Y π hd) =
    {z |
      (fun i => z (Fin.castAdd Y.arity i)) ∈ X.domain ∧
        ∀ (j : Fin Y.arity), z (Fin.natAdd X.arity j) = z (Fin.castAdd Y.arity (π.symm j))}
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.reindex_graph : ∀
  (X Y : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.DiagonalConstructible.Object) (π : Fin X.arity ≃ Fin Y.arity)
  (hd : ∀ (x : Fin X.arity → ℂ), x ∈ X.domain ↔ x ∘ ⇑π.symm ∈ Y.domain),
  DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.framedEquivGraph X.domain Y.domain
      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.reindexEquiv X Y π hd) =
    {z |
      (fun i => z (Fin.castAdd Y.arity i)) ∈ X.domain ∧
        ∀ (j : Fin Y.arity), z (Fin.natAdd X.arity j) = z (Fin.castAdd Y.arity (π.symm j))} :=
fun X Y π hd =>
  Set.ext fun z =>
    id
      {
        mp := fun a =>
          Exists.casesOn a fun x h =>
            And.casesOn h fun hx hy =>
              ⟨Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ X.domain) hx)) x.property, fun j =>
                have h1 := congrFun hy j;
                have h2 := congrFun hx (π.symm j);
                id
                  (fun h1 =>
                    Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = z (Fin.castAdd Y.arity (π.symm j))) h1))
                      (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ↑x (π.symm j) = _a) h2)) (Eq.refl (↑x (π.symm j)))))
                  h1⟩,
        mpr := fun a =>
          And.casesOn a fun hx hy => Exists.intro ⟨fun i => z (Fin.castAdd Y.arity i), hx⟩ ⟨rfl, funext fun j => hy j⟩ }

  (DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.rvAction (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Galois.levelRoots m)) (some u) = some u ↔
    ∃ z, Multiplicative.toAdd u.1 = ↑z / ↑↑m :=

                      (DiamondIntegral.Section5.compatibleRootCharacter (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Galois.levelRoots m))

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.GammaCells.sign_far : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  (e : DiamondIntegral.Section8.GammaCells.Hull SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.Gamma),
  0 < e →
    ∀ (g : DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.AffFun 1) (N : ℚ),
      |g.const / g.coeff 0| < N →
        ∀ {z : DiamondIntegral.Section8.GammaCells.Hull SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.Gamma},
          (N • e < z →
              SignType.sign (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.AffFun.evalV e g fun x => z) =
                if g.coeff 0 = 0 then SignType.sign g.const else SignType.sign (g.coeff 0)) ∧
            (z < -N • e →
              SignType.sign (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.AffFun.evalV e g fun x => z) =
                if g.coeff 0 = 0 then SignType.sign g.const else -SignType.sign (g.coeff 0)) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] e he g N
    hN {z} =>
  have hval :=
    of_eq_true
      (Eq.trans
        (congrFun'
          (congrArg Eq
            (congrFun'
              (congrArg HAdd.hAdd
                (Eq.trans (Finset.sum_congr Finset.univ_unique fun x a => Eq.refl (g.coeff x • z))

              (g.const • e)))
          (g.coeff 0 • z + g.const • e))
        (eq_self (g.coeff 0 • z + g.const • e)));
  if hc : g.coeff 0 = 0 then
    of_eq_true
      (Eq.trans
        (congr
          (congrArg And

                        ((fun q => DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.sign_smul_pos he q) g.const)))

                      (ite_congr (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg Eq hc) 0) (eq_self 0))
                        (fun a => Eq.refl (SignType.sign g.const)) fun a => congrArg (⇑SignType.sign) hc)
                      (ite_true (SignType.sign g.const) (SignType.sign 0))))
                  (eq_self (SignType.sign g.const))))
              (implies_true (N • e < z))))
          (Eq.trans
            (implies_congr (Eq.refl (z < -N • e))
              (Eq.trans
                (congr
                  (congrArg Eq
                    (Eq.trans
                      (congrArg (⇑SignType.sign)
                        (Eq.trans hval
                          (Eq.trans
                            (congrFun'
                              (congrArg HAdd.hAdd (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg HSMul.hSMul hc) z) (zero_smul ℚ z)))
                              (g.const • e))
                            (zero_add (g.const • e)))))
                      ((fun q => DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.sign_smul_pos he q) g.const)))
                  (Eq.trans
                    (ite_congr (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg Eq hc) 0) (eq_self 0))
                      (fun a => Eq.refl (SignType.sign g.const)) fun a =>
                      congrArg Neg.neg (congrArg (⇑SignType.sign) hc))
                    (ite_true (SignType.sign g.const) (-SignType.sign 0))))
                (eq_self (SignType.sign g.const))))
            (implies_true (z < -N • e))))
        (and_self True))
  else
    Eq.mpr
      (id

          (congrArg And

  [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (b u : ι → ℚ) (i₀ : ι) (ε : ℚ),

    (1 - ε) * DiamondIntegral.Section8.HeightChains.ev b u + ε * u i₀ :=

        (congrArg Eq
          (Eq.trans
            (Eq.trans
              (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl Finset.univ) fun x a =>
                Eq.trans

                      (u x))

                  (congr (congrArg HAdd.hAdd (mul_assoc (1 - ε) (b x) (u x)))

DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.apValue_eq_level : ∀ (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient) {k : ℕ}

      DiamondIntegral.Section8.GammaCells.qpow (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxValues.uniformizerValue P)
        (↑(DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.level P m g) / ↑↑m)
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.apValue_eq_level : ∀ (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient)
  {k : ℕ}
  (D :
    DiamondIntegral.Section4.RelativeAnnularGenerators.AnnularDatum (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxValues.base P) k)
  (m : ℕ+) {g : SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.Gamma},
  g ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.apValues P D m →
    g =
      DiamondIntegral.Section8.GammaCells.qpow (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxValues.uniformizerValue P)
        (↑(DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.level P m g) / ↑↑m) :=
fun P {k} D m {g} hg =>
  Exists.casesOn
    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.GammaCells.eq_qpow_of_inLattice (PNat.ne_zero m)
      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.apValue_lattice P D m hg))
    fun z hz =>
    have hz0 :=
      have h1 := DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.one_le_apValue P D m hg;
      have hm :=
        cast (Eq.symm (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg LT.lt (Eq.symm Nat.cast_zero)) ↑↑m) Nat.cast_lt._simp_1))
          (PNat.pos m);
      have this :=
        div_nonneg_iff.mp
          (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a) (propext (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.qpow_le_iff P)))
            (Eq.mp
              (congrArg
                (fun _a =>
                  _a ≤
                    DiamondIntegral.Section8.GammaCells.qpow (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxValues.uniformizerValue P)
                      (↑z / ↑↑m))
                (Eq.symm (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.qpow_zero' P)))
              (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => 1 ≤ _a) hz) h1)));
      Or.casesOn this
        (fun h =>
          And.casesOn h fun h right =>
            cast
              (Eq.trans
                (Eq.trans
                  (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg LE.le (Eq.symm Nat.cast_zero)) ↑z)
                    (Eq.trans
                      (congrArg (fun x => x ≤ ↑z)
                        (Eq.trans Nat.cast_zero (Eq.symm (Eq.trans (congrArg Int.cast Nat.cast_zero) Int.cast_zero))))
                      Int.cast_le._simp_1))
                  (congrFun' (congrArg LE.le Nat.cast_zero) z))
                (Eq.symm
                  (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg LE.le (Eq.symm Nat.cast_zero)) z)
                    (congrFun' (congrArg LE.le Nat.cast_zero) z))))
              h)
        fun h => And.casesOn h fun left h => absurd h (not_le.mpr hm);
    have hm := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (PNat.ne_zero m);
    have hr :=
      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              DiamondIntegral.Section8.ratValue (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxValues.uniformizerValue P) _a =
                ↑z / ↑↑m)
            hz))
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg (fun _a => _a = ↑z / ↑↑m)
              (DiamondIntegral.Section8.GammaCells.ratValue_qpow
                (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxValues.one_lt_uniformizerValue P) (↑z / ↑↑m))))
          (Eq.refl (↑z / ↑↑m)));
    have hl :=
      Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ↑_a = ↑z) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.level.eq_1 P m g)))
        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ↑⌊↑↑m * _a⌋₊ = ↑z) hr))
          (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ↑⌊_a⌋₊ = ↑z) (mul_div_cancel₀ (↑z) hm)))
            (have this :=
              cast (Eq.symm (Eq.trans (congrArg (Eq ↑z) (Eq.symm (Int.cast_natCast z.toNat))) Int.cast_inj._simp_1))
                (Eq.symm (Int.toNat_of_nonneg hz0));
            Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ↑⌊_a⌋₊ = _a) this))
              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ↑_a = ↑z.toNat) (Nat.floor_natCast z.toNat))) (Eq.refl ↑z.toNat)))));
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg
          (fun _a =>
            g =
              DiamondIntegral.Section8.GammaCells.qpow (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxValues.uniformizerValue P)
                (_a / ↑↑m))
          hl))
      hz

DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.mem_weights : ∀ (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient) {k : ℕ}
  (a : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredCharts.Chart (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxValues.base P) k)
  (ha : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredBounds.DomainBounded a) (m : ℕ+)
  (w : SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.Gamma),
  w ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.weights P a ha m ↔ (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.latticeFibre P a (↑m) w).Nonempty
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.mem_weights : ∀ (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient)
  {k : ℕ} (a : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredCharts.Chart (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxValues.base P) k)
  (ha : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredBounds.DomainBounded a) (m : ℕ+)
  (w : SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.Gamma),
  w ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.weights P a ha m ↔ (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.latticeFibre P a (↑m) w).Nonempty :=
fun P {k} a ha m w =>
  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (congrFun'
        (congrArg Iff
          (Eq.trans
            (congrFun'
              (congrArg Membership.mem
                (Set.Finite.toFinset.congr_simp (Set.image_congr fun a_1 a_2 => Eq.refl (a.correctedWeight a_1))
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.weights._proof_1 P a ha m)))
              w)
            (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.mem_weights._simp_1_2
              ((Set.image_congr fun a_1 a_2 => Eq.refl (a.correctedWeight a_1)) ▸
                DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.weights._proof_1 P a ha m))))
        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.latticeFibre P a (↑m) w).Nonempty))
    {
      mp := fun x =>
        match x with
        | Exists.intro u ⟨hu, huw⟩ => Exists.intro u ⟨hu, huw⟩,
      mpr := fun x =>
        match x with
        | Exists.intro u ⟨hu, huw⟩ => Exists.intro u ⟨hu, huw⟩ }

DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.hmTerm_eq_zero : ∀ (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient) {k : ℕ}
  (a : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredCharts.Chart (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxValues.base P) k)
  (ha : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredBounds.DomainBounded a) (m : ℕ+),
  ∀ w ∉ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.weights P a ha m, DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.hmTerm P a ha m w = 0
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.hmTerm_eq_zero : ∀ (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient)
  {k : ℕ} (a : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredCharts.Chart (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxValues.base P) k)
  (ha : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredBounds.DomainBounded a) (m : ℕ+),
  ∀ w ∉ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.weights P a ha m, DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.hmTerm P a ha m w = 0 :=
fun P {k} a ha m w hw =>
  have he :=
    Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = ∅) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.fibreChart_domain P a ha m w)))
      (Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp fun h => hw ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.mem_weights P a ha m w).mpr h));
  of_eq_true
    (Eq.trans
      (congrFun'
        (congrArg Eq
          (Eq.trans
            (congr
              (congrArg AddMonoidAlgebra.single
                (neg_mul (↑↑m)
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section8.ratValue (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxValues.uniformizerValue P) w)))
              (Eq.trans
                (congrArg (⇑(DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.theta P))
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section5.nativeRESChartClass_empty
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.fibreChart P a ha m w) he))
                (map_zero (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.theta P))))
            (AddMonoidAlgebra.single_zero
              (-(↑↑m *
                  DiamondIntegral.Section8.ratValue (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxValues.uniformizerValue P) w)))))
        0)
      (eq_self 0))

  {k : ℕ} (a : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredCharts.Chart (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxValues.base P) k)

DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.hmValue_empty : ∀ (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient) {k : ℕ}

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.hmValue_empty : ∀ (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient)
  {k : ℕ} (a : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredCharts.Chart (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxValues.base P) k)
  (ha : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredBounds.DomainBounded a) (m : ℕ+),
  a.domain = ∅ → DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.hmValue P a ha m = 0 :=
fun P {k} a ha m h =>
  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (congrArg (fun _a => _a = 0)
        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.hmValue_eq_sum P a ha m ∅ fun w hw =>
          Exists.casesOn ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.mem_weights P a ha m w).mp hw) fun u h_1 =>
            And.casesOn h_1 fun hu right =>
              have this := hu.left;
              absurd (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => u ∈ _a) h) this) (Set.notMem_empty u))))
    (of_eq_true (eq_self 0))

DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.latticeFibre_union : ∀ (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient)
  {n k : ℕ}
  (a b : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVChartDisjointUnion.Data (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxValues.base P) n k)
  (hd : Disjoint a.domain b.domain) (m : ℕ) (w : SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.Gamma),
  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.latticeFibre P
      (DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVChartDisjointUnion.disjointUnion a b hd).toChart m w =
    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.latticeFibre P a.toChart m w ∪ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.latticeFibre P b.toChart m w
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.latticeFibre_union : ∀ (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient)
  {n k : ℕ}
  (a b : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVChartDisjointUnion.Data (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxValues.base P) n k)
  (hd : Disjoint a.domain b.domain) (m : ℕ) (w : SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.Gamma),
  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.latticeFibre P
      (DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVChartDisjointUnion.disjointUnion a b hd).toChart m w =
    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.latticeFibre P a.toChart m w ∪
      DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.latticeFibre P b.toChart m w :=
fun P {n k} a b hd m w =>
  Set.ext fun u =>
    {
      mp := fun a_1 =>
        And.casesOn a_1 fun left hw =>
          And.casesOn left fun hu hl =>
            Or.casesOn hu
              (fun hu =>
                Or.inl
                  ⟨⟨hu, hl⟩,
                    Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congrArg (fun _a => _a = w)
                          (Eq.symm
                            (DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVChartDisjointUnion.disjointUnion_weight_left a b hd u hu))))
                      hw⟩)
              fun hu =>
              Or.inr
                ⟨⟨hu, hl⟩,
                  Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg (fun _a => _a = w)
                        (Eq.symm
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVChartDisjointUnion.disjointUnion_weight_right a b hd u hu))))
                    hw⟩,
      mpr := fun a_1 =>
        Or.casesOn a_1
          (fun h =>
            And.casesOn h fun left hw =>
              And.casesOn left fun hu hl =>
                ⟨⟨Or.inl hu, hl⟩,
                  Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg (fun _a => _a = w)
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVChartDisjointUnion.disjointUnion_weight_left a b hd u hu)))
                    hw⟩)
          fun h =>
          And.casesOn h fun left hw =>
            And.casesOn left fun hu hl =>
              ⟨⟨Or.inr hu, hl⟩,
                Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg (fun _a => _a = w)
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVChartDisjointUnion.disjointUnion_weight_right a b hd u hu)))
                  hw⟩ }

DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.hmValue_union : ∀ (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient) {n k : ℕ}
  (a b : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVChartDisjointUnion.Data (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxValues.base P) n k)
  (hd : Disjoint a.domain b.domain)
  (hu :
    DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredBounds.DomainBounded
      (DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVChartDisjointUnion.disjointUnion a b hd).toChart)

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.hmValue_union : ∀ (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient)
  {n k : ℕ}
  (a b : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVChartDisjointUnion.Data (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxValues.base P) n k)
  (hd : Disjoint a.domain b.domain)
  (hu :
    DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredBounds.DomainBounded
      (DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVChartDisjointUnion.disjointUnion a b hd).toChart)
  (ha : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredBounds.DomainBounded a.toChart)
  (hb : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredBounds.DomainBounded b.toChart) (m : ℕ+),
  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.hmValue P (DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVChartDisjointUnion.disjointUnion a b hd).toChart hu
      m =
    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.hmValue P a.toChart ha m + DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.hmValue P b.toChart hb m :=
fun P {n k} a b hd hu ha hb m =>
  have hterm := fun w =>
    have hdom :=
      Eq.trans
        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.fibreChart_domain P
          (DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVChartDisjointUnion.disjointUnion a b hd).toChart hu m w)
        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.latticeFibre_union P a b hd (↑m) w);
    have hcls :=
      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              _a =
                DiamondIntegral.Section5.nativeRESChartClass
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.fibreChart P a.toChart ha m w) +
                  DiamondIntegral.Section5.nativeRESChartClass
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.fibreChart P b.toChart hb m w))
            (Eq.symm
              (DiamondIntegral.Section8.RESPieces.classOn_domain
                (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.fibreChart P
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVChartDisjointUnion.disjointUnion a b hd).toChart hu m w)))))
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                DiamondIntegral.Section8.RESPieces.classOn
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.fibreChart P
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVChartDisjointUnion.disjointUnion a b hd).toChart hu m w)
                    _a =
                  DiamondIntegral.Section5.nativeRESChartClass
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.fibreChart P a.toChart ha m w) +
                    DiamondIntegral.Section5.nativeRESChartClass
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.fibreChart P b.toChart hb m w))
              hdom))
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg
                (fun _a =>
                  _a =
                    DiamondIntegral.Section5.nativeRESChartClass
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.fibreChart P a.toChart ha m w) +
                      DiamondIntegral.Section5.nativeRESChartClass
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.fibreChart P b.toChart hb m w))
                (DiamondIntegral.Section8.RESPieces.classOn_union
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.fibreChart P
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVChartDisjointUnion.disjointUnion a b hd).toChart hu m w)
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.latticeFibre P a.toChart (↑m) w)
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.latticeFibre P b.toChart (↑m) w)
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.latticeFibre_definable' P a.toChart ha m w)
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.latticeFibre_definable' P b.toChart hb m w)
                  (fun u h => Eq.symm hdom ▸ Or.inl h) (fun u h => Eq.symm hdom ▸ Or.inr h)
                  (Set.disjoint_of_subset (fun x h => h.left.left) (fun x h => h.left.left) hd))))
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg
                  (fun _a =>
                    _a +
                        DiamondIntegral.Section8.RESPieces.classOn
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.fibreChart P
                            (DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVChartDisjointUnion.disjointUnion a b hd).toChart hu m w)
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.latticeFibre P b.toChart (↑m) w) =
                      DiamondIntegral.Section5.nativeRESChartClass
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.fibreChart P a.toChart ha m w) +
                        DiamondIntegral.Section5.nativeRESChartClass
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.fibreChart P b.toChart hb m w))

                    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.fibreChart P

                      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.fibreChart P

                  AddMonoidAlgebra.single

DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.product_weight : ∀ (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient) {k l : ℕ}
  (a : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredCharts.Chart (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxValues.base P) k)
  (b : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredCharts.Chart (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxValues.base P) l)
  (u : Fin (b.arity + a.arity) → P.N),
  (DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredProduct.product a b).correctedWeight u =
    a.correctedWeight (u ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.headIndex b.arity a.arity) *
      b.correctedWeight (u ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.tailIndex b.arity a.arity)
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.product_weight : ∀ (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient)
  {k l : ℕ} (a : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredCharts.Chart (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxValues.base P) k)
  (b : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredCharts.Chart (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxValues.base P) l)
  (u : Fin (b.arity + a.arity) → P.N),
  (DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredProduct.product a b).correctedWeight u =
    a.correctedWeight (u ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.headIndex b.arity a.arity) *
      b.correctedWeight (u ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.tailIndex b.arity a.arity) :=
fun P {k l} a b u =>
  Eq.mpr
    (id
      ((fun a a_1 e_a =>
          Eq.rec (motive := fun a_2 e_a =>
            ∀ (a_3 : SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.Gamma), (a = a_3) = (a_2 = a_3))
            (fun a_2 => Eq.refl (a = a_2)) e_a)
        ((DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredProduct.product a b).correctedWeight u)
        ((DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredProduct.product a b).correctedWeight
          (DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.join b.arity a.arity
            (u ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.headIndex b.arity a.arity)
            (u ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.tailIndex b.arity a.arity)))
        (Eq.trans
          (congrArg (fun _a => (DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredProduct.product a b).correctedWeight _a)
            (Eq.symm (DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.join_reconstruct b.arity a.arity u)))
          (Eq.refl
            ((DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredProduct.product a b).correctedWeight
              (DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.join b.arity a.arity
                (u ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.headIndex b.arity a.arity)
                (u ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.tailIndex b.arity a.arity)))))
        (a.correctedWeight (u ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.headIndex b.arity a.arity) *
          b.correctedWeight (u ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.tailIndex b.arity a.arity))))

        DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.latticeDomain P b m :=
fun P {k l} a b m u =>
  {

        And.casesOn left fun h1 h2 =>

  {k : ℕ} (a : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredCharts.Chart (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxValues.base P) k)

    DiamondIntegral.Section8.IsRationalValue (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxValues.uniformizerValue P) w :=
fun P {k} a ha m {w} hw =>

    Exists.casesOn ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.mem_weights P a ha m w).mp hw) fun u hu =>
      Exists.intro u ⟨hu.left, hu.right⟩;

    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.latticeWeight_rational P (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.bdd P a ha) (PNat.ne_zero m) hw')

    Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {w} =>

        w ∈ a.correctedWeight '' DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.latticeDomain P a ↑m →

      (fun hw hw' =>
        DiamondIntegral.Section8.GammaCells.isRationalValue_qpow
          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxValues.uniformizerValue P) q)
      (Eq.symm h) hw hw'

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.exists_concrete_point : ∀
  (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient) {n : ℕ} {A : Set (Fin n → P.N)},
  SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.DefinableOverBase (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxValues.base P)
      (fun x => SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag.rv) A →
    A.Nonempty → ∃ x, ⇑P.e ∘ x ∈ A :=
fun P {n} {A} hA hne =>
  Decidable.byContradiction fun hno =>
    let E :=
      DiamondIntegral.Section5.elementaryActualDefinableEquiv P.e
        DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.laurentCoefficientEnumeration;
    let S := ⟨A, DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.raw_definable_of_base P hA⟩;
    have h1 :=
      Subtype.ext
        (id
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun _a => {x | ⇑P.e ∘ x ∈ A} = {x | ⇑P.e ∘ x ∈ _a}) FirstOrder.Language.DefinableSet.coe_bot))
            (Set.ext fun x =>
              { mp := fun h => Eq.mp (Mathlib.Tactic.Push.not_exists._simp_1 fun x => ⇑P.e ∘ x ∈ A) hno x h,
                mpr := fun h => False.elim h })));
    have h2 := Equiv.injective E h1;
    Exists.casesOn hne fun x hx =>
      have this := Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => x ∈ ↑_a) (Eq.symm h2))) hx;
      Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => x ∈ _a) FirstOrder.Language.DefinableSet.coe_bot) this

DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.concrete_rv : ∀ (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient)
  {x : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.Carrier},
  SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iRV (P.e x) → x = Sum.inr (DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.rvPart x)
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.concrete_rv : ∀ (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient)
  {x : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.Carrier},
  SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iRV (P.e x) → x = Sum.inr (DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.rvPart x) :=
fun P {x} hx =>
  have h := FirstOrder.Language.ElementaryEmbedding.map_rel P.e SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Rel.memRV ![x];
  have ht :=
    funext fun i =>
      List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a x_1 =>
        List.finRange (Nat.succ 0) = a → Fintype.complete i ≍ x_1 → (⇑P.e ∘ ![x]) i = ![P.e x] i) (Fintype.complete i)
        (fun as h =>
          List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
            Eq.ndrec (motive := fun i =>
              ∀ (this : i ∈ Fintype.elems), [] ≍ as → this ≍ List.Mem.head as → (⇑P.e ∘ ![x]) i = ![P.e x] i)
              (fun this tail_eq =>
                Eq.ndrec (motive := fun as =>
                  this ≍ List.Mem.head as →
                    (⇑P.e ∘ ![x]) ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl (Nat.succ 0)⟩) =
                      ![P.e x] ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl (Nat.succ 0)⟩))
                  (fun h => Eq.refl ((⇑P.e ∘ ![x]) ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl (Nat.succ 0)⟩))) (eq_of_heq tail_eq))
              (eq_of_heq head_eq) (Fintype.complete i))
        (fun b {as} a h =>
          List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
            Eq.ndrec (motive := fun b =>
              [] ≍ as → Fintype.complete i ≍ List.Mem.tail b a → (⇑P.e ∘ ![x]) i = ![P.e x] i)
              (fun tail_eq =>
                Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {as} =>
                  ∀ (a : List.Mem i as),
                    Fintype.complete i ≍ List.Mem.tail ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl (Nat.succ 0)⟩) a →
                      (⇑P.e ∘ ![x]) i = ![P.e x] i)
                  (fun a h =>
                    List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a_1 x_1 => [] = a_1 → a ≍ x_1 → (⇑P.e ∘ ![x]) i = ![P.e x] i) a
                      (fun as h => False.elim (noConfusion_of_Nat List.ctorIdx h))
                      (fun b {as} a_1 h => False.elim (noConfusion_of_Nat List.ctorIdx h)) (Eq.refl []) (HEq.refl a))
                  (eq_of_heq tail_eq) a)
              (eq_of_heq head_eq))
        (Eq.refl (List.finRange (Nat.succ 0))) (HEq.refl (Fintype.complete i));
  have hx' :=
    (Eq.mp
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              FirstOrder.Language.Structure.RelMap SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Rel.memRV _a ↔
                FirstOrder.Language.Structure.RelMap SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Rel.memRV ![x])
            ht)
          h).mp
      hx;
  Eq.symm (DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.rvSort_tag ⟨x, hx'⟩)

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.isoGraph_functional : ∀
  (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient) {k : ℕ}

          w' ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.headIndex b.arity a.arity →
        w = w' :=

  Exists.casesOn hw fun u h_1 =>
    Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {w} =>
      w ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.headIndex b.arity a.arity =
          w' ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.headIndex b.arity a.arity →
        w = w')
      (fun h =>
        Exists.casesOn hw' fun u' h_2 =>
          Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {w'} =>
            DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.join b.arity a.arity ↑u ↑(F.equiv u) ∘
                  DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.headIndex b.arity a.arity =
                w' ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.headIndex b.arity a.arity →
              DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.join b.arity a.arity ↑u ↑(F.equiv u) = w')
            (fun h =>
              have hu :=
                Subtype.ext
                  (funext fun i =>
                    have this := congrFun h i;
                    Eq.mp
                      (congr
                        (congrArg Eq
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.join_head b.arity a.arity (↑u) (↑(F.equiv u)) i))
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.join_head b.arity a.arity (↑u') (↑(F.equiv u')) i))
                      this);
              Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg
                    (fun _a =>
                      DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.join b.arity a.arity ↑_a ↑(F.equiv _a) =
                        DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.join b.arity a.arity ↑u' ↑(F.equiv u'))
                    hu))
                (Eq.refl (DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.join b.arity a.arity ↑u' ↑(F.equiv u'))))

DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.iso_lattice : ∀ (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient) {k : ℕ}
  {a b : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredCharts.Chart (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxValues.base P) k},
  DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredBounds.DomainBounded a →
    DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredBounds.DomainBounded b →
      ∀ (F : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredCharts.Iso a b) (m : ℕ+) (u : ↑a.domain),
        ↑u ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.latticeDomain P a ↑m →
          ↑(F.equiv u) ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.latticeDomain P b ↑m
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.iso_lattice : ∀ (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient)
  {k : ℕ} {a b : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredCharts.Chart (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxValues.base P) k},
  DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredBounds.DomainBounded a →
    DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredBounds.DomainBounded b →
      ∀ (F : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredCharts.Iso a b) (m : ℕ+) (u : ↑a.domain),
        ↑u ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.latticeDomain P a ↑m →
          ↑(F.equiv u) ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.latticeDomain P b ↑m :=
fun P {k} {a b} ha hb F m u hu =>
  Decidable.byContradiction fun hF =>
    let n := a.arity;
    let n' := b.arity;
    let Bad :=
      DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.isoGraph P F ∩
          {w |
            w ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.headIndex n' n ∈
                DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.latticeDomain P a ↑m ∧
              w ∈
                SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.sortedUniverse fun x =>
                  SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag.rv} ∩
        {w |
          w ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.tailIndex n' n ∈
              (SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.sortedUniverse fun x =>
                  SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag.rv) \
                DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.latticeDomain P b ↑m ∧
            w ∈
              SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.sortedUniverse fun x =>
                SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag.rv};
    have hBad :=
      SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.DefinableOverBase.inter
        (SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.DefinableOverBase.inter F.graph_definable
          (SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.DefinableOverBase.preimage_real
            (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.latticeDomain_definable P (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.bdd P a ha)
              (PNat.ne_zero m))

DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS_const : ∀ (c : ℂ),
  0 ≤ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS (DiamondIntegral.Section5.puiseuxConstant c)
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS_const : ∀ (c : ℂ),
  0 ≤ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS (DiamondIntegral.Section5.puiseuxConstant c) :=
fun c =>
  id
    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => 0 ≤ _a.orderTop) (DiamondIntegral.Section5.puiseuxConstant_coe c)))
      (if hc : c = 0 then
        Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => 0 ≤ (HahnSeries.C _a).orderTop) hc))
          (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => 0 ≤ _a.orderTop) (map_zero HahnSeries.C)))
            (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => 0 ≤ _a) HahnSeries.orderTop_zero)) le_top))
      else
        Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => 0 ≤ _a.orderTop) (HahnSeries.C_apply c)))
          (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => 0 ≤ _a) (HahnSeries.orderTop_single hc))) (le_refl 0))))

DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lt_ordS_iff : ∀ (x : DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Ser) (γ : ℚ),
  ↑γ < DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS x ↔ ∀ γ' ≤ γ, DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf x γ' = 0
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lt_ordS_iff : ∀ (x : DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Ser) (γ : ℚ),
  ↑γ < DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS x ↔ ∀ γ' ≤ γ, DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf x γ' = 0 :=
fun x γ =>
  { mp := fun h γ' hγ' => HahnSeries.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_orderTop (lt_of_le_of_lt (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr hγ') h),
    mpr := fun h =>
      Decidable.byContradiction fun hle =>
        have hx := fun h0 =>
          absurd
            (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a ≤ ↑γ) DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS_zero)
              (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS _a ≤ ↑γ) h0)
                (Eq.mp not_lt._simp_1 hle)))
            (of_eq_true
              (Eq.trans (congrArg Not (Eq.trans top_le_iff._simp_2 WithTop.coe_ne_top._simp_1)) not_false_eq_true));
        have hx' := fun h0 => hx (Subtype.ext h0);
        have ho := Eq.symm (HahnSeries.order_eq_orderTop_of_ne_zero hx');
        DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.coeff_order_ne hx'
          (h (↑x).order
            (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a) (propext WithTop.coe_le_coe))
              (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a ≤ ↑γ) ho) (Eq.mp not_lt._simp_1 hle)))) }

@DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.poly_lipschitz_conc : ∀ {d : ℕ} (g : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ)
  {x y : Fin d → DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Ser},
  (∀ (i : Fin d), 0 ≤ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS (x i)) →
    (∀ (i : Fin d), 0 ≤ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS (y i)) →

        (∀ (i : Fin d), ↑γ < DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS (x i - y i)) →

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.poly_lipschitz_conc : ∀ {d : ℕ} (g : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ)
  {x y : Fin d → DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Ser},
  (∀ (i : Fin d), 0 ≤ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS (x i)) →
    (∀ (i : Fin d), 0 ≤ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS (y i)) →
      ∀ {γ : ℚ},
        (∀ (i : Fin d), ↑γ < DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS (x i - y i)) →
          ↑γ <
            DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS
              ((MvPolynomial.eval x) ((MvPolynomial.map DiamondIntegral.Section5.puiseuxConstant) g) -
                (MvPolynomial.eval y) ((MvPolynomial.map DiamondIntegral.Section5.puiseuxConstant) g)) :=
fun {d} g {x y} hx hy {γ} hxy =>
  have hint := fun p z hz =>
    MvPolynomial.induction_on p
      (fun a =>
        Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg (fun _a => 0 ≤ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS ((MvPolynomial.eval z) _a))
              (MvPolynomial.map_C DiamondIntegral.Section5.puiseuxConstant a)))
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun _a => 0 ≤ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS _a)
                (MvPolynomial.eval_C (DiamondIntegral.Section5.puiseuxConstant a))))
            (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS_const a)))
      (fun p q hp hq =>
        Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg (fun _a => 0 ≤ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS ((MvPolynomial.eval z) _a))
              (RingHom.map_add (MvPolynomial.map DiamondIntegral.Section5.puiseuxConstant) p q)))
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun _a => 0 ≤ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS _a)
                (RingHom.map_add (MvPolynomial.eval z) ((MvPolynomial.map DiamondIntegral.Section5.puiseuxConstant) p)
                  ((MvPolynomial.map DiamondIntegral.Section5.puiseuxConstant) q))))
            (le_trans (le_min hp hq)
              (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS_add
                ((MvPolynomial.eval z) ((MvPolynomial.map DiamondIntegral.Section5.puiseuxConstant) p))
                ((MvPolynomial.eval z) ((MvPolynomial.map DiamondIntegral.Section5.puiseuxConstant) q))))))
      fun p i hp =>
      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a => 0 ≤ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS ((MvPolynomial.eval z) _a))
            (RingHom.map_mul (MvPolynomial.map DiamondIntegral.Section5.puiseuxConstant) p (MvPolynomial.X i))))
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                0 ≤
                  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS
                    ((MvPolynomial.eval z) ((MvPolynomial.map DiamondIntegral.Section5.puiseuxConstant) p * _a)))
              (MvPolynomial.map_X DiamondIntegral.Section5.puiseuxConstant i)))
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun _a => 0 ≤ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS _a)
                (RingHom.map_mul (MvPolynomial.eval z) ((MvPolynomial.map DiamondIntegral.Section5.puiseuxConstant) p)
                  (MvPolynomial.X i))))
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg
                  (fun _a =>
                    0 ≤
                      DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS
                        ((MvPolynomial.eval z) ((MvPolynomial.map DiamondIntegral.Section5.puiseuxConstant) p) * _a))
                  (MvPolynomial.eval_X i)))

                (Eq.mpr

  DiamondIntegral.Section8.LatticeCone.weight A L (∑ j ∈ s, f j) =
    ∏ j ∈ s, DiamondIntegral.Section8.LatticeCone.weight A L (f j)
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.LatticeCone.weight_sum.{u_1, u_2, u_3} : ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (A : Rˣ)
  {E : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup E] {ι : Type u_3} [DecidableEq ι] (L : E →+ ℤ) (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → E),
  DiamondIntegral.Section8.LatticeCone.weight A L (∑ j ∈ s, f j) =
    ∏ j ∈ s, DiamondIntegral.Section8.LatticeCone.weight A L (f j) :=
fun {R} [CommRing R] A {E} [AddCommGroup E] {ι} [DecidableEq ι] L s f =>
  Finset.induction_on s
    (of_eq_true
      (Eq.trans
        (congrFun'
          (congrArg Eq
            (congrArg Units.val
              (Eq.trans (Eq.trans (congrArg (HPow.hPow A) (map_zero L)) (zpow_ofNat A 0)) (pow_zero A))))
          1)
        (eq_self 1)))
    fun i s hi ih =>
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg
          (fun _a =>
            DiamondIntegral.Section8.LatticeCone.weight A L _a =
              ∏ j ∈ insert i s, DiamondIntegral.Section8.LatticeCone.weight A L (f j))
          (Finset.sum_insert hi)))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section8.LatticeCone.weight A L (f i + ∑ x ∈ s, f x) = _a)
            (Finset.prod_insert hi)))
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                _a =
                  DiamondIntegral.Section8.LatticeCone.weight A L (f i) *
                    ∏ x ∈ s, DiamondIntegral.Section8.LatticeCone.weight A L (f x))
              (DiamondIntegral.Section8.LatticeCone.weight_add A L (f i) (∑ x ∈ s, f x))))
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg
                (fun _a =>
                  DiamondIntegral.Section8.LatticeCone.weight A L (f i) * _a =
                    DiamondIntegral.Section8.LatticeCone.weight A L (f i) *
                      ∏ x ∈ s, DiamondIntegral.Section8.LatticeCone.weight A L (f x))
                ih))
            (Eq.refl
              (DiamondIntegral.Section8.LatticeCone.weight A L (f i) *
                ∏ j ∈ s, DiamondIntegral.Section8.LatticeCone.weight A L (f j))))))

@DiamondIntegral.Section8.LatticeCone.deg_param : ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommGroup E] {ι : Type u_2}
  [inst_1 : Fintype ι] (v : ι → E) (deg : E →+ ℤ) (p : E) (n : ι → ℕ),
  deg (p + ∑ j, n j • v j) = deg p + ∑ j, ↑(n j) * deg (v j)
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.LatticeCone.deg_param.{u_2, u_3} : ∀ {E : Type u_2} [inst : AddCommGroup E]
  {ι : Type u_3} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] (v : ι → E) (deg : E →+ ℤ) (p : E) (n : ι → ℕ),
  deg (p + ∑ j, n j • v j) = deg p + ∑ j, ↑(n j) * deg (v j) :=
fun {E} [AddCommGroup E] {ι} [Fintype ι] v deg p n =>
  of_eq_true
    (Eq.trans
      (congrFun'
        (congrArg Eq
          (Eq.trans (map_add deg p (∑ j, n j • v j))
            (congrArg (HAdd.hAdd (deg p))
              (Eq.trans (map_sum deg (fun x => n x • v x) Finset.univ)
                (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl Finset.univ) fun x a => map_nsmul deg (n x) (v x))))))
        (deg p + ∑ x, ↑(n x) * deg (v x)))
      (eq_self (deg p + ∑ x, ↑(n x) * deg (v x))))

@DiamondIntegral.Section8.LatticeCone.sum_add_single : ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommGroup E] {ι : Type u_2}
  [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : DecidableEq ι] (v : ι → E) (n : ι → ℕ) (j : ι),
  ∑ i, (n + Pi.single j 1) i • v i = ∑ i, n i • v i + v j
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.LatticeCone.sum_add_single.{u_2, u_3} : ∀ {E : Type u_2} [inst : AddCommGroup E]
  {ι : Type u_3} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : DecidableEq ι] (v : ι → E) (n : ι → ℕ) (j : ι),
  ∑ i, (n + Pi.single j 1) i • v i = ∑ i, n i • v i + v j :=
fun {E} [AddCommGroup E] {ι} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] v n j =>
  of_eq_true
    (Eq.trans
      (congrFun'
        (congrArg Eq
          (Eq.trans
            (Eq.trans
              (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl Finset.univ) fun x a =>
                Eq.trans
                  (Eq.trans
                    (congrFun' (congrArg HSMul.hSMul (congrArg (HAdd.hAdd (n x)) (Pi.single_apply j 1 x))) (v x))
                    (add_smul (n x) (if x = j then 1 else 0) (v x)))
                  (congrArg (HAdd.hAdd (n x • v x))
                    (Eq.trans (ite_smul (x = j) (v x) 1 0)
                      (ite_congr (Eq.refl (x = j)) (fun a => one_smul ℕ (v x)) fun a => zero_nsmul (v x)))))
              Finset.sum_add_distrib)
            (congrArg (HAdd.hAdd (∑ x, n x • v x))
              (Eq.trans (Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ j v)
                (ite_eq_left_of_eq_true (v j) 0 (Finset.mem_univ._simp_1 j))))))
        (∑ i, n i • v i + v j))
      (eq_self (∑ x, n x • v x + v j)))

@DiamondIntegral.Section8.LatticeCone.level_insert : ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommGroup E] {ι : Type u_2}
  [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : DecidableEq ι] (P : Finset E) (v : ι → E) (deg : E →+ ℤ) {S : Finset ι} {j : ι}
  (z : ℤ),
  DiamondIntegral.Section8.LatticeCone.level P v deg (insert j S) z =
    DiamondIntegral.Section8.LatticeCone.level P v deg S z ∪
      (fun x => x + v j) '' DiamondIntegral.Section8.LatticeCone.level P v deg (insert j S) (z - deg (v j))
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.LatticeCone.level_insert.{u_2, u_3} : ∀ {E : Type u_2} [inst : AddCommGroup E]
  {ι : Type u_3} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : DecidableEq ι] (P : Finset E) (v : ι → E) (deg : E →+ ℤ) {S : Finset ι}
  {j : ι} (z : ℤ),
  DiamondIntegral.Section8.LatticeCone.level P v deg (insert j S) z =
    DiamondIntegral.Section8.LatticeCone.level P v deg S z ∪
      (fun x => x + v j) '' DiamondIntegral.Section8.LatticeCone.level P v deg (insert j S) (z - deg (v j)) :=
fun {E} [AddCommGroup E] {ι} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] P v deg {S} {j} z =>
  Set.ext fun x =>
    {
      mp := fun a =>
        And.casesOn a fun left hz =>
          Exists.casesOn left fun p h =>
            And.casesOn h fun hp right =>
              Exists.casesOn right fun n h =>
                And.casesOn h fun hn right =>
                  Eq.ndrec (motive := fun x =>
                    deg x = z →
                      x ∈
                        DiamondIntegral.Section8.LatticeCone.level P v deg S z ∪
                          (fun x => x + v j) ''
                            DiamondIntegral.Section8.LatticeCone.level P v deg (insert j S) (z - deg (v j)))
                    (fun hz =>
                      if h0 : n j = 0 then
                        Or.inl
                          ⟨Exists.intro p
                              ⟨hp,
                                Exists.intro n
                                  ⟨fun i hi =>
                                    if hij : i = j then Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => n _a = 0) hij)) h0
                                    else
                                      hn i
                                        (of_eq_true
                                          (Eq.trans
                                            (congrArg Not
                                              (Eq.trans Finset.mem_insert._simp_1
                                                (Eq.trans (congr (congrArg Or (eq_false hij)) (eq_false hi))
                                                  (or_self False))))
                                            not_false_eq_true)),
                                    rfl⟩⟩,
                            hz⟩
                      else
                        Or.inr
                          (let n' := fun i => if i = j then n j - 1 else n i;
                          have hn' :=
                            funext fun i =>
                              if hij : i = j then
                                Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {j} =>
                                  (∀ j_1 ∉ insert j S, n j_1 = 0) →
                                    ¬n j = 0 →
                                      let n' := fun i => if i = j then n j - 1 else n i;
                                      n i = (n' + Pi.single j 1) i)
                                  (fun hn h0 =>
                                    let n' := fun i_1 => if i_1 = i then n i - 1 else n i_1;
                                    Eq.mpr
                                      (id
                                        (congrArg (Eq (n i))
                                          (congr
                                            (congrArg HAdd.hAdd (ite_eq_left_of_eq_true (n i - 1) (n i) (eq_self i)))
                                            (Pi.single_eq_same i 1))))
                                      (Decidable.byContradiction fun a =>
                                        DiamondIntegral.Section8.LatticeCone.level_insert._proof_1_1 v deg z p n i h0
                                          a))
                                  hij hn h0
                              else
                                of_eq_true
                                  (Eq.trans
                                    (congrArg (Eq (n i))
                                      (Eq.trans
                                        (congr

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.LatticeCone.series_empty.{u_1, u_2, u_3} : ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R]

  (∀ p ∈ P, 0 ≤ deg p) →
    DiamondIntegral.Section8.LatticeCone.series A P v deg L ∅ =
      ↑(DiamondIntegral.Section8.LatticeCone.numerator A P deg L) :=
fun {R} [CommRing R] A {E} [AddCommGroup E] {ι} [Fintype ι] P v deg L hP =>
  PowerSeries.ext fun m =>
    have hlev :=
      Set.ext fun x =>
        Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg (Iff ((∃ p ∈ P, ∃ n, (∀ j ∉ ∅, n j = 0) ∧ x = p + ∑ j, n j • v j) ∧ deg x = ↑m))
              (congrFun' (congrArg Membership.mem (Finset.coe_filter (fun p => deg p = ↑m) P)) x)))
          {
            mp := fun a =>
              And.casesOn a fun left hz =>
                Exists.casesOn left fun p h =>
                  And.casesOn h fun hp right =>
                    Exists.casesOn right fun n h =>
                      And.casesOn h fun hn right =>
                        Eq.ndrec (motive := fun x => deg x = ↑m → x ∈ P ∧ deg x = ↑m)
                          (fun hz =>
                            have h0 := funext fun j => hn j (Finset.notMem_empty j);
                            Eq.ndrec (motive := fun n =>
                              (∀ j ∉ ∅, n j = 0) →
                                deg (p + ∑ j, n j • v j) = ↑m → p + ∑ j, n j • v j ∈ P ∧ deg (p + ∑ j, n j • v j) = ↑m)
                              (fun hn hz =>
                                Eq.mpr
                                  (id
                                    (congr
                                      (congrArg And
                                        (congrArg (Membership.mem P)
                                          (Eq.trans
                                            (congrArg (HAdd.hAdd p)
                                              (Eq.trans
                                                (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl Finset.univ) fun x a => zero_smul ℕ (v x))
                                                Finset.sum_const_zero))
                                            (add_zero p))))
                                      (congrFun'
                                        (congrArg Eq

                                            (Eq.trans
                                              (congrArg (HAdd.hAdd p)
                                                (Eq.trans
                                                  (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl Finset.univ) fun x a => zero_smul ℕ (v x))
                                                  Finset.sum_const_zero))
                                              (add_zero p))))
                                        ↑m)))
                                  ⟨hp,
                                    Eq.mp
                                      (congrFun'
                                        (congrArg Eq
                                          (congrArg (⇑deg)
                                            (Eq.trans
                                              (congrArg (HAdd.hAdd p)
                                                (Eq.trans
                                                  (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl Finset.univ) fun x a => zero_smul ℕ (v x))
                                                  Finset.sum_const_zero))
                                              (add_zero p))))
                                        ↑m)
                                      hz⟩)
                              (Eq.symm h0) hn hz)
                          (Eq.symm right) hz,
            mpr := fun a =>
              And.casesOn a fun hp hz =>
                ⟨Exists.intro x
                    ⟨hp,
                      Exists.intro 0
                        ⟨fun x x_1 => rfl,
                          of_eq_true
                            (Eq.trans
                              (congrArg (Eq x)
                                (Eq.trans
                                  (congrArg (HAdd.hAdd x)
                                    (Eq.trans (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl Finset.univ) fun x a => zero_nsmul (v x))
                                      Finset.sum_const_zero))
                                  (add_zero x)))
                              (eq_self x))⟩⟩,
                  hz⟩ };

      (id
        (congr
          (congrArg Eq
            (PowerSeries.coeff_mk m fun m =>
              ∑ᶠ (x : E) (_ : x ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.LatticeCone.level P v deg ∅ ↑m),

@DiamondIntegral.Section8.LatticeCone.hasLimit_series : ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (A : Rˣ) {E : Type u_2}
  [inst_1 : AddCommGroup E] {ι : Type u_3} [inst_2 : Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (P : Finset E) (v : ι → E)
  (deg L : E →+ ℤ),
  (∀ p ∈ P, ∀ p' ∈ P, ∀ (n n' : ι → ℕ), p + ∑ j, n j • v j = p' + ∑ j, n' j • v j → p = p' ∧ n = n') →

                (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.milnor_invariant_conc f m)
                (fun p x x_1 x_2 => Exists.intro Fin.elim0 ⟨Finset.mem_singleton_self Fin.elim0, fun j => Fin.elim0 j⟩)

          (Eq.mpr

              (congrArg
                (fun _a =>
                  _a =
                    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.truncClass m (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.bOne m)

                (Finset.sum_singleton
                  (fun q =>
                    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.truncClass m (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.bOne m) q
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.rawMilnor_definableOver f))

DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.rv_bounds : ∀ (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient) {K : ℕ}
  (R : Set (Fin K → CanonicalRV.RVSort P.N)),
  (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace K).Definable (↑P.G.real) R →
    DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVValueDoublyBounded R →
      ∃ q₁ q₂,
        ∀ (s : Fin K → DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.RV),
          DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.eRVs P s ∈ R →
            ∀ (i : Fin K),
              ↑q₂ ≤ DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.value (s i) ∧
                DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.value (s i) ≤ ↑q₁
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.rv_bounds : ∀ (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient)
  {K : ℕ} (R : Set (Fin K → CanonicalRV.RVSort P.N)),
  (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace K).Definable (↑P.G.real) R →
    DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVValueDoublyBounded R →
      ∃ q₁ q₂,
        ∀ (s : Fin K → DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.RV),
          DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.eRVs P s ∈ R →
            ∀ (i : Fin K),
              ↑q₂ ≤ DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.value (s i) ∧
                DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.value (s i) ≤ ↑q₁ :=
fun P {K} R hR hb =>
  let Rc := (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace K).preimage R;
  have hRc := hR;
  let Gup :=
    {y | SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iRV (y 0) ∧ y 0 ≠ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iRVZero} ∩
      ⋂ j,
        {y |
          ∀ w ∈ Rc,
            SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iLe ((fun v => v (Sum.inr j)) (Sum.elim y w))
              ((fun v => v (Sum.inl 0)) (Sum.elim y w))};
  let Glo :=
    {y | SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iRV (y 0) ∧ y 0 ≠ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iRVZero} ∩
      ⋂ j,
        {y |
          ∀ w ∈ Rc,
            SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iLe ((fun v => v (Sum.inl 0)) (Sum.elim y w))
              ((fun v => v (Sum.inr j)) (Sum.elim y w))};
  have hGup :=
    Set.Definable.inter DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.nonzeroRV_definable
      (Set.definable_iInter_of_finite fun j =>
        DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.forall_le_definable hRc (fun v => v (Sum.inr j)) (fun v => v (Sum.inl 0))
          (Set.DefinableFun.proj SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV)
          (Set.DefinableFun.proj SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV));
  have hGlo :=
    Set.Definable.inter DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.nonzeroRV_definable
      (Set.definable_iInter_of_finite fun j =>
        DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.forall_le_definable hRc (fun v => v (Sum.inl 0)) (fun v => v (Sum.inr j))
          (Set.DefinableFun.proj SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV)
          (Set.DefinableFun.proj SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV));
  Exists.casesOn hb fun γ hγ =>
    Exists.casesOn (SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.EndpointLogic.codeValue_surjective γ) fun a₁ h =>
      And.casesOn h fun ha₁ ha₁γ =>
        Exists.casesOn (SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.EndpointLogic.codeValue_surjective γ⁻¹)
          fun a₂ h =>
          And.casesOn h fun ha₂ ha₂γ =>
            have hdec := fun w a =>
              Exists.casesOn a fun hw hR' =>
                Exists.intro ((SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace K).decode ⟨w, hw⟩)
                  ⟨hR', Classical.choose_spec hw⟩;
            have hneup :=
              Exists.intro (fun x => a₁)
                ⟨⟨ha₁.left, ha₁.right⟩,
                  Set.mem_iInter.mpr fun j w hw =>
                    Exists.casesOn (hdec w hw) fun u h =>
                      And.casesOn h fun hu right =>
                        Eq.ndrec (motive := fun w =>
                          w ∈ Rc →
                            SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iLe ((fun v => v (Sum.inr j)) (Sum.elim (fun x => a₁) w))
                              ((fun v => v (Sum.inl 0)) (Sum.elim (fun x => a₁) w)))
                          (fun hw =>
                            have h1 := (hγ u hu j).right;
                            (SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv_le_iff (u j) ⟨a₁, ha₁.left⟩).mp
                              (Eq.mp
                                (congrArg (fun _a => SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv (u j) ≤ _a)
                                  (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.codeValue_val P ha₁))
                                (Eq.mp
                                  (congrArg (fun _a => SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv (u j) ≤ ↑_a)
                                    (Eq.symm ha₁γ))
                                  h1)))
                          right hw⟩;
            have hnelo :=
              Exists.intro (fun x => a₂)
                ⟨⟨ha₂.left, ha₂.right⟩,
                  Set.mem_iInter.mpr fun j w hw =>
                    Exists.casesOn (hdec w hw) fun u h =>
                      And.casesOn h fun hu right =>
                        Eq.ndrec (motive := fun w =>
                          w ∈ Rc →
                            SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iLe ((fun v => v (Sum.inl 0)) (Sum.elim (fun x => a₂) w))
                              ((fun v => v (Sum.inr j)) (Sum.elim (fun x => a₂) w)))
                          (fun hw =>
                            have h1 := (hγ u hu j).left;
                            (SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv_le_iff ⟨a₂, ha₂.left⟩ (u j)).mp
                              (Eq.mp
                                (congrArg (fun _a => _a ≤ SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv (u j))
                                  (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.codeValue_val P ha₂))
                                (Eq.mp
                                  (congrArg (fun _a => ↑_a ≤ SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv (u j))
                                    (Eq.symm ha₂γ))
                                  h1)))
                          right hw⟩;
            have hconc := fun c hrv hnz =>
              have hrv' :=
                (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.e_sort P SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag.rv (c 0)).mp
                  hrv;
              Exists.casesOn
                (Sum.casesOn (motive := fun x => c 0 = x → ∃ r, x = Sum.inr r) (c 0)
                  (fun f hc0 =>
                    absurd
                      (Eq.mp
                        (congrArg
                          (fun _a =>
                            SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.sortEval SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag.rv _a)
                          hc0)
                        hrv')
                      fun h => h trivial)
                  (fun r hc0 => Exists.intro r rfl) (Eq.refl (c 0)))
                fun r hr =>
                have hrz := fun h =>
                  hnz
                    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => P.e _a = SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iRVZero) hr))
                      (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => P.e (Sum.inr _a) = SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iRVZero) h))
                        (Eq.mpr
                          (id
                            (congrArg (fun _a => P.e (Sum.inr none) = _a)
                              (Eq.symm (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.e_iRVZero P))))
                          (Eq.refl (P.e (Sum.inr none))))));
                Exists.casesOn (Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.mp hrz) fun u h =>
                  Eq.ndrec (motive := fun r => c 0 = Sum.inr r → r ≠ none → ∃ u, c 0 = Sum.inr (some u))
                    (fun hr hrz => Exists.intro u hr) (Eq.symm h) hr hrz;
            Exists.casesOn (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.concrete_witness P hGup hneup) fun c₁ h =>
              And.casesOn h fun left hall₁ =>
                And.casesOn left fun hrv₁ hnz₁ =>
                  Exists.casesOn (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.concrete_witness P hGlo hnelo) fun c₂ h =>
                    And.casesOn h fun left hall₂ =>
                      And.casesOn left fun hrv₂ hnz₂ =>
                        Exists.casesOn (hconc c₁ hrv₁ hnz₁) fun u₁ hu₁ =>
                          Exists.casesOn (hconc c₂ hrv₂ hnz₂) fun u₂ hu₂ =>
                            have hmem := fun s hs =>
                              Exists.intro (Exists.intro (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.eRVs P s) rfl)
                                (Eq.mpr
                                  (id
                                    (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ R)
                                      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.rawRV_decode_P P
                                        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.eRVs P s))))
                                  hs);
                            Exists.intro (Multiplicative.toAdd u₁.1)
                              (Exists.intro (Multiplicative.toAdd u₂.1) fun s hs i =>
                                ⟨have h1 :=
                                    Set.mem_iInter.mp hall₂ i
                                      (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues
                                        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.eRVs P s))
                                      (hmem s hs);
                                  id
                                    (fun h1 =>
                                      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.iLe_rvTag (some u₂) (s i)).mp
                                        (Eq.mp
                                          (congrArg (fun _a => SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iLe _a (Sum.inr (s i)))
                                            hu₂)
                                          (Eq.mp
                                            (congrArg (fun _a => _a)
                                              (propext
                                                (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.e_iLe P (c₂ 0) (Sum.inr (s i)))))
                                            h1)))
                                    h1,
                                  have h1 :=
                                    Set.mem_iInter.mp hall₁ i
                                      (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues
                                        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.eRVs P s))
                                      (hmem s hs);
                                  id
                                    (fun h1 =>
                                      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.iLe_rvTag (s i) (some u₁)).mp
                                        (Eq.mp
                                          (congrArg (fun _a => SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iLe (Sum.inr (s i)) _a)
                                            hu₁)
                                          (Eq.mp
                                            (congrArg (fun _a => _a)
                                              (propext
                                                (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.e_iLe P (Sum.inr (s i)) (c₁ 0))))
                                            h1)))
                                    h1⟩)

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.value_patterns : ∀
  (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient) {n : ℕ}
  (U : DiamondIntegral.Section6.MeasuredRVObject (↑P.G.real) n),

    ∀ (m : ℕ+),
      ∃ a c,
        ∀ (t : Fin U.object.arity → DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.RV)

              hrat;

            Exists.intro ⟨DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.eRVs P t, ht⟩
              (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.fcv_spec P U t ht);

            Exists.casesOn (Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.mp (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.fcv_ne_none P U t ht i))

                have hb := hq (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.fcv P U t ht) hmem i;

DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.label_rational_of_lattice : ∀
  (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient) (m : ℕ+)
  {r : CanonicalRV.RVSort DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.Carrier},
  DiamondIntegral.Section8.InLattice (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxValues.uniformizerValue P) (↑m)
      (SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.codeValue (P.e ↑r)) →
    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.LabelRational m (DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.taggedRVEquiv r)
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.label_rational_of_lattice : ∀
  (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient) (m : ℕ+)
  {r : CanonicalRV.RVSort DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.Carrier},
  DiamondIntegral.Section8.InLattice (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxValues.uniformizerValue P) (↑m)
      (SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.codeValue (P.e ↑r)) →
    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.LabelRational m (DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.taggedRVEquiv r) :=
fun P m {r} hl =>
  have hrv :=
    have h := FirstOrder.Language.ElementaryEmbedding.map_rel P.e SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Rel.memRV ![↑r];
    have ht :=
      funext fun i =>
        List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a x =>
          List.finRange (Nat.succ 0) = a → Fintype.complete i ≍ x → (⇑P.e ∘ ![↑r]) i = ![P.e ↑r] i) (Fintype.complete i)
          (fun as h =>
            List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun i =>
                ∀ (this : i ∈ Fintype.elems), [] ≍ as → this ≍ List.Mem.head as → (⇑P.e ∘ ![↑r]) i = ![P.e ↑r] i)
                (fun this tail_eq =>
                  Eq.ndrec (motive := fun as =>
                    this ≍ List.Mem.head as →
                      (⇑P.e ∘ ![↑r]) ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl (Nat.succ 0)⟩) =
                        ![P.e ↑r] ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl (Nat.succ 0)⟩))
                    (fun h => Eq.refl ((⇑P.e ∘ ![↑r]) ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl (Nat.succ 0)⟩)))
                    (eq_of_heq tail_eq))
                (eq_of_heq head_eq) (Fintype.complete i))
          (fun b {as} a h =>
            List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun b =>
                [] ≍ as → Fintype.complete i ≍ List.Mem.tail b a → (⇑P.e ∘ ![↑r]) i = ![P.e ↑r] i)
                (fun tail_eq =>
                  Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {as} =>
                    ∀ (a : List.Mem i as),
                      Fintype.complete i ≍ List.Mem.tail ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl (Nat.succ 0)⟩) a →
                        (⇑P.e ∘ ![↑r]) i = ![P.e ↑r] i)
                    (fun a h =>
                      List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a_1 x => [] = a_1 → a ≍ x → (⇑P.e ∘ ![↑r]) i = ![P.e ↑r] i) a
                        (fun as h => False.elim (noConfusion_of_Nat List.ctorIdx h))
                        (fun b {as} a_1 h => False.elim (noConfusion_of_Nat List.ctorIdx h)) (Eq.refl []) (HEq.refl a))
                    (eq_of_heq tail_eq) a)
                (eq_of_heq head_eq))
          (Eq.refl (List.finRange (Nat.succ 0))) (HEq.refl (Fintype.complete i));
    (Eq.mp
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              FirstOrder.Language.Structure.RelMap SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Rel.memRV _a ↔
                FirstOrder.Language.Structure.RelMap SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Rel.memRV ![↑r])
            ht)
          h).mpr
      r.property;
  have hfix := DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.fixed_of_lattice P m hrv hl;
  (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.labelFixed_iff m (DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.taggedRVEquiv r)).mp
    (Sum.inr_injective
      (Eq.mp
        (congrArg (fun _a => _a = Sum.inr (DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.rvPart ↑r))
          (DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.carrierAction_inr (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Galois.levelRoots m)
            (DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.rvPart ↑r)))
        (Eq.mp
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              (DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.carrierAction (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Galois.levelRoots m))
                  _a =
                _a)
            (Eq.symm (DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.rvSort_tag r)))
          hfix)))

    (∀ δ < Multiplicative.toAdd u.1, DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf y δ = 0) ∧

    Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => Multiplicative.toAdd _a.1 = (↑y).order) (Eq.symm h')))

DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.card_free_fin : ∀ (B ℓ : ℕ), ℓ ≤ B → Fintype.card { j // ℓ < ↑j } = B - ℓ
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.card_free_fin : ∀ (B ℓ : ℕ), ℓ ≤ B → Fintype.card { j // ℓ < ↑j } = B - ℓ :=
fun B ℓ h =>
  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = B - ℓ) (Fintype.card_subtype fun j => ℓ < ↑j)))
    (have he :=
      Finset.ext fun j =>
        Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congr
              (congrArg Iff
                (Eq.trans DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.card_free_fin._simp_1_3
                  (Eq.trans
                    (congrFun' (congrArg And (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.card_free_fin._simp_1_4 j)) (ℓ < ↑j))
                    (true_and (ℓ < ↑j)))))
              (Eq.trans
                (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.card_free_fin._simp_1_5 fun j hj =>
                  Decidable.byContradiction fun a =>
                    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.card_free_fin._proof_1_2 B ℓ j
                      (Eq.mp DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.card_free_fin._simp_1_1 hj) a)
                DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.card_free_fin._simp_1_1)))
          (have this := j.isLt;
          Decidable.byContradiction fun a => DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.card_free_fin._proof_1_6 B ℓ j this a);
    Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a.card = B - ℓ) he))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a => _a = B - ℓ)
            (Finset.card_attachFin (Finset.Ioc ℓ B) fun j hj =>
              Decidable.byContradiction fun a =>
                DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.card_free_fin._proof_1_2 B ℓ j
                  (Eq.mp DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.card_free_fin._simp_1_1 hj) a)))
        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = B - ℓ) (Nat.card_Ioc ℓ B))) (Eq.refl (B - ℓ)))))

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.units_identity : ∀ (N B C : ℕ) (e : ℤ),
  ↑N - ↑B = e - ↑C →
    ↑DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.Lunit ^ N * DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Linv B =
      ↑(DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.Lunit ^ e) * DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Linv C :=

@DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.sign_smul_pos : ∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : LinearOrder V]
  [IsOrderedAddMonoid V] [inst_3 : Module ℚ V] [PosSMulStrictMono ℚ V] {e : V},
  0 < e → ∀ (q : ℚ), SignType.sign (q • e) = SignType.sign q
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.sign_smul_pos.{u_1} : ∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommGroup V]
  [inst_1 : LinearOrder V] [IsOrderedAddMonoid V] [inst_3 : Module ℚ V] [PosSMulStrictMono ℚ V] {e : V},
  0 < e → ∀ (q : ℚ), SignType.sign (q • e) = SignType.sign q :=
fun {V} [AddCommGroup V] [LinearOrder V] [IsOrderedAddMonoid V] [Module ℚ V] [PosSMulStrictMono ℚ V] {e} he q =>
  Or.casesOn (lt_trichotomy q 0)
    (fun h =>
      have this := smul_pos (neg_pos.mpr h) he;
      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a => _a = SignType.sign q)
            (sign_neg
              (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a) (propext neg_pos))
                (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => 0 < _a) (neg_smul q e)) this)))))
        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => -1 = _a) (sign_neg h))) (Eq.refl (-1))))
    fun h =>
    Or.casesOn h
      (fun h =>
        of_eq_true
          (Eq.trans
            (congr
              (congrArg Eq
                (Eq.trans (congrArg (⇑SignType.sign) (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg HSMul.hSMul h) e) (zero_smul ℚ e)))
                  sign_zero))
              (Eq.trans (congrArg (⇑SignType.sign) h) sign_zero))
            (eq_self 0)))
      fun h =>
      Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = SignType.sign q) (sign_pos (smul_pos h he))))
        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => 1 = _a) (sign_pos h))) (Eq.refl 1))

@DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.sign_smul : ∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : LinearOrder V]
  [IsOrderedAddMonoid V] [inst_3 : Module ℚ V] [PosSMulStrictMono ℚ V] (q : ℚ) (w : V),
  SignType.sign (q • w) = SignType.sign q * SignType.sign w
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.sign_smul.{u_1} : ∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommGroup V]
  [inst_1 : LinearOrder V] [IsOrderedAddMonoid V] [inst_3 : Module ℚ V] [PosSMulStrictMono ℚ V] (q : ℚ) (w : V),
  SignType.sign (q • w) = SignType.sign q * SignType.sign w :=
fun {V} [AddCommGroup V] [LinearOrder V] [IsOrderedAddMonoid V] [Module ℚ V] [PosSMulStrictMono ℚ V] q w =>
  Or.casesOn (lt_trichotomy w 0)
    (fun hw =>
      have h1 := DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.sign_smul_pos (neg_pos.mpr hw) q;
      Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => SignType.sign (q • w) = SignType.sign q * _a) (sign_neg hw)))
        (Trans.trans (Eq.symm (neg_neg (SignType.sign (q • w))))
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun _a => -_a = SignType.sign q * -1)
                (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a = SignType.sign q) (Left.sign_neg (q • w)))
                  (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => SignType.sign _a = SignType.sign q) (smul_neg q w)) h1))))
            (of_eq_true
              (Eq.trans
                (congrArg (Eq (-SignType.sign q))
                  (Eq.trans (mul_neg (SignType.sign q) 1) (congrArg Neg.neg (mul_one (SignType.sign q)))))
                (eq_self (-SignType.sign q)))))))
    fun h =>
    Or.casesOn h
      (fun hw =>
        of_eq_true
          (Eq.trans
            (congr
              (congrArg Eq
                (Eq.trans (congrArg (⇑SignType.sign) (Eq.trans (congrArg (HSMul.hSMul q) hw) (smul_zero q))) sign_zero))
              (Eq.trans (congrArg (HMul.hMul (SignType.sign q)) (Eq.trans (congrArg (⇑SignType.sign) hw) sign_zero))
                (mul_zero (SignType.sign q))))
            (eq_self 0)))
      fun hw =>
      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a => _a = SignType.sign q * SignType.sign w)
            (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.sign_smul_pos hw q)))
        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => SignType.sign q = SignType.sign q * _a) (sign_pos hw)))
          (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => SignType.sign q = _a) (mul_one (SignType.sign q))))
            (Eq.refl (SignType.sign q))))

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.exists_rat_between_finsets : ∀ (S T : Finset ℚ),
  (∀ s ∈ S, ∀ t ∈ T, s < t) → ∃ r, (∀ s ∈ S, s < r) ∧ ∀ t ∈ T, r < t :=
fun S T h =>
  if hS : S.Nonempty then
    if hT : T.Nonempty then
      Exists.intro ((S.max' hS + T.min' hT) / 2)
        ⟨fun s hs =>
          have h1 := Finset.le_max' S s hs;
          have h2 := h (S.max' hS) (Finset.max'_mem S hS) (T.min' hT) (Finset.min'_mem T hT);

            Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith.lt_irrefl
              (Eq.mp
                (congrArg (fun _a => _a < 0)
                  (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.of_eq
                    (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.add_congr

  [inst_1 : LinearOrder V] [IsOrderedAddMonoid V] {ι : Type u_2} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → ℚ) (b : ι → V)
  (y : V),

    ∃ r, ∀ i ∈ s, SignType.sign (r - a i) = SignType.sign (y - b i) :=

      And.casesOn h fun hi right => Eq.symm right ▸ Exists.intro (a i) fun j hj => hab i hi j hj
