theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.mem_satQ_liftC : ∀ {n : ℕ}
  (C : List (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.AffFun n × SignType)) (x : Fin (n + 1) → ℚ),
  (∀ p ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.liftC C, SignType.sign (p.1.eval x) = p.2) ↔
    (fun i => x i.castSucc) ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.satQ C :=
fun {n} C x =>
  {
    mp := fun h p hp =>
      have this := h (p.1.liftFun, p.2) (List.mem_map.mpr (Exists.intro p ⟨hp, rfl⟩));
      Eq.mp
        (congrArg (fun _a => SignType.sign _a = (p.1.liftFun, p.2).2)
          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.AffFun.eval_liftFun p.1 x))
        this,
    mpr := fun h q hq =>
      Exists.casesOn (List.mem_map.mp hq) fun p h_1 =>
        And.casesOn h_1 fun hp right =>
          Eq.ndrec (motive := fun q => q ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.liftC C → SignType.sign (q.1.eval x) = q.2)
            (fun hq =>
              id
                (Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg (fun _a => SignType.sign _a = p.2)
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.AffFun.eval_liftFun p.1 x)))
                  (h p hp)))
            right hq }

  γ ≤ SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom a →
    γ ≤ SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom b →
      γ ≤ SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom (a + b) :=
fun P {γ} {a b} ha hb =>
  have h := SpecialTransformations.Section9.vfValue_min_le_sub a (-b);
  LE.le.trans (le_min ha hb)
    (Eq.mp
      (congrArg
        (fun _a =>
          min (SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom a) _a ≤
            SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom (a + b))
        (SpecialTransformations.Section9.vfValue_neg b))
      (Eq.mp
        (congrArg
          (fun _a =>
            min (SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom a)
                (SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom (-b)) ≤
              SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom _a)
          (sub_neg_eq_add a b))
        h))

DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.poly_integral : ∀ (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient) {d : ℕ}
  (g : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ) {x : Fin d → SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.VFType},
  (∀ (i : Fin d), 1 ≤ SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom (x i)) →
    1 ≤
      SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom ((MvPolynomial.eval x) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.fN P g))
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.poly_integral : ∀ (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient)
  {d : ℕ} (g : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ) {x : Fin d → SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.VFType},
  (∀ (i : Fin d), 1 ≤ SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom (x i)) →
    1 ≤
      SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom
        ((MvPolynomial.eval x) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.fN P g)) :=
fun P {d} g {x} hx =>
  MvPolynomial.induction_on g
    (fun a =>
      id
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg (fun _a => 1 ≤ SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom ((MvPolynomial.eval x) _a))
              (MvPolynomial.map_C (DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.ambientComplexFieldHom P.e) a)))
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun _a => 1 ≤ SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom _a)
                (MvPolynomial.eval_C ((DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.ambientComplexFieldHom P.e) a))))
            (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.complex_value_ge P a))))
    (fun p q hp hq =>
      id
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg (fun _a => 1 ≤ SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom ((MvPolynomial.eval x) _a))
              (RingHom.map_add (MvPolynomial.map (DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.ambientComplexFieldHom P.e))
                p q)))
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun _a => 1 ≤ SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom _a)
                (RingHom.map_add (MvPolynomial.eval x)
                  ((MvPolynomial.map (DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.ambientComplexFieldHom P.e)) p)
                  ((MvPolynomial.map (DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.ambientComplexFieldHom P.e)) q))))
            (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.value_add_ge P hp hq))))
    fun p i hp =>
    id
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a => 1 ≤ SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom ((MvPolynomial.eval x) _a))
            (RingHom.map_mul (MvPolynomial.map (DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.ambientComplexFieldHom P.e)) p
              (MvPolynomial.X i))))
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                1 ≤
                  SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom
                    ((MvPolynomial.eval x)
                      ((MvPolynomial.map (DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.ambientComplexFieldHom P.e)) p *
                        _a)))
              (MvPolynomial.map_X (DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.ambientComplexFieldHom P.e) i)))
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun _a => 1 ≤ SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom _a)
                (RingHom.map_mul (MvPolynomial.eval x)
                  ((MvPolynomial.map (DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.ambientComplexFieldHom P.e)) p)
                  (MvPolynomial.X i))))
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg
                  (fun _a =>
                    1 ≤
                      SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom
                        ((MvPolynomial.eval x)
                            ((MvPolynomial.map (DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.ambientComplexFieldHom P.e))
                              p) *
                          _a))
                  (MvPolynomial.eval_X i)))
              (Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg (fun _a => 1 ≤ _a)
                    (map_mul SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom
                      ((MvPolynomial.eval x)
                        ((MvPolynomial.map (DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.ambientComplexFieldHom P.e)) p))
                      (x i))))
                (one_le_mul hp (hx i)))))))

DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.poly_lipschitz : ∀ (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient) {d : ℕ}
  (g : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ) {x y : Fin d → SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.VFType},

    (∀ (i : Fin d), 1 ≤ SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom (y i)) →

        (∀ (i : Fin d), ↑γ < SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom (x i - y i)) →

            SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom
              ((MvPolynomial.eval x) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.fN P g) -
                (MvPolynomial.eval y) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.fN P g))
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.poly_lipschitz : ∀ (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient)
  {d : ℕ} (g : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ) {x y : Fin d → SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.VFType},
  (∀ (i : Fin d), 1 ≤ SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom (x i)) →
    (∀ (i : Fin d), 1 ≤ SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom (y i)) →
      ∀ {γ : SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.Gamma},
        (∀ (i : Fin d), ↑γ < SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom (x i - y i)) →
          ↑γ <
            SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom
              ((MvPolynomial.eval x) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.fN P g) -
                (MvPolynomial.eval y) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.fN P g)) :=
fun P {d} g {x y} hx hy {γ} hxy =>
  MvPolynomial.induction_on g
    (fun a =>
      id
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                ↑γ <
                  SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom
                    ((MvPolynomial.eval x) _a - (MvPolynomial.eval y) _a))
              (MvPolynomial.map_C (DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.ambientComplexFieldHom P.e) a)))
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg
                (fun _a =>
                  ↑γ <
                    SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom
                      (_a -
                        (MvPolynomial.eval y)
                          (MvPolynomial.C ((DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.ambientComplexFieldHom P.e) a))))
                (MvPolynomial.eval_C ((DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.ambientComplexFieldHom P.e) a))))
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg
                  (fun _a =>
                    ↑γ <
                      SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom
                        ((DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.ambientComplexFieldHom P.e) a - _a))
                  (MvPolynomial.eval_C ((DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.ambientComplexFieldHom P.e) a))))
              (Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg (fun _a => ↑γ < SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom _a)

    (fun p q hp hq =>
      id
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                ↑γ <
                  SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom
                    ((MvPolynomial.eval x) _a - (MvPolynomial.eval y) _a))
              (RingHom.map_add (MvPolynomial.map (DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.ambientComplexFieldHom P.e))
                p q)))
          (Eq.mpr
            (id

                (fun _a =>
                  ↑γ <
                    SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom
                      (_a -
                        (MvPolynomial.eval y)

                              q)))

                  ((MvPolynomial.map (DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.ambientComplexFieldHom P.e)) p)
                  ((MvPolynomial.map (DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.ambientComplexFieldHom P.e)) q))))
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg
                  (fun _a =>
                    ↑γ <
                      SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom
                        ((MvPolynomial.eval x)
                              ((MvPolynomial.map (DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.ambientComplexFieldHom P.e))

                      ((MvPolynomial.eval y)
                        ((MvPolynomial.map (DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.ambientComplexFieldHom P.e)) q)))))

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.mem_ball_iff : ∀ (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient)

  id
    (Eq.mpr

        (congrArg (fun _a => ↑x ∈ _a ↔ 1 < SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom x)

              (propext (SpecialTransformations.Section3.OpenBallCodes.body_realize ![↑0, ↑1] ↑x))))
          (have hP :=
            ⟨fun i =>
              List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a x =>
                List.finRange 2 = a → Fintype.complete i ≍ x → SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iVF (![↑0, ↑1] i))
                (Fintype.complete i)
                (fun as h =>
                  List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
                    Eq.ndrec (motive := fun i =>
                      ∀ (this : i ∈ Fintype.elems),
                        (fun x1 x2 => (fun i => i) x1 :: x2) ⟨1, Nat.le_refl 2⟩ [] ≍ as →
                          this ≍ List.Mem.head as → SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iVF (![↑0, ↑1] i))
                      (fun this tail_eq =>
                        Eq.ndrec (motive := fun as =>
                          this ≍ List.Mem.head as →
                            SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iVF
                              (![↑0, ↑1] ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.le_refl 2)⟩)))
                          (fun h => Subtype.property 0) (eq_of_heq tail_eq))
                      (eq_of_heq head_eq) (Fintype.complete i))
                (fun b {as} a h =>
                  List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
                    Eq.ndrec (motive := fun b =>

                        Fintype.complete i ≍ List.Mem.tail b a → SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iVF (![↑0, ↑1] i))

                        Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {as} =>

DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.milnor_invariant : ∀ (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient)
  {d : ℕ} (f : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ) {x y : Fin d → SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.VFType},

    (∀ (i : Fin d),
        ↑(DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.piV P) < SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom (x i - y i)) →
      (y, Fin.elim0) ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.milnorSet P f
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.milnor_invariant : ∀
  (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient) {d : ℕ} (f : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ)
  {x y : Fin d → SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.VFType},
  (x, Fin.elim0) ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.milnorSet P f →
    (∀ (i : Fin d),
        ↑(DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.piV P) < SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom (x i - y i)) →
      (y, Fin.elim0) ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.milnorSet P f :=
fun P {d} f {x y} hx hxy =>
  And.casesOn hx fun hxM hxf =>
    have h1 := DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxValues.one_lt_uniformizerValue P;
    have hyM := fun i =>
      have h := SpecialTransformations.Section9.vfValue_min_le_sub (x i) (x i - y i);
      LT.lt.trans_le (lt_min (hxM i) (LT.lt.trans h1 (hxy i)))
        (Eq.mp
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              min (SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom (x i))
                  (SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom (x i - y i)) ≤
                SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom _a)
            (sub_sub_cancel (x i) (y i)))
          h);
    ⟨hyM,
      have hfx :=
        Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom
                    ((MvPolynomial.eval x) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.fN P f)) =
                  _a)
              (Eq.symm (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.value_tN P))))
          (congrArg SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv hxf);
      have hlip :=
        DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.poly_lipschitz P f (fun i => LT.lt.le (hxM i)) (fun i => LT.lt.le (hyM i)) hxy;
      have hne := fun h0 =>
        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.piV P).property
          (Eq.symm
            (Eq.mp
              (congrArg (fun _a => _a = ↑(DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.piV P))
                (Eq.symm SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.infinity_eq_zero))
              (Eq.mp
                (congrArg (fun _a => _a = ↑(DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.piV P))
                  (map_zero SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom))
                (Eq.mp
                  (congrArg
                    (fun _a =>
                      SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom _a = ↑(DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.piV P))
                    h0)
                  hfx))));
      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv P.N
                  ((MvPolynomial.eval (y, Fin.elim0).1) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.fN P f)) =
                _a)
            (Eq.symm hxf)))
        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rv_eq_of_value_close hne
          (id
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg
                  (fun _a =>
                    _a <
                      SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom
                        ((MvPolynomial.eval (y, Fin.elim0).1) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.fN P f) -
                          (MvPolynomial.eval x) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.fN P f)))
                  hfx))
              (Eq.mp
                (congrArg (fun _a => ↑(DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.piV P) < _a)
                  (SpecialTransformations.Section9.vfValue_sub_comm
                    ((MvPolynomial.eval (x, Fin.elim0).1) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.fN P f))
                    ((MvPolynomial.eval y) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.fN P f))))
                hlip))))⟩

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.mem_milnorSetX_iff : ∀
  (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient) {N d k : ℕ} (F : Fin k → MvPolynomial (Fin N) ℂ)
  (f : MvPolynomial (Fin N) ℂ) (q : Fin d → MvPolynomial (Fin N) ℂ)
  (x : Fin d → SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.VFType) (t : Fin 0 → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity P.N),
  (x, t) ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.milnorSetX P F f q ↔
    ∃ y ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.tube P F,
      DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv P.N ((MvPolynomial.eval y) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.fN P f)) =
          DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv P.N (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.tN P) ∧
        DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.chartMap P q y = x :=
fun P {N d k} F f q x t =>
  {
    mp := fun a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun a ha =>
        have ha' := ha;
        Exists.intro (↑a).1 ⟨a.property.left, ⟨a.property.right, congrArg Prod.fst ha'⟩⟩,
    mpr := fun a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun y h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hy right =>
          And.casesOn right fun hf right =>
            right ▸
              Exists.intro ⟨(y, Fin.elim0), ⟨hy, hf⟩⟩
                (id
                  (Prod.ext rfl
                    (Subsingleton.elim (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.chartMap P q y, Fin.elim0).2
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.chartMap P q y, t).2))) }

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.milnorX_invariant : ∀
  (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient) {N d k : ℕ} {F : Fin k → MvPolynomial (Fin N) ℂ}
  (f : MvPolynomial (Fin N) ℂ) {q : Fin d → MvPolynomial (Fin N) ℂ},
  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.EtaleChart P F q →
    ∀ {x x' : Fin d → SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.VFType}
      {t : Fin 0 → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity P.N},
      (x, t) ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.milnorSetX P F f q →
        (∀ (i : Fin d),
            ↑(DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.piV P) < SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom (x i - x' i)) →
          (x', t) ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.milnorSetX P F f q :=
fun P {N d k} {F} f {q} hq {x x'} {t} hx hxx =>
  have h1 := DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxValues.one_lt_uniformizerValue P;
  have hxM := DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.milnorX_maximal P f hq hx;
  Exists.casesOn ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.mem_milnorSetX_iff P F f q x t).mp hx) fun y h =>
    And.casesOn h fun hy right =>
      And.casesOn right fun hf right =>
        Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {x} =>
          (x, t) ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.milnorSetX P F f q →
            (∀ (i : Fin d),
                ↑(DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.piV P) <
                  SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom (x i - x' i)) →
              (∀ (i : Fin d), 1 < SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom (x i)) →
                (x', t) ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.milnorSetX P F f q)
          (fun hx hxx hxM =>
            have hx'M := fun i =>
              have h :=
                SpecialTransformations.Section9.vfValue_min_le_sub (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.chartMap P q y i)
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.chartMap P q y i - x' i);
              LT.lt.trans_le (lt_min (hxM i) (LT.lt.trans h1 (hxx i)))
                (Eq.mp
                  (congrArg
                    (fun _a =>
                      min
                          (SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom
                            (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.chartMap P q y i))
                          (SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom
                            (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.chartMap P q y i - x' i)) ≤
                        SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom _a)
                    (sub_sub_cancel (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.chartMap P q y i) (x' i)))
                  h);
            Exists.casesOn (hq.surj x' hx'M) fun y' h =>
              And.casesOn h fun hy' right =>
                Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {x'} =>
                  (∀ (i : Fin d),
                      ↑(DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.piV P) <
                        SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.chartMap P q y i - x' i)) →
                    (∀ (i : Fin d), 1 < SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom (x' i)) →
                      (x', t) ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.milnorSetX P F f q)
                  (fun hxx hx'M =>
                    have hyy := hq.lipschitz y hy y' hy' (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.piV P) hxx;
                    have hfy :=
                      Eq.mpr
                        (id
                          (congrArg
                            (fun _a =>
                              SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom
                                  ((MvPolynomial.eval y) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.fN P f)) =
                                _a)
                            (Eq.symm (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.value_tN P))))
                        (congrArg SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv hf);
                    have hlip :=
                      DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.poly_lipschitz P f (fun i => LT.lt.le (hy.left i))
                        (fun i => LT.lt.le (hy'.left i)) hyy;
                    have hne := fun h0 =>
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.piV P).property
                        (Eq.symm
                          (Eq.mp
                            (congrArg (fun _a => _a = ↑(DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.piV P))
                              (Eq.symm SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.infinity_eq_zero))
                            (Eq.mp
                              (congrArg (fun _a => _a = ↑(DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.piV P))
                                (map_zero SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom))
                              (Eq.mp
                                (congrArg
                                  (fun _a =>
                                    SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom _a =
                                      ↑(DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.piV P))
                                  h0)
                                hfy))));
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.mem_milnorSetX_iff P F f q
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.chartMap P q y') t).mpr
                      (Exists.intro y'
                        ⟨hy',
                          ⟨Eq.mpr
                              (id
                                (congrArg
                                  (fun _a =>
                                    DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv P.N
                                        ((MvPolynomial.eval y') (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.fN P f)) =
                                      _a)
                                  (Eq.symm hf)))
                              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rv_eq_of_value_close hne
                                (id
                                  (Eq.mpr
                                    (id
                                      (congrArg
                                        (fun _a =>
                                          _a <
                                            SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom
                                              ((MvPolynomial.eval y') (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.fN P f) -
                                                (MvPolynomial.eval y) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.fN P f)))
                                        hfy))
                                    (Eq.mp
                                      (congrArg (fun _a => ↑(DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.piV P) < _a)
                                        (SpecialTransformations.Section9.vfValue_sub_comm
                                          ((MvPolynomial.eval y) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.fN P f))
                                          ((MvPolynomial.eval y') (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.fN P f))))
                                      hlip)))),
                            rfl⟩⟩))
                  right hxx hx'M)
          right hx hxx hxM

      DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.rvOfField (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cev f p.1) =
          DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.rvOfField DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.tS ∧
        ∀ (j : Fin k),
          ↑1 < DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cev (F j) p.1) :=

  have h1 := DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mem_mixedSet_milnor f p;

      (id

      (Eq.mpr

                        DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedRaw p ∈

                      DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.rvOfField

                          ↑1 <
                            DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS
                              (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cev (F j) p.1))

            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg
                  (fun _a =>
                    _a ↔
                      (∀ (i : Fin N), 0 < DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS (p.1 i)) ∧
                        DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.rvOfField

@DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.near_invariant : ∀ {N k : ℕ} (F : Fin k → MvPolynomial (Fin N) ℂ)
  (f : MvPolynomial (Fin N) ℂ) (m : ℕ+),
  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Invariant m (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.bOne m)
    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.rawNear F f))
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.near_invariant : ∀ {N k : ℕ} (F : Fin k → MvPolynomial (Fin N) ℂ)
  (f : MvPolynomial (Fin N) ℂ) (m : ℕ+),
  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Invariant m (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.bOne m)
    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.rawNear F f)) :=
fun {N k} F f m x x' u hx hcongr =>
  have hx1 := (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mem_mixedSet_near F f (x, u)).mp hx;
  have hm := (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mem_mixedSet_milnor f (x, u)).mpr ⟨hx1.left, hx1.right.left⟩;
  have hm' := DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.milnor_invariant_conc f m x x' u hm hcongr;
  And.casesOn ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mem_mixedSet_milnor f (x', u)).mp hm') fun hx'M hx'f =>
    have hdiff := fun i =>
      Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a) (propext (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lt_ordS_iff (x i - x' i) 1))))
        fun γ hγ =>
        have this := id (Eq.refl ((↑(x i)).coeff γ - (↑(x' i)).coeff γ));
        Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = 0) this))
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun _a => _a - DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf (x' i) γ = 0)
                (hcongr i γ
                  (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => γ ≤ _a) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lev_self m))) hγ))))
            (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = 0) (sub_self (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf (x' i) γ))))
              (Eq.refl 0)));
    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mem_mixedSet_near F f (x', u)).mpr
      ⟨hx'M,
        ⟨hx'f, fun j =>
          DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.one_lt_ordS_of_close (hx1.right.right j)
            (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.poly_lipschitz_conc (F j) (fun i => LT.lt.le (hx1.left i))
              (fun i => LT.lt.le (hx'M i)) hdiff)⟩⟩
'DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.near_invariant' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
@DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.IsJetX : {N k : ℕ} →
  (Fin k → MvPolynomial (Fin N) ℂ) → MvPolynomial (Fin N) ℂ → (m : ℕ+) → (Fin N → Fin (↑m + 1) → ℂ) → Prop
def DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.IsJetX : {N k : ℕ} →
  (Fin k → MvPolynomial (Fin N) ℂ) → MvPolynomial (Fin N) ℂ → (m : ℕ+) → (Fin N → Fin (↑m + 1) → ℂ) → Prop :=

DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.one_lt_ordS_sub_iff : ∀ (m : ℕ+) (g : Polynomial ℂ),
  ↑1 < DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.sub m) g) ↔
    ∀ l ≤ ↑m, g.coeff l = 0
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.one_lt_ordS_sub_iff : ∀ (m : ℕ+) (g : Polynomial ℂ),
  ↑1 < DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.sub m) g) ↔
    ∀ l ≤ ↑m, g.coeff l = 0 :=
fun m g =>
  have hm :=
    cast (Eq.symm (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg LT.lt (Eq.symm Nat.cast_zero)) ↑↑m) Nat.cast_lt._simp_1)) (PNat.pos m);
  have hle := fun l =>
    Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ≤ 1 ↔ l ≤ ↑m) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lev.eq_1 m l)))
      (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ↔ l ≤ ↑m) (propext (div_le_one hm))))
        (cast (Eq.symm (congrFun' (congrArg Iff Nat.cast_le._simp_1) (l ≤ ↑m))) Iff.rfl));
  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (congrArg (fun _a => _a ↔ ∀ l ≤ ↑m, g.coeff l = 0)
        (propext (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lt_ordS_iff ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.sub m) g) 1))))
    {
      mp := fun h l hl =>
        Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = 0) (Eq.symm (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf_sub_lev m g l))))
          (h (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lev m l) ((hle l).mpr hl)),
      mpr := fun h γ hγ =>
        if hl : ∃ l, γ = DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lev m l then
          Exists.casesOn hl fun l h_1 =>
            Eq.ndrec (motive := fun γ =>
              γ ≤ 1 → DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.sub m) g) γ = 0)
              (fun hγ =>
                Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = 0) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf_sub_lev m g l)))
                  (h l ((hle l).mp hγ)))
              (Eq.symm h_1) hγ
        else
          DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf_sub_of_not_lev m g γ
            (Eq.mp (Mathlib.Tactic.Push.not_exists._simp_1 fun l => γ = DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lev m l)
              hl) }

@DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.affineIndependent_of_forall : ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {m : ℕ}
  (p : ι → Fin m → ℚ),
  (∀ (w : ι → ℚ), ∑ i, w i = 0 → (∀ (c : Fin m), ∑ i, w i * p i c = 0) → ∀ (i : ι), w i = 0) → AffineIndependent ℚ p
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.affineIndependent_of_forall.{u_1} : ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {m : ℕ}
  (p : ι → Fin m → ℚ),
  (∀ (w : ι → ℚ), ∑ i, w i = 0 → (∀ (c : Fin m), ∑ i, w i * p i c = 0) → ∀ (i : ι), w i = 0) → AffineIndependent ℚ p :=
fun {ι} [Fintype ι] {m} p h =>
  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a) (propext affineIndependent_iff))) fun s w hs hsum i hi =>
    have h' :=
      h (fun i => if i ∈ s then w i else 0)
        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = 0) (Finset.sum_ite_mem Finset.univ s w)))
          (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ∑ i ∈ _a, w i = 0) (Finset.univ_inter s))) hs))
        (fun c =>
          have hc := congrFun hsum c;
          Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrFun'
                (congrArg Eq
                  (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl Finset.univ) fun x a =>
                    Eq.trans (ite_mul (x ∈ s) (w x) 0 (p x c))
                      (ite_congr (Eq.refl (x ∈ s)) (fun a => Eq.refl (w x * p x c)) fun a => zero_mul (p x c))))
                0))
            (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = 0) (Finset.sum_ite_mem Finset.univ s fun x => w x * p x c)))
              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ∑ i ∈ _a, w i * p i c = 0) (Finset.univ_inter s)))
                (Eq.mp
                  (congrFun'
                    (congrArg Eq
                      (Eq.trans (Finset.sum_apply c s fun c => w c • p c)
                        (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl s) fun x a => Eq.refl (w x * p x c))))
                    0)
                  hc))))
        i;
    Eq.mp (congrFun' (congrArg Eq (ite_eq_left_of_eq_true (w i) 0 (eq_true hi))) 0) h'

@DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.mem_graph_iff : ∀ {n : ℕ} {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (v : ι → Fin n → ℚ)

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.bary_unique.{u_1} : ∀ {n : ℕ} {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι]

  AffineIndependent ℚ v →
    ∀ {t t' : ι → ℚ},
      DiamondIntegral.Section8.HeightChains.IsBary t →
        DiamondIntegral.Section8.HeightChains.IsBary t' →

            DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.OverBase v t z → DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.OverBase v t' z → t = t' :=

        (of_eq_true
          (Eq.trans
            (congrFun'
              (congrArg Eq
                (Eq.trans
                  (Eq.trans (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl Finset.univ) fun x a => Eq.refl (t x - t' x))
                    (Finset.sum_sub_distrib t t'))

              0)

                (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = 0) (sub_self (z c.castSucc)))) (Eq.refl 0)))))

@DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.mem_bandSimplex_iff : ∀ {n k : ℕ} (v : Fin (k + 1) → Fin n → ℚ) (f : Fin (k + 1) → ℚ)
  (j : Fin (k + 1)) (c : ℚ) (z : Fin (n + 1) → ℚ),
  z ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.openSimplex (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.bandVertices v f j c) ↔
    ∃ s,
      DiamondIntegral.Section8.HeightChains.IsBary s ∧
        (∀ (i : Fin n), z i.castSucc = ∑ m, s m.castSucc * v m i + s (Fin.last (k + 1)) * v j i) ∧
          z (Fin.last n) = ∑ m, s m.castSucc * f m + s (Fin.last (k + 1)) * c
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.mem_bandSimplex_iff : ∀ {n k : ℕ} (v : Fin (k + 1) → Fin n → ℚ)
  (f : Fin (k + 1) → ℚ) (j : Fin (k + 1)) (c : ℚ) (z : Fin (n + 1) → ℚ),
  z ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.openSimplex (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.bandVertices v f j c) ↔
    ∃ s,
      DiamondIntegral.Section8.HeightChains.IsBary s ∧
        (∀ (i : Fin n), z i.castSucc = ∑ m, s m.castSucc * v m i + s (Fin.last (k + 1)) * v j i) ∧
          z (Fin.last n) = ∑ m, s m.castSucc * f m + s (Fin.last (k + 1)) * c :=
fun {n k} v f j c z =>
  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (congrArg
        (fun _a =>
          _a ↔
            ∃ s,
              DiamondIntegral.Section8.HeightChains.IsBary s ∧
                (∀ (i : Fin n), z i.castSucc = ∑ m, s m.castSucc * v m i + s (Fin.last (k + 1)) * v j i) ∧
                  z (Fin.last n) = ∑ m, s m.castSucc * f m + s (Fin.last (k + 1)) * c)
        (propext
          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.mem_openSimplex_iff (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.bandVertices v f j c)
            z))))
    (exists_congr fun s =>
      and_congr_right fun x =>
        Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                _a ↔
                  (∀ (i : Fin n), z i.castSucc = ∑ m, s m.castSucc * v m i + s (Fin.last (k + 1)) * v j i) ∧
                    z (Fin.last n) = ∑ m, s m.castSucc * f m + s (Fin.last (k + 1)) * c)
              (propext Fin.forall_fin_succ')))
          (of_eq_true
            (Eq.trans
              (congr
                (congrArg Iff
                  (congr
                    (congrArg And
                      (forall_congr fun i =>
                        congrArg (Eq (z i.castSucc))
                          (Eq.trans
                            (Fin.sum_univ_castSucc fun i_1 =>
                              s i_1 *
                                Fin.snoc (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.lift v f) (Fin.snoc (v j) c) i_1 i.castSucc)
                            (congr
                              (congrArg HAdd.hAdd
                                (Eq.trans
                                  (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl Finset.univ) fun x a =>
                                    congrArg (HMul.hMul (s x.castSucc))
                                      (Eq.trans
                                        (congrFun
                                          (Fin.snoc_castSucc (Fin.snoc (v j) c)
                                            (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.lift v f) x)
                                          i.castSucc)
                                        (Fin.snoc_castSucc (f x) (v x) i)))
                                  (Fin.sum_univ_castSucc fun i_1 => s i_1.castSucc * v i_1 i)))
                              (congrArg (HMul.hMul (s (Fin.last (k + 1))))
                                (Eq.trans
                                  (congrFun (Fin.snoc_last (Fin.snoc (v j) c) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.lift v f))
                                    i.castSucc)
                                  (Fin.snoc_castSucc c (v j) i)))))))
                    (congrArg (Eq (z (Fin.last n)))
                      (Eq.trans
                        (Fin.sum_univ_castSucc fun i =>
                          s i * Fin.snoc (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.lift v f) (Fin.snoc (v j) c) i (Fin.last n))
                        (congr
                          (congrArg HAdd.hAdd
                            (Eq.trans
                              (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl Finset.univ) fun x a =>
                                congrArg (HMul.hMul (s x.castSucc))
                                  (Eq.trans
                                    (congrFun
                                      (Fin.snoc_castSucc (Fin.snoc (v j) c) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.lift v f) x)
                                      (Fin.last n))
                                    (Fin.snoc_last (f x) (v x))))
                              (Fin.sum_univ_castSucc fun i => s i.castSucc * f i)))
                          (congrArg (HMul.hMul (s (Fin.last (k + 1))))
                            (Eq.trans
                              (congrFun (Fin.snoc_last (Fin.snoc (v j) c) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.lift v f))
                                (Fin.last n))
                              (Fin.snoc_last c (v j)))))))))
                (congr
                  (congrArg And
                    (forall_congr fun i =>
                      congrArg (Eq (z i.castSucc))
                        (congrFun' (congrArg HAdd.hAdd (Fin.sum_univ_castSucc fun i_1 => s i_1.castSucc * v i_1 i))
                          (s (Fin.last (k + 1)) * v j i))))
                  (congrArg (Eq (z (Fin.last n)))
                    (congrFun' (congrArg HAdd.hAdd (Fin.sum_univ_castSucc fun i => s i.castSucc * f i))
                      (s (Fin.last (k + 1)) * c)))))
              (iff_self
                ((∀ (i : Fin n),
                    z i.castSucc =
                      ∑ i_1, s i_1.castSucc.castSucc * v i_1.castSucc i + s (Fin.last k).castSucc * v (Fin.last k) i +
                        s (Fin.last (k + 1)) * v j i) ∧
                  z (Fin.last n) =
                    ∑ i, s i.castSucc.castSucc * f i.castSucc + s (Fin.last k).castSucc * f (Fin.last k) +
                      s (Fin.last (k + 1)) * c)))))

@DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.mem_Bands : ∀ {n : ℕ} {N : ℚ}

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.mem_Bands : ∀ {n : ℕ} {N : ℚ}
  (T : DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.Triangulation n (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.box n N))
  (W : (k : T.κ) → Finset (Fin (T.dim k + 1) → ℚ)) {k : T.κ}
  {p : (Fin (T.dim k + 1) → ℚ) × (Fin (T.dim k + 1) → ℚ) × Fin (T.dim k + 1)},
  p ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.Bands T W k ↔
    DiamondIntegral.Section8.HeightChains.Consec (W k) p.1 p.2.1 ∧
      ∀ (i : Fin (T.dim k + 1)), i ≠ p.2.2 → p.1 i = p.2.1 i :=
fun {n} {N} T W {k} {p} =>
  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (congrFun'
        (congrArg Iff
          (Eq.trans DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.mem_Bands._simp_1_2
            (congrFun'
              (congrArg And

                  (congrArg (And (p.1 ∈ W k))

                      (Eq.trans
                        (congrArg (And (p.2.1 ∈ W k)) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.mem_Bands._simp_1_4 p.2.2))
                        (and_true (p.2.1 ∈ W k)))))))
              (DiamondIntegral.Section8.HeightChains.Consec (W k) p.1 p.2.1 ∧
                ∀ (i : Fin (T.dim k + 1)), i ≠ p.2.2 → p.1 i = p.2.1 i))))
        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.HeightChains.Consec (W k) p.1 p.2.1 ∧
          ∀ (i : Fin (T.dim k + 1)), i ≠ p.2.2 → p.1 i = p.2.1 i)))
    { mp := fun h => h.right, mpr := fun h => ⟨⟨h.left.left, h.left.right.left⟩, h⟩ }

@DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.lt_at_of_mem_Bands : ∀ {n : ℕ} {N : ℚ}

  (T : DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.Triangulation n (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.box n N))

  And.casesOn ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.mem_Bands T W).mp hp) fun hc hoff =>

  (∀ (k : T.κ), DiamondIntegral.Section8.HeightChains.IsChainF (W k)) →

    x ≠ a' →

      Sum.casesOn (motive := fun x =>
        Sum.inl w ≠ x →
          Disjoint (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.pieceSet T W k (Sum.inl w))

        a'

          DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.graph_disjoint (T.indep k) (hchain k) w.property w'.property fun h =>

              (congrArg (fun _a => Disjoint (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.pieceSet T W k (Sum.inl w)) _a)

              ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.mem_Bands T W).mp p'.property).left))
        ha)
    (fun p ha =>
      Sum.casesOn (motive := fun x =>
        Sum.inr p ≠ x →
          Disjoint (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.pieceSet T W k (Sum.inr p))
            (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.pieceSet T W k x))
        a'

          Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun _a => Disjoint _a (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.pieceSet T W k (Sum.inl w')))
                (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.pieceSet_inr T W k p)))
            (Disjoint.symm
              (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.graph_band_disjoint (T.indep k) (hchain k) w'.property
                ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.mem_Bands T W).mp p.property).left)))
        (fun p' ha =>
          Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun _a => Disjoint _a (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.pieceSet T W k (Sum.inr p')))
                (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.pieceSet_inr T W k p)))

              (id

                  (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.pieceSet_inr T W k p')))
              (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.band_disjoint (T.indep k) (hchain k)

                ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.mem_Bands T W).mp p'.property).left fun x =>

                        have hlt := DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.lt_at_of_mem_Bands T W p.property;

        ha)
    ha

              ∀ (t : Fin (T.dim k + 1) → ℚ),
                DiamondIntegral.Section8.HeightChains.IsBary t →
                  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.OverBase (T.vert k) t z →
                    SignType.sign (z (Fin.last n) - DiamondIntegral.Section8.HeightChains.ev t u) = s
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.sign_const_on_piece : ∀ {n : ℕ} {N : ℚ}
  (T : DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.Triangulation n (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.box n N))
  (W : (k : T.κ) → Finset (Fin (T.dim k + 1) → ℚ)),
  (∀ (k : T.κ), DiamondIntegral.Section8.HeightChains.IsChainF (W k)) →
    (∀ (k : T.κ), ∀ w ∈ W k, (fun x => -N) ≤ w ∧ w ≤ fun x => N) →
      ∀ (k : T.κ) (a : DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.PieceIdx T W k) (u : Fin (T.dim k + 1) → ℚ),
        u ∈ W k ∨ (u ≤ fun x => -N) ∨ (fun x => N) ≤ u →
          ∃ s,
            ∀ z ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.pieceSet T W k a,
              ∀ (t : Fin (T.dim k + 1) → ℚ),
                DiamondIntegral.Section8.HeightChains.IsBary t →
                  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.OverBase (T.vert k) t z →
                    SignType.sign (z (Fin.last n) - DiamondIntegral.Section8.HeightChains.ev t u) = s :=
fun {n} {N} T W hchain hbd k a u hu =>
  have hcmp := fun w hw =>
    Or.casesOn hu (fun hu => hchain k w hw u hu) fun h =>
      Or.casesOn h (fun hu => Or.inr (LE.le.trans hu (hbd k w hw).left)) fun hu =>
        Or.inl (LE.le.trans (hbd k w hw).right hu);
  Sum.casesOn a
    (fun w =>
      have key := fun z hz t ht hb =>
        Exists.casesOn ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.mem_graph_iff (T.vert k) (↑w) z).mp hz) fun t' h =>
          And.casesOn h fun ht' right =>
            And.casesOn right fun hb' he =>
              Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg (fun _a => z (Fin.last n) = DiamondIntegral.Section8.HeightChains.ev _a ↑w)
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.bary_unique (T.indep k) ht ht' hb hb')))
                he;
      if heq : ↑w = u then
        Exists.intro 0 fun z hz t ht hb =>
          Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun _a => SignType.sign (_a - DiamondIntegral.Section8.HeightChains.ev t u) = 0)
                (key z hz t ht hb)))
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg
                  (fun _a =>
                    SignType.sign
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.HeightChains.ev t _a - DiamondIntegral.Section8.HeightChains.ev t u) =
                      0)
                  heq))
              (Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg (fun _a => SignType.sign _a = 0) (sub_self (DiamondIntegral.Section8.HeightChains.ev t u))))
                (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = 0) sign_zero)) (Eq.refl 0))))
      else
        Or.casesOn (hcmp (↑w) w.property)
          (fun h =>
            Exists.intro (-1) fun z hz t ht hb =>
              Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg (fun _a => SignType.sign (_a - DiamondIntegral.Section8.HeightChains.ev t u) = -1)
                    (key z hz t ht hb)))
                (sign_neg
                  (sub_neg.mpr (DiamondIntegral.Section8.HeightChains.ev_strictMono ht (lt_of_le_of_ne h heq)))))
          fun h =>
          Exists.intro 1 fun z hz t ht hb =>
            Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg (fun _a => SignType.sign (_a - DiamondIntegral.Section8.HeightChains.ev t u) = 1)
                  (key z hz t ht hb)))
              (sign_pos
                (sub_pos.mpr
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section8.HeightChains.ev_strictMono ht (lt_of_le_of_ne h (Ne.symm heq))))))
    fun p =>
    have hc := ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.mem_Bands T W).mp p.property).left;
    have key := fun z hz t ht hb =>
      Exists.casesOn (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => z ∈ _a) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.pieceSet_inr T W k p)) hz)
        fun t' h =>
        And.casesOn h fun ht' right =>
          And.casesOn right fun hb' right =>
            And.casesOn right fun h1 h2 =>
              Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg
                    (fun _a =>
                      DiamondIntegral.Section8.HeightChains.ev _a (↑p).1 < z (Fin.last n) ∧
                        z (Fin.last n) < DiamondIntegral.Section8.HeightChains.ev _a (↑p).2.1)
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.bary_unique (T.indep k) ht ht' hb hb')))
                ⟨h1, h2⟩;
    if h1 : u ≤ (↑p).1 then
      Exists.intro 1 fun z hz t ht hb =>
        have this := (key z hz t ht hb).left;
        sign_pos (sub_pos.mpr (LE.le.trans_lt (DiamondIntegral.Section8.HeightChains.ev_mono ht h1) this))
    else
      if h2 : (↑p).2.1 ≤ u then
        Exists.intro (-1) fun z hz t ht hb =>
          have this := (key z hz t ht hb).right;
          sign_neg (sub_neg.mpr (LT.lt.trans_le this (DiamondIntegral.Section8.HeightChains.ev_mono ht h2)))
      else
        False.elim
          (Or.casesOn hu
            (fun hu =>
              have hfu :=
                Or.casesOn (hchain k (↑p).1 hc.left u hu) (fun h => lt_of_le_of_ne h fun he => h1 (he ▸ le_rfl))
                  fun h => absurd h h1;
              have hug :=
                Or.casesOn (hchain k u hu (↑p).2.1 hc.right.left) (fun h => lt_of_le_of_ne h fun he => h2 (he ▸ le_rfl))
                  fun h => absurd h h2;
              hc.right.right.right u hu ⟨hfu, hug⟩)
            fun h =>
            Or.casesOn h (fun hu => h1 (LE.le.trans hu (hbd k (↑p).1 hc.left).left)) fun hu =>
              h2 (LE.le.trans (hbd k (↑p).2.1 hc.right.left).right hu))
'DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.sign_const_on_piece' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]

      ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxPolynomial.ofLaurent R) a) =

  AddMonoidAlgebra.induction_linear a
    (Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a => (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxPolynomial.integerPart R) _a = 0)
          (map_zero (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxPolynomial.ofLaurent R))))
      (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = 0) (map_zero (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxPolynomial.integerPart R))))
        (Eq.refl 0)))
    (fun x y hx hy =>
      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a => (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxPolynomial.integerPart R) _a = x + y)
            (map_add (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxPolynomial.ofLaurent R) x y)))
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg (fun _a => _a = x + y)
              (map_add (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxPolynomial.integerPart R)
                ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxPolynomial.ofLaurent R) x)
                ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxPolynomial.ofLaurent R) y))))
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg
                (fun _a =>
                  _a +
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxPolynomial.integerPart R)
                        ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxPolynomial.ofLaurent R) y) =
                    x + y)
                hx))
            (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => x + _a = x + y) hy)) (Eq.refl (x + y))))))
    fun n r =>
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg
          (fun _a => (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxPolynomial.integerPart R) _a = AddMonoidAlgebra.single n r)
          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxPolynomial.ofLaurent_single R n r)))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id

        (congrArg (fun _a => (DiamondIntegral.Section8.RationalSeries.daggerFactor A a b).coeff _a = -↑(A ^ a))
          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.RationalSeries.natDegree_daggerFactor A a hb)))
      (id
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg (fun _a => _a = -↑(A ^ a)) (Polynomial.coeff_sub 1 (Polynomial.C ↑(A ^ a) * Polynomial.X ^ b) b)))
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun _a => (Polynomial.coeff 1) b - _a = -↑(A ^ a))
                (Polynomial.coeff_C_mul_X_pow (↑(A ^ a)) b b)))
            (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (_a - if b = b then ↑(A ^ a) else 0) = -↑(A ^ a)) Polynomial.coeff_one))
              (of_eq_true
                (Eq.trans
                  (congrFun'
                    (congrArg Eq
                      (Eq.trans
                        (congr (congrArg HSub.hSub (ite_eq_right_of_eq_false 1 0 (eq_false (LT.lt.ne' hb))))
                          (ite_eq_left_of_eq_true (↑(A ^ a)) 0 (eq_self b)))
                        (zero_sub ↑(A ^ a))))
                    (-↑(A ^ a)))
                  (eq_self (-↑(A ^ a))))))))))

@DiamondIntegral.Section8.RationalSeries.isUnit_leadingCoeff : ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (A : Rˣ)
  {Q : Polynomial R}, Q ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.RationalSeries.daggerDenominators A → IsUnit Q.leadingCoeff
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.RationalSeries.isUnit_leadingCoeff.{u_1} : ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R]
  (A : Rˣ) {Q : Polynomial R},
  Q ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.RationalSeries.daggerDenominators A → IsUnit Q.leadingCoeff :=
fun {R} [CommRing R] A {Q} hQ =>
  Or.casesOn (subsingleton_or_nontrivial R) (fun h => isUnit_of_subsingleton Q.leadingCoeff) fun h =>
    Submonoid.closure_induction
      (fun q hq =>
        Exists.casesOn hq fun a h_1 =>
          Exists.casesOn h_1 fun b h_2 =>
            And.casesOn h_2 fun hb right =>
              Eq.symm right ▸
                Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg (fun _a => IsUnit _a)
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.RationalSeries.leadingCoeff_daggerFactor A a hb)))
                  (IsUnit.neg (Units.isUnit (A ^ a))))
      (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => IsUnit _a) Polynomial.leadingCoeff_one)) isUnit_one)
      (fun p q hx hy hp hq =>
        Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => IsUnit _a) (Polynomial.leadingCoeff_mul' (IsUnit.ne_zero (IsUnit.mul hp hq)))))
          (IsUnit.mul hp hq))
      hQ

@DiamondIntegral.Section8.RationalSeries.HasLimit.unique : ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (A : Rˣ)

  DiamondIntegral.Section8.RationalSeries.HasLimit A φ c →
    DiamondIntegral.Section8.RationalSeries.HasLimit A φ c' → c = c'
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.RationalSeries.HasLimit.unique.{u_1} : ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (A : Rˣ)
  {φ : PowerSeries R} {c c' : R},
  DiamondIntegral.Section8.RationalSeries.HasLimit A φ c →
    DiamondIntegral.Section8.RationalSeries.HasLimit A φ c' → c = c' :=
fun {R} [CommRing R] A {φ} {c c'} h h' =>
  Exists.casesOn h fun P h =>
    Exists.casesOn h fun Q h =>
      And.casesOn h fun hQ right =>
        And.casesOn right fun he right =>
          And.casesOn right fun hd hc =>
            Exists.casesOn h' fun P' h =>
              Exists.casesOn h fun Q' h =>
                And.casesOn h fun hQ' right =>
                  And.casesOn right fun he' right =>
                    And.casesOn right fun hd' hc' =>

                        Polynomial.coe_injective R

                                              (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.mul_pf_right φ (Nat.rawCast 1)
                                                (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsNat.to_raw_eq
                                                  (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_mul (Eq.refl HMul.hMul)
                                                    (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsNat.of_raw (PowerSeries R) 1)
                                                    (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsNat.of_raw (PowerSeries R) 1)
                                                    (Eq.refl 1)))))
                                            (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.mul_zero (↑Q ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * Nat.rawCast 1))
                                            (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.add_pf_add_zero
                                              (↑Q ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * (φ ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * Nat.rawCast 1) + 0)))
                                          (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.zero_mul (φ ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * Nat.rawCast 1 + 0))
                                          (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.add_pf_add_zero
                                            (↑Q ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * (φ ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * Nat.rawCast 1) + 0))))
                                      (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.atom_pf (↑Q') rfl
                                        (Eq.mpr
                                          (id
                                            (congrArg
                                              (fun _a => ↑Q' ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * Nat.rawCast 1 = ↑Q' ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * _a)
                                              (Eq.symm rfl)))
                                          (Eq.refl (↑Q' ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * Nat.rawCast 1))))
                                      (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.add_mul
                                        (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.mul_add
                                          (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.mul_pf_left (↑Q) (Nat.rawCast 1)
                                            (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.mul_pf_left φ (Nat.rawCast 1)
                                              (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.mul_pf_right (↑Q') (Nat.rawCast 1)
                                                (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsNat.to_raw_eq
                                                  (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_mul (Eq.refl HMul.hMul)
                                                    (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsNat.of_raw (PowerSeries R) 1)
                                                    (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsNat.of_raw (PowerSeries R) 1)
                                                    (Eq.refl 1))))))
                                          (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.mul_zero
                                            (↑Q ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * (φ ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * Nat.rawCast 1)))
                                          (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.add_pf_add_zero
                                            (↑Q ^ Nat.rawCast 1 *
                                                (φ ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * (↑Q' ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * Nat.rawCast 1)) +
                                              0)))
                                        (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.zero_mul (↑Q' ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * Nat.rawCast 1 + 0))
                                        (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.add_pf_add_zero

                                        (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.add_mul
                                          (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.mul_add
                                            (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.mul_pf_right φ (Nat.rawCast 1)

                                                (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsNat.to_raw_eq
                                                  (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_mul (Eq.refl HMul.hMul)
                                                    (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsNat.of_raw (PowerSeries R) 1)
                                                    (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsNat.of_raw (PowerSeries R) 1)

                                          (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.zero_mul (φ ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * Nat.rawCast 1 + 0))
                                          (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.add_pf_add_zero
                                            (φ ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * (↑Q' ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * Nat.rawCast 1) + 0))))
                                      (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.atom_pf (↑Q) rfl
                                        (Eq.mpr

                                                  (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_mul (Eq.refl HMul.hMul)

                                          (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.mul_zero

                                          (↑Q ^ Nat.rawCast 1 *
                                              (φ ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * (↑Q' ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * Nat.rawCast 1)) +
                                            0)))))))));
                      have h1 :=
                        Eq.mpr
                          (id
                            (congrArg (fun _a => _a = c * Q.leadingCoeff * Q'.leadingCoeff)
                              (Polynomial.coeff_mul_add_eq_of_natDegree_le hd le_rfl)))

                            (Eq.mpr

                                (congrArg (fun _a => c * Q.leadingCoeff * _a = c * Q.leadingCoeff * Q'.leadingCoeff)

                      have h2 :=
                        Eq.mpr
                          (id
                            (congrArg (fun _a => _a = c' * Q'.leadingCoeff * Q.leadingCoeff)
                              (Polynomial.coeff_mul_add_eq_of_natDegree_le hd' le_rfl)))
                          (Eq.mpr
                            (id
                              (congrArg (fun _a => _a * Q.coeff Q.natDegree = c' * Q'.leadingCoeff * Q.leadingCoeff)
                                hc'))
                            (Eq.mpr
                              (id
                                (congrArg (fun _a => c' * Q'.leadingCoeff * _a = c' * Q'.leadingCoeff * Q.leadingCoeff)
                                  Polynomial.coeff_natDegree))
                              (Eq.refl (c' * Q'.leadingCoeff * Q.leadingCoeff))));
                      have hu :=
                        IsUnit.mul (DiamondIntegral.Section8.RationalSeries.isUnit_leadingCoeff A hQ)
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.RationalSeries.isUnit_leadingCoeff A hQ');

                        (id
                          (Mathlib.Tactic.LinearCombination.eq_of_eq

                                    (add_comm Q.natDegree Q'.natDegree))
                                  (Eq.mp
                                    (congrArg
                                      (fun _a =>
                                        _a.coeff (Q.natDegree + Q'.natDegree) = c * Q.leadingCoeff * Q'.leadingCoeff)

                                          (id
                                            (congrArg

                                      (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.mul_congr
                                        (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.atom_pf Q.leadingCoeff rfl
                                          (Eq.mpr
                                            (id
                                              (congrArg
                                                (fun _a =>
                                                  Q.leadingCoeff ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * Nat.rawCast 1 =
                                                    Q.leadingCoeff ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * _a)
                                                (Eq.symm rfl)))
                                            (Eq.refl (Q.leadingCoeff ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * Nat.rawCast 1))))
                                        (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.atom_pf Q'.leadingCoeff rfl
                                          (Eq.mpr
                                            (id
                                              (congrArg
                                                (fun _a =>
                                                  Q'.leadingCoeff ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * Nat.rawCast 1 =
                                                    Q'.leadingCoeff ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * _a)
                                                (Eq.symm rfl)))
                                            (Eq.refl (Q'.leadingCoeff ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * Nat.rawCast 1))))
                                        (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.add_mul
                                          (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.mul_add
                                            (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.mul_pf_left Q.leadingCoeff (Nat.rawCast 1)
                                              (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.mul_pf_right Q'.leadingCoeff (Nat.rawCast 1)

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.RationalSeries.HasLimit.add.{u_1} : ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (A : Rˣ)

fun {R} [CommRing R] A {φ ψ} {c d} h h' =>
  Or.casesOn (subsingleton_or_nontrivial R)
    (fun hR =>
      Exists.intro 0
        (Exists.intro 1

                  ((c + d) * Polynomial.leadingCoeff 1)⟩⟩⟩))
    fun hR =>

    DiamondIntegral.Section8.IsRationalValue π δ → DiamondIntegral.Section8.IsRationalValue π (γ * δ)
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.IsRationalValue.mul.{u_1} : ∀ {Γ : Type u_1} [inst : CommGroup Γ] {π γ δ : Γ},
  DiamondIntegral.Section8.IsRationalValue π γ →
    DiamondIntegral.Section8.IsRationalValue π δ → DiamondIntegral.Section8.IsRationalValue π (γ * δ) :=

  Exists.casesOn hγ fun n h =>
    And.casesOn h fun hn right =>
      Exists.casesOn right fun z h =>
        Exists.casesOn hδ fun n' h_1 =>
          And.casesOn h_1 fun hn' right =>
            Exists.casesOn right fun z' h' =>
              Exists.intro (n * n')
                ⟨Nat.mul_ne_zero hn hn',

                    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = π ^ (z * ↑n' + z' * ↑n)) (mul_pow γ δ (n * n'))))

                              (id (congrArg (fun _a => (π ^ z) ^ n' * _a = π ^ (z * ↑n' + z' * ↑n)) (pow_mul δ n' n)))
                              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (π ^ z) ^ n' * _a ^ n = π ^ (z * ↑n' + z' * ↑n)) h'))

                                  (id
                                    (congrArg (fun _a => (π ^ z) ^ n' * (π ^ z') ^ n = _a)
                                      (zpow_add π (z * ↑n') (z' * ↑n))))

                                    (id

                                        (zpow_mul π z ↑n')))

                                      (id
                                        (congrArg (fun _a => (π ^ z) ^ n' * (π ^ z') ^ n = (π ^ z) ^ ↑n' * _a)

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.ratValue_eq.{u_1} : ∀ {Γ : Type u_1} [inst : CommGroup Γ] [inst_1 : LinearOrder Γ]

@DiamondIntegral.Section8.ratValue_mul : ∀ {Γ : Type u_1} [inst : CommGroup Γ] [inst_1 : LinearOrder Γ]
  [IsOrderedMonoid Γ] {π : Γ},
  1 < π →
    ∀ {γ δ : Γ},
      DiamondIntegral.Section8.IsRationalValue π γ →
        DiamondIntegral.Section8.IsRationalValue π δ →
          DiamondIntegral.Section8.ratValue π (γ * δ) =
            DiamondIntegral.Section8.ratValue π γ + DiamondIntegral.Section8.ratValue π δ
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.ratValue_mul.{u_1} : ∀ {Γ : Type u_1} [inst : CommGroup Γ] [inst_1 : LinearOrder Γ]
  [IsOrderedMonoid Γ] {π : Γ},
  1 < π →
    ∀ {γ δ : Γ},
      DiamondIntegral.Section8.IsRationalValue π γ →
        DiamondIntegral.Section8.IsRationalValue π δ →
          DiamondIntegral.Section8.ratValue π (γ * δ) =
            DiamondIntegral.Section8.ratValue π γ + DiamondIntegral.Section8.ratValue π δ :=
fun {Γ} [CommGroup Γ] [LinearOrder Γ] [IsOrderedMonoid Γ] {π} hπ {γ δ} hγ hδ =>
  Exists.casesOn hγ fun n h =>
    And.casesOn h fun hn right =>
      Exists.casesOn right fun z h =>
        Exists.casesOn hδ fun n' h_1 =>
          And.casesOn h_1 fun hn' right =>
            Exists.casesOn right fun z' h' =>
              have hmul :=
                Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = π ^ (z * ↑n' + z' * ↑n)) (mul_pow γ δ (n * n'))))

@DiamondIntegral.Section8.ratValue_le_iff : ∀ {Γ : Type u_1} [inst : CommGroup Γ] [inst_1 : LinearOrder Γ]
  [IsOrderedMonoid Γ] {π : Γ},
  1 < π →
    ∀ {γ δ : Γ},
      DiamondIntegral.Section8.IsRationalValue π γ →
        DiamondIntegral.Section8.IsRationalValue π δ →
          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.ratValue π γ ≤ DiamondIntegral.Section8.ratValue π δ ↔ γ ≤ δ)
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.ratValue_le_iff.{u_1} : ∀ {Γ : Type u_1} [inst : CommGroup Γ] [inst_1 : LinearOrder Γ]
  [IsOrderedMonoid Γ] {π : Γ},
  1 < π →
    ∀ {γ δ : Γ},
      DiamondIntegral.Section8.IsRationalValue π γ →
        DiamondIntegral.Section8.IsRationalValue π δ →
          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.ratValue π γ ≤ DiamondIntegral.Section8.ratValue π δ ↔ γ ≤ δ) :=
fun {Γ} [CommGroup Γ] [LinearOrder Γ] [IsOrderedMonoid Γ] {π} hπ {γ δ} hγ hδ =>
  Exists.casesOn hγ fun n h =>
    And.casesOn h fun hn right =>
      Exists.casesOn right fun z h =>
        Exists.casesOn hδ fun n' h_1 =>
          And.casesOn h_1 fun hn' right =>
            Exists.casesOn right fun z' h' =>
              Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg (fun _a => _a ≤ DiamondIntegral.Section8.ratValue π δ ↔ γ ≤ δ)
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.ratValue_eq hπ hn h)))
                (Eq.mpr
                  (id (congrArg (fun _a => ↑z / ↑n ≤ _a ↔ γ ≤ δ) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.ratValue_eq hπ hn' h')))
                  (have hnq := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn);
                  have hn'q := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn');
                  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ↔ γ ≤ δ) (propext (div_le_div_iff₀ hnq hn'q))))
                    (have h1 :=
                      Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = π ^ (z * ↑n')) (pow_mul γ n n')))
                        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ^ n' = π ^ (z * ↑n')) h))
                          (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (π ^ z) ^ n' = _a) (zpow_mul π z ↑n')))
                            (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (π ^ z) ^ n' = _a) (zpow_natCast (π ^ z) n')))
                              (Eq.refl ((π ^ z) ^ n')))));
                    have h2 :=
                      Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => δ ^ _a = π ^ (z' * ↑n)) (mul_comm n n')))
                        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = π ^ (z' * ↑n)) (pow_mul δ n' n)))
                          (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ^ n = π ^ (z' * ↑n)) h'))
                            (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (π ^ z') ^ n = _a) (zpow_mul π z' ↑n)))
                              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (π ^ z') ^ n = _a) (zpow_natCast (π ^ z') n)))
                                (Eq.refl ((π ^ z') ^ n))))));
                    have hpow := Iff.symm (pow_le_pow_iff_left (Nat.mul_ne_zero hn hn'));
                    Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ↑z * ↑n' ≤ ↑z' * ↑n ↔ _a) (propext hpow)))
                      (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ↑z * ↑n' ≤ ↑z' * ↑n ↔ _a ≤ δ ^ (n * n')) h1))
                        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ↑z * ↑n' ≤ ↑z' * ↑n ↔ π ^ (z * ↑n') ≤ _a) h2))
                          (Eq.mpr
                            (id
                              (congrArg (fun _a => ↑z * ↑n' ≤ ↑z' * ↑n ↔ _a)
                                (propext (StrictMono.le_iff_le (zpow_right_strictMono hπ)))))
                            (cast
                              (Eq.symm
                                (congrFun'
                                  (congrArg Iff
                                    (Eq.trans
                                      (congr
                                        (congrArg LE.le
                                          (Eq.trans (congrArg (HMul.hMul ↑z) (Eq.symm (Int.cast_natCast n')))
                                            (Int.cast_mul._simp_1 z ↑n')))
                                        (Eq.trans (congrArg (HMul.hMul ↑z') (Eq.symm (Int.cast_natCast n)))
                                          (Int.cast_mul._simp_1 z' ↑n)))
                                      Int.cast_le._simp_1))
                                  (z * ↑n' ≤ z' * ↑n)))
                              Iff.rfl)))))))

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.inLattice_iff.{u_1} : ∀ {Γ : Type u_1} [inst : CommGroup Γ] [inst_1 : LinearOrder Γ]
  [IsOrderedMonoid Γ] {π : Γ},

      m ≠ 0 →
        ∀ {γ : Γ},

@DiamondIntegral.Section8.finite_lattice_Icc : ∀ {Γ : Type u_1} [inst : CommGroup Γ] [inst_1 : LinearOrder Γ]
  [IsOrderedMonoid Γ] {π : Γ},
  1 < π → ∀ {m : ℕ}, m ≠ 0 → ∀ (a b : ℤ), {γ | DiamondIntegral.Section8.InLattice π m γ ∧ π ^ a ≤ γ ∧ γ ≤ π ^ b}.Finite
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.finite_lattice_Icc.{u_1} : ∀ {Γ : Type u_1} [inst : CommGroup Γ]
  [inst_1 : LinearOrder Γ] [IsOrderedMonoid Γ] {π : Γ},
  1 < π →
    ∀ {m : ℕ}, m ≠ 0 → ∀ (a b : ℤ), {γ | DiamondIntegral.Section8.InLattice π m γ ∧ π ^ a ≤ γ ∧ γ ≤ π ^ b}.Finite :=
fun {Γ} [CommGroup Γ] [LinearOrder Γ] [IsOrderedMonoid Γ] {π} hπ {m} hm a b =>
  have hsub := fun ⦃γ⦄ a_1 =>
    And.casesOn a_1 fun left right =>
      Exists.casesOn left fun z hz =>
        And.casesOn right fun hα hβ =>
          Exists.intro z
            ⟨⟨have this :=
                  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ≤ π ^ z) (zpow_mul π a ↑m)))
                    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ≤ π ^ z) (zpow_natCast (π ^ a) m)))
                      (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (π ^ a) ^ m ≤ _a) (Eq.symm hz))) (pow_le_pow_left' hα m)));
                (StrictMono.le_iff_le (zpow_right_strictMono hπ)).mp this,
                have this :=
                  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => π ^ z ≤ _a) (zpow_mul π b ↑m)))
                    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => π ^ z ≤ _a) (zpow_natCast (π ^ b) m)))
                      (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ≤ (π ^ b) ^ m) (Eq.symm hz))) (pow_le_pow_left' hβ m)));
                (StrictMono.le_iff_le (zpow_right_strictMono hπ)).mp this⟩,
              Eq.symm hz⟩;

    (Set.Finite.preimage (fun ⦃x⦄ a_1 ⦃y⦄ a hxy => StrictMono.injective (pow_left_strictMono hm) hxy)
      (Set.Finite.image (fun z => π ^ z) (Set.finite_Icc (a * ↑m) (b * ↑m))))
    hsub

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.hasLimit_openSimplex_of_generators_rat.{u_1, u_2} : ∀ {R : Type u_1}
  [inst : CommRing R] (A : Rˣ) {n : ℕ} {ι : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {g : ι → Fin n → ℤ}
  {d : ι → ℕ} [Nonempty ι] {w : ι → Fin n → ℚ},
  AffineIndependent ℚ w →
    (∀ (j : ι), 0 < d j) →
      (∀ (j : ι) (i : Fin n), ↑(g j i) = ↑(d j) * w j i) →
        ∀ (a : Fin n → ℚ) (b : ℚ) (wt : (Fin n → ℤ) → ℕ → ℤ),
          (∀ (x : Fin n → ℤ) (m : ℕ),
              (fun i => ↑(x i) / ↑m) ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.openSimplex w →
                ↑(wt x m) = ∑ i, a i * ↑(x i) + b * ↑m) →
            DiamondIntegral.Section8.RationalSeries.HasLimit A
              (DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.latticeSeries A
                (DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.openSimplex w) wt)
              ((-1) ^ Fintype.card ι) :=
fun {R} [CommRing R] A {n} {ι} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {g} {d} [Nonempty ι] {w} hw hd hg a b wt hwt =>
  have hLI := DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.independent_of_affineIndependent hw hd hg;
  have hcone := fun x hx => DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.cone_int hd hg a b wt hwt hx;
  have hPc := fun p hp =>
    Exists.intro p
      ⟨hp,
        Exists.intro 0
          ⟨fun x x_1 => rfl,
            of_eq_true
              (Eq.trans
                (congrArg (Eq p)
                  (Eq.trans
                    (congrArg (HAdd.hAdd p)
                      (Eq.trans
                        (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl Finset.univ) fun x a =>
                          zero_nsmul (DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.gen g d x))
                        Finset.sum_const_zero))
                    (add_zero p)))
                (eq_self p))⟩⟩;
  have hPH := fun p hp => (hcone p (hPc p hp)).left;
  have hgenH := fun j =>
    have h1 :=
      Exists.intro (∑ j, DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.gen g d j)
        ⟨DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.sum_gen_mem,
          Exists.intro (Pi.single j 1)
            ⟨fun x h => absurd (Finset.mem_univ x) h,
              of_eq_true
                (Eq.trans
                  (congrArg
                    (Eq
                      (∑ i, DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.gen g d i +
                        DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.gen g d j))
                    (congrArg (HAdd.hAdd (∑ i, DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.gen g d i))
                      (Eq.trans
                        (Eq.trans
                          (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl Finset.univ) fun x a =>
                            Eq.trans
                              (Eq.trans
                                (congrFun' (congrArg HSMul.hSMul (Pi.single_apply j 1 x))
                                  (DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.gen g d x))
                                (ite_smul (x = j) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.gen g d x) 1 0))
                              (ite_congr (Eq.refl (x = j))
                                (fun a => one_smul ℕ (DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.gen g d x)) fun a =>
                                zero_nsmul (DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.gen g d x)))
                          (Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ j (DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.gen g d)))
                        (ite_eq_left_of_eq_true (DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.gen g d j) 0
                          (Finset.mem_univ._simp_1 j)))))
                  (eq_self
                    (∑ i, DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.gen g d i +
                      DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.gen g d j)))⟩⟩;
    have this :=
      AddSubgroup.sub_mem (DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.intPts a b)
        (hcone
            (∑ i, DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.gen g d i + DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.gen g d j)
            h1).left
        (hPH (∑ j, DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.gen g d j)
          DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.sum_gen_mem);
    Eq.mp
      (congrArg (Membership.mem (DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.intPts a b))
        (add_sub_cancel_left (∑ i, DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.gen g d i)
          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.gen g d j)))
      this;
  let H := DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.intPts a b;
  let PH := Finset.subtype (fun x => x ∈ H) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.parallelepipedFinset g d);
  let vH := fun j =>

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.Triangulation.hasLimit_rat.{u_1} : ∀ {n : ℕ} {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R]
  (A : Rˣ) {D : Set (Fin n → ℚ)} (T : DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.Triangulation n D) (wt : (Fin n → ℤ) → ℕ → ℤ)
  (a : T.κ → Fin n → ℚ) (b : T.κ → ℚ),
  (∀ (k : T.κ) (x : Fin n → ℤ) (m : ℕ),
      (fun i => ↑(x i) / ↑m) ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.openSimplex (T.vert k) →
        ↑(wt x m) = ∑ i, a k i * ↑(x i) + b k * ↑m) →
    DiamondIntegral.Section8.RationalSeries.HasLimit A (DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.latticeSeries A D wt)
      (-↑T.eulerChar) :=
fun {n} {R} [CommRing R] A {D} T wt a b hwt =>
  have h :=
    DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.hasLimit_of_triangulation_rat A (fun k => Fin (T.dim k + 1)) T.vert T.indep
      (fun k k' hkk' => T.disjoint k k' hkk') a b wt hwt;
  have hc :=
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrFun'
          (congrArg Eq
            (Eq.trans
              (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl Finset.univ) fun x a =>
                Eq.trans
                  (Eq.trans (congrArg (HPow.hPow (-1)) (Fintype.card_fin (T.dim x + 1))) (pow_succ (-1) (T.dim x)))
                  (Eq.trans (mul_neg ((-1) ^ T.dim x) 1) (congrArg Neg.neg (mul_one ((-1) ^ T.dim x)))))
              (Finset.sum_neg_distrib fun x => (-1) ^ T.dim x)))
          (-↑(∑ k, (-1) ^ T.dim k))))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (Eq (-∑ x, (-1) ^ T.dim x))
            (congrArg Neg.neg
              (Eq.trans (Int.cast_sum Finset.univ fun x => (-1) ^ T.dim x)
                (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl Finset.univ) fun x a =>
                  Eq.trans (Int.cast_pow (-1) (T.dim x))
                    (congrFun' (congrArg HPow.hPow (Eq.trans (Int.cast_neg 1) (congrArg Neg.neg Int.cast_one)))
                      (T.dim x)))))))
        (Eq.refl (-∑ x, (-1) ^ T.dim x)));
  Eq.mp
    (congrArg
      (fun _a =>
        DiamondIntegral.Section8.RationalSeries.HasLimit A (DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.latticeSeries A D wt)
          _a)
      hc)
    (Eq.mp
      (congrArg
        (fun _a =>
          DiamondIntegral.Section8.RationalSeries.HasLimit A
            (DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.latticeSeries A _a wt)
            (∑ k, (-1) ^ Fintype.card (Fin (T.dim k + 1))))
        T.cover)
      h)

  {d k : ℕ} (g : Fin k → MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ) (f : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ)

      DiamondIntegral.Section8.Remark815.famCodes P g f ↔

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Remark815.mem_famCodes : ∀
  (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient) {d k : ℕ} (g : Fin k → MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ)
  (f : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ) (y : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.VFType)
  (p : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed P.N d 0),
  Sum.elim (fun x => ↑y) (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues p) ∈
      DiamondIntegral.Section8.Remark815.famCodes P g f ↔
    p ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Remark815.fiberSet P g f y :=
fun P {d k} g f y p =>
  have hcode := fun h =>
    SpecialTransformations.Section5.mvPolynomialCode_eq (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.fN P h)
      (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues p) p.1 fun i => rfl;
  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (congrFun'
        (congrArg Iff
          (congrArg
            (And
              (∀ (i : Fin d),
                SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues p (Sum.inl i) ∈
                  SpecialTransformations.Section8.rawOpenBall ↑0 ↑1))
            (congr (congrArg And (forall_congr fun j => congrFun' (congrArg Eq ((fun h => hcode h) (g j))) ↑0))

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Remark815.mem_preimage_iff : ∀
  (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient) {n r : ℕ}
