DiamondIntegral.Section8.Remark815.mem_prod_preimage_iff : ∀
  (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient) {n r n' r' : ℕ}
  (Γ : Set (DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed P.N n r × DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed P.N n' r'))
  (x : Fin n ⊕ Fin r → P.N) (z : Fin n' ⊕ Fin r' → P.N),
  Sum.elim x z ∈
      ((SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r).prod
            (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n' r')).preimage
        Γ ↔
    ∃ p w,
      (p, w) ∈ Γ ∧ SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues p = x ∧ SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues w = z
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Remark815.mem_prod_preimage_iff : ∀
  (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient) {n r n' r' : ℕ}
  (Γ : Set (DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed P.N n r × DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed P.N n' r'))
  (x : Fin n ⊕ Fin r → P.N) (z : Fin n' ⊕ Fin r' → P.N),
  Sum.elim x z ∈
      ((SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r).prod
            (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n' r')).preimage
        Γ ↔
    ∃ p w,
      (p, w) ∈ Γ ∧
        SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues p = x ∧ SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues w = z :=
fun P {n r n' r'} Γ x z =>
  {
    mp := fun a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun w h =>
        And.casesOn (motive := fun x_1 =>
          ((SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r).prod
                    (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n' r')).decode
                ⟨Sum.elim x z, x_1⟩ ∈
              Γ →
            ∃ p w,
              (p, w) ∈ Γ ∧
                SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues p = x ∧ SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues w = z)
          w
          (fun hx hz h =>
            Exists.intro
              ((SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r).decode
                ⟨↑⟨Sum.elim x z, ⟨hx, hz⟩⟩ ∘ Sum.inl,
                  SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Space.prod._proof_3
                    (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r)
                    (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n' r') ⟨Sum.elim x z, ⟨hx, hz⟩⟩⟩)
              (Exists.intro
                ((SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n' r').decode
                  ⟨↑⟨Sum.elim x z, ⟨hx, hz⟩⟩ ∘ Sum.inr,
                    SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Space.prod._proof_4
                      (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r)
                      (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n' r') ⟨Sum.elim x z, ⟨hx, hz⟩⟩⟩)
                ⟨h,
                  ⟨SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_decode ⟨x, hx⟩,
                    SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_decode ⟨z, hz⟩⟩⟩))
          h,
    mpr := fun a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun p h =>
        Exists.casesOn h fun w h =>
          And.casesOn h fun hΓ right =>
            And.casesOn right fun left right =>
              left ▸
                right ▸
                  Exists.intro
                    ⟨SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_mem_domain p,
                      SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_mem_domain w⟩
                    (id
                      (Eq.mpr
                        (id
                          (congrArg
                            (fun _a =>
                              (_a,
                                  (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n' r').decode
                                    ⟨SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues w,
                                      SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_mem_domain w⟩) ∈
                                Γ)
                            (SpecialTransformations.Section4.decode_mixedValues p)))
                        (Eq.mpr
                          (id (congrArg (fun _a => (p, _a) ∈ Γ) (SpecialTransformations.Section4.decode_mixedValues w)))
                          hΓ))) }

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Remark815.rv_coord_definableFun : ∀
  (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient) (S : Set P.N) {ι : Type} [Finite ι] (k : ι),
  Set.DefinableFun SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV S fun w => SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iRv (w k) :=
fun P S {ι} [Finite ι] k =>
  Set.DefinableFun.comp
    (have this := fun m =>
      List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a x =>
        List.finRange (Nat.succ 0) = a →
          Fintype.complete m ≍ x →
            Set.DefinableFun SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV S fun x => (fun w => ![w k]) x m)
        (Fintype.complete m)
        (fun as h =>
          List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
            Eq.ndrec (motive := fun m =>
              ∀ (this : m ∈ Fintype.elems),
                [] ≍ as →
                  this ≍ List.Mem.head as →
                    Set.DefinableFun SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV S fun x => (fun w => ![w k]) x m)
              (fun this tail_eq =>
                Eq.ndrec (motive := fun as =>
                  this ≍ List.Mem.head as →
                    Set.DefinableFun SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV S fun x =>
                      (fun w => ![w k]) x ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl (Nat.succ 0)⟩))
                  (fun h => Set.DefinableFun.proj SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV) (eq_of_heq tail_eq))
              (eq_of_heq head_eq) (Fintype.complete m))
        (fun b {as} a h =>
          List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
            Eq.ndrec (motive := fun b =>
              [] ≍ as →
                Fintype.complete m ≍ List.Mem.tail b a →
                  Set.DefinableFun SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV S fun x => (fun w => ![w k]) x m)
              (fun tail_eq =>
                Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {as} =>
                  ∀ (a : List.Mem m as),
                    Fintype.complete m ≍ List.Mem.tail ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl (Nat.succ 0)⟩) a →
                      Set.DefinableFun SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV S fun x => (fun w => ![w k]) x m)
                  (fun a h =>
                    List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a_1 x =>
                      [] = a_1 →
                        a ≍ x → Set.DefinableFun SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV S fun x => (fun w => ![w k]) x m)
                      a (fun as h => False.elim (noConfusion_of_Nat List.ctorIdx h))
                      (fun b {as} a_1 h => False.elim (noConfusion_of_Nat List.ctorIdx h)) (Eq.refl []) (HEq.refl a))
                  (eq_of_heq tail_eq) a)
              (eq_of_heq head_eq))
        (Eq.refl (List.finRange (Nat.succ 0))) (HEq.refl (Fintype.complete m));
    this)
    (Set.DefinableFun.of_empty (Set.DefinableFun.fun_symbol SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Fn.rvMap))

@DiamondIntegral.Section8.RingDefinable.rdef_zero : ∀ {α : Type} (G : MvPolynomial α ℂ),

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.RingDefinable.rdef_zero : ∀ {α : Type} (G : MvPolynomial α ℂ),
  DiamondIntegral.Section8.RingDefinable.RDef {c | (MvPolynomial.eval c) G = 0} :=
fun {α} G =>
  have h := FirstOrder.Ring.mvPolynomial_zeroLocus_definable {G};
  have h' := Set.Definable.mono h (Set.subset_univ (⋃ p ∈ {G}, ⇑p.coeff '' ↑p.support));
  Eq.mpr
    (eq_of_heq
      ((fun α X X' e'_2 =>
          Eq.casesOn (motive := fun a x =>
            X' = a →
              e'_2 ≍ x → DiamondIntegral.Section8.RingDefinable.RDef X ≍ DiamondIntegral.Section8.RingDefinable.RDef X')
            e'_2
            (fun h =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun X' =>
                ∀ (e_2 : X = X'),
                  e_2 ≍ Eq.refl X →
                    DiamondIntegral.Section8.RingDefinable.RDef X ≍ DiamondIntegral.Section8.RingDefinable.RDef X')
                (fun e_2 h => HEq.refl (DiamondIntegral.Section8.RingDefinable.RDef X)) (Eq.symm h) e'_2)
            (Eq.refl X') (HEq.refl e'_2))
        α {c | (MvPolynomial.eval c) G = 0} (MvPolynomial.zeroLocus ℂ (Ideal.span ↑{G}))
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg (fun _a => {c | (MvPolynomial.eval c) G = 0} = MvPolynomial.zeroLocus ℂ (Ideal.span _a))
              (Finset.coe_singleton G)))
          (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => {c | (MvPolynomial.eval c) G = 0} = _a) (MvPolynomial.zeroLocus_span {G})))
            (Set.ext fun c =>
              of_eq_true
                (Eq.trans
                  (congrArg (Iff ((MvPolynomial.eval c) G = 0))
                    (congrFun'
                      (congrArg Membership.mem
                        (congrArg Set.ofPred
                          (funext fun x =>
                            Eq.trans
                              (forall_congr fun p =>

@DiamondIntegral.Section8.SameType.bijGraph_iff : ∀ {M : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} {X : Set (α → M)}
  {Y : Set (β → M)} {G : Set (α ⊕ β → M)},
  DiamondIntegral.Section8.SameType.BijGraph X Y G ↔
    (∀ (x : α → M) (z : β → M), Sum.elim x z ∈ G → x ∈ X ∧ z ∈ Y) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ X, ∃ z, Sum.elim x z ∈ G) ∧
        (∀ (x : α → M) (z z' : β → M), Sum.elim x z ∈ G → Sum.elim x z' ∈ G → z = z') ∧
          (∀ z ∈ Y, ∃ x, Sum.elim x z ∈ G) ∧ ∀ (x x' : α → M) (z : β → M), Sum.elim x z ∈ G → Sum.elim x' z ∈ G → x = x'

  {X : Set (α → M)} {Y : Set (β → M)} {G : Set (α ⊕ β → M)},
  DiamondIntegral.Section8.SameType.BijGraph X Y G ↔
    (∀ (x : α → M) (z : β → M), Sum.elim x z ∈ G → x ∈ X ∧ z ∈ Y) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ X, ∃ z, Sum.elim x z ∈ G) ∧
        (∀ (x : α → M) (z z' : β → M), Sum.elim x z ∈ G → Sum.elim x z' ∈ G → z = z') ∧
          (∀ z ∈ Y, ∃ x, Sum.elim x z ∈ G) ∧
            ∀ (x x' : α → M) (z : β → M), Sum.elim x z ∈ G → Sum.elim x' z ∈ G → x = x' :=
fun {M} {α} {β} {X} {Y} {G} =>
  id
    (and_congr
      { mp := fun h x z hG => h (Sum.elim x z) hG,
        mpr := fun h u hG =>
          h (u ∘ Sum.inl) (u ∘ Sum.inr) (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ G) (Eq.symm (Sum.elim_comp_inl_inr u))) hG) }
      (and_congr Iff.rfl
        (and_congr
          { mp := fun h x z z' h1 h2 => h (Sum.elim x (Sum.elim z z')) (id h1) (id h2),
            mpr := fun h u h1 h2 => h (u ∘ Sum.inl) ((u ∘ Sum.inr) ∘ Sum.inl) ((u ∘ Sum.inr) ∘ Sum.inr) h1 h2 }
          (and_congr Iff.rfl
            { mp := fun h x x' z h1 h2 => h (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x x') z) (id h1) (id h2),
              mpr := fun h u h1 h2 => h ((u ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl) ((u ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inr) (u ∘ Sum.inr) h1 h2 }))))

    A.Definable L SY →
      A.Definable L SG →
        A.Definable L
          {y |
            DiamondIntegral.Section8.SameType.BijGraph (DiamondIntegral.Section8.SameType.fibre SX y)
              (DiamondIntegral.Section8.SameType.fibre SY y) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.SameType.fibre SG y)} :=

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.SameType.rv_poly_eq : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  (E : Subfield SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.VFType),
  (∀ e ∈ E, e ≠ 0 → SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom e = 1) →
    ∀ (q : Polynomial ↥E) {t t' : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.VFType},
      1 < SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom t →
        DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M t = DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M t' →
          DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (Polynomial.eval₂ E.subtype t q) =
            DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (Polynomial.eval₂ E.subtype t' q) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] E hE q
    {t t'} ht h =>
  if hq : q = 0 then
    Eq.symm hq ▸
      of_eq_true
        (Eq.trans
          (congr
            (congrArg Eq
              (Eq.trans
                (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv.congr_simp M (Polynomial.eval₂ E.subtype t 0) 0
                  (Polynomial.eval₂_zero E.subtype t))
                DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv_zero))
            (Eq.trans
              (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv.congr_simp M (Polynomial.eval₂ E.subtype t' 0) 0
                (Polynomial.eval₂_zero E.subtype t'))
              DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv_zero))
          (eq_self (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rvZero M)))
  else
    Exists.casesOn (SpecialTransformations.Section3.factor_X_nonzero_constant q hq) fun j h_1 =>
      Exists.casesOn h_1 fun q₀ h_2 =>
        And.casesOn h_2 fun left hq0 =>
          Eq.ndrec (motive := fun q =>
            ¬q = 0 →
              DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (Polynomial.eval₂ E.subtype t q) =
                DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (Polynomial.eval₂ E.subtype t' q))
            (fun hq =>
              let c := q₀.coeff 0;
              have hcdef := rfl;
              have hc0 := fun h0 =>
                hq0
                  (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = 0) (Eq.symm (Polynomial.coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero q₀))))
                    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = 0) (Eq.symm hcdef))) (Subtype.ext h0)));

                (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a) (propext Polynomial.X_dvd_iff)))
                  (of_eq_true
                    (Eq.trans
                      (congrFun'
                        (congrArg Eq
                          (Eq.trans
                            (Eq.trans
                              (congrFun'
                                (congrArg DFunLike.coe
                                  (congrArg Polynomial.coeff
                                    (congrArg (HSub.hSub q₀) (congrArg (⇑Polynomial.C) hcdef))))
                                0)
                              (Polynomial.coeff_sub q₀ (Polynomial.C (q₀.coeff 0)) 0))
                            (Eq.trans (congrArg (HSub.hSub (q₀.coeff 0)) Polynomial.coeff_C_zero)
                              (sub_self (q₀.coeff 0)))))
                        0)
                      (eq_self 0))))
                fun r hr =>
                have hq₀ := fun x =>

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.SameType.same_type : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  (E : Subfield SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.VFType),
  (∀ e ∈ E, e ≠ 0 → SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom e = 1) →
    CanonicalStructure.IsCanonical →
      ∀ {C : Set M},
        (∀ c ∈ C, ∀ (h : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iVF c), ⟨c, h⟩ ∈ E) →
          ∀ {m : ℕ} (U : Set (Fin (m + 1) → M)),
            C.Definable SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV U →
              ∀ {t t' : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.VFType},
                1 < SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom t →
                  DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M t = DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M t' →
                    ∀ (ys : Fin m → M),
                      (∀ (j : Fin m), SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iRV (ys j)) →
                        (Fin.cons (↑t) ys ∈ U ↔ Fin.cons (↑t') ys ∈ U) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] E
    hE hc {C} hC {m} U hU {t t'} ht h ys hys =>
  let U' :=
    U ∩
      {z |
        ∀ (i : Fin (m + 1)),
          SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.sortEval
            (SpecialTransformations.Section3.MixedPolynomialSyntax.contextSort i) (z i)};
  have hU' :=
    SpecialTransformations.Section3.raw_definableOver_sorted hc C
      SpecialTransformations.Section3.MixedPolynomialSyntax.contextSort U'
      (Set.Definable.inter hU
        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.SameType.sorted_definable C
          SpecialTransformations.Section3.MixedPolynomialSyntax.contextSort))
      fun z hz => hz.right;
  Exists.casesOn (SpecialTransformations.Section3.DefinableOver.quantifier_free hM hU') fun p h_1 =>
    Exists.casesOn h_1 fun ψ h_2 =>
      And.casesOn h_2 fun hqf right =>
        And.casesOn right fun hws heq =>
          have hsort := fun x i => Fin.cases x.property (fun j => hys j) i;
          have hmem := fun x =>
            have h1 := { mp := fun hx => ⟨hx, hsort x⟩, mpr := fun hx => hx.left };
            Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ↔ ψ.Realize p.values (Fin.cons (↑x) ys)) (propext h1)))
              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => Fin.cons (↑x) ys ∈ _a ↔ ψ.Realize p.values (Fin.cons (↑x) ys)) heq))
                { mp := fun hx => hx.right, mpr := fun hx => ⟨hsort x, hx⟩ });
          Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ↔ Fin.cons (↑t') ys ∈ U) (propext (hmem t))))
            (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ψ.Realize p.values (Fin.cons (↑t) ys) ↔ _a) (propext (hmem t'))))
              (SpecialTransformations.Section3.MixedPolynomialSupport.formula_iff_of_support p E
                (fun i hi => hC (p.values i) (p.mem_base i) hi) ψ hqf hws t t' ys hys fun q x =>
                congrArg Subtype.val (DiamondIntegral.Section8.SameType.rv_poly_eq E hE q ht h)))

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.SameType.same_type_sum : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  (E : Subfield SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.VFType),
  (∀ e ∈ E, e ≠ 0 → SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom e = 1) →
    CanonicalStructure.IsCanonical →
      ∀ {C : Set M},
        (∀ c ∈ C, ∀ (h : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iVF c), ⟨c, h⟩ ∈ E) →
          ∀ {β : Type} [Finite β] (U : Set (Unit ⊕ β → M)),
            C.Definable SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV U →
              ∀ {t t' : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.VFType},
                1 < SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom t →
                  DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M t = DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M t' →
                    ∀ (ys : β → M),
                      (∀ (j : β), SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iRV (ys j)) →
                        (Sum.elim (fun x => ↑t) ys ∈ U ↔ Sum.elim (fun x => ↑t') ys ∈ U) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] E hE hc
    {C} hC {β} [Finite β] U hU {t t'} ht h ys hys =>
  Exists.casesOn (Finite.exists_equiv_fin β) fun m h_1 =>
    Nonempty.casesOn h_1 fun e =>
      let g := Sum.elim (fun x => 0) fun j => (e j).succ;
      have hU' := Set.Definable.preimage_comp g hU;
      have hcomp := fun x =>
        funext fun k =>
          Sum.casesOn k (fun val => Eq.refl ((Fin.cons (↑x) (ys ∘ ⇑e.symm) ∘ g) (Sum.inl val))) fun j =>
            of_eq_true
              (Eq.trans
                (congrFun'
                  (congrArg Eq
                    (Eq.trans (Fin.cons_succ (↑x) (ys ∘ ⇑e.symm) (e j)) (congrArg ys (Equiv.symm_apply_apply e j))))
                  (ys j))
                (eq_self (ys j)));
      have this :=
        DiamondIntegral.Section8.SameType.same_type E hE hc hC ((fun z => z ∘ g) ⁻¹' U) hU' ht h (ys ∘ ⇑e.symm) fun j =>
          hys (e.symm j);
      Eq.mp
        (congr
          (congrArg Iff
            (Eq.trans DiamondIntegral.Section8.SameType.same_type_sum._simp_1_1
              (congrArg (Membership.mem U) ((fun x => hcomp x) t))))
          (Eq.trans DiamondIntegral.Section8.SameType.same_type_sum._simp_1_1
            (congrArg (Membership.mem U) ((fun x => hcomp x) t'))))
        this

  [inst : Fintype ι] {g : ι → Fin n → ℤ} {d : ι → ℕ} {w : ι → Fin n → ℚ},
  AffineIndependent ℚ w →
    (∀ (j : ι), 0 < d j) →
      (∀ (j : ι) (i : Fin n), ↑(g j i) = ↑(d j) * w j i) → DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.Independent g d :=
fun {n} {ι} [Fintype ι] {g} {d} {w} hw hd hg c h1 h2 j =>
  have hz :=
    affineIndependent_iff.mp hw Finset.univ (fun j => c j * ↑(d j)) h1
      (funext fun i =>
        Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrFun'
              (congrArg Eq
                (Eq.trans (Finset.sum_apply i Finset.univ fun c_1 => (c c_1 * ↑(d c_1)) • w c_1)
                  (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl Finset.univ) fun x a => Eq.refl (c x * ↑(d x) * w x i))))

                  (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.mul_congr
                    (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.mul_congr
                      (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.atom_pf (c j) rfl
                        (Eq.mpr
                          (id
                            (congrArg (fun _a => c j ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * Nat.rawCast 1 = c j ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * _a)
                              (Eq.symm rfl)))
                          (Eq.refl (c j ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * Nat.rawCast 1))))
                      (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.atom_pf (↑(d j)) rfl

@DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.parallelepiped_finite : ∀ {n : ℕ} {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι]
  {g : ι → Fin n → ℤ} {d : ι → ℕ}, (DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.parallelepiped g d).Finite
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.parallelepiped_finite.{u_2} : ∀ {n : ℕ} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype ι]
  {g : ι → Fin n → ℤ} {d : ι → ℕ}, (DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.parallelepiped g d).Finite :=
fun {n} {ι} [Fintype ι] {g} {d} =>
  let B := (fun i => ∑ j, |g j i|, ∑ j, ↑(d j));
  Set.Finite.subset (Set.finite_Icc (-B) B) fun ⦃x⦄ a =>
    Exists.casesOn a fun μ h =>
      And.casesOn h fun hx hμ =>
        have h2 :=
          Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => |_a| ≤ ∑ j, ↑(d j)) hx.left))
            (LE.le.trans (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs (fun j => μ j * ↑(d j)) Finset.univ)
              (Finset.sum_le_sum fun j x =>
                Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ≤ ↑(d j)) (abs_mul (μ j) ↑(d j))))
                  (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a * |↑(d j)| ≤ ↑(d j)) (abs_of_pos (hμ j).left)))
                    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => μ j * _a ≤ ↑(d j)) (Nat.abs_cast (d j))))
                      (mul_le_of_le_one_left (Nat.cast_nonneg (d j)) (hμ j).right)))));
        have h1 := fun i =>
          Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => |_a| ≤ ∑ j, |↑(g j i)|) (hx.right i)))
            (LE.le.trans (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs (fun j => μ j * ↑(g j i)) Finset.univ)
              (Finset.sum_le_sum fun j x =>
                Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ≤ |↑(g j i)|) (abs_mul (μ j) ↑(g j i))))
                  (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a * |↑(g j i)| ≤ |↑(g j i)|) (abs_of_pos (hμ j).left)))
                    (mul_le_of_le_one_left (abs_nonneg ↑(g j i)) (hμ j).right))));
        have h2' :=
          cast
            (Eq.trans
              (Eq.trans
                (Eq.trans (congr (congrArg LE.le Int.cast_abs._simp_1) (Nat.cast_sum._simp_1 Finset.univ d))
                  (congrArg (LE.le ↑|x.2|)
                    (Eq.trans (Nat.cast_sum Finset.univ d)
                      (Eq.symm
                        (Eq.trans
                          (Eq.trans (congrArg Int.cast (Nat.cast_sum Finset.univ d))
                            (Int.cast_sum Finset.univ fun x => ↑(d x)))
                          (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl Finset.univ) fun x a => Int.cast_natCast (d x)))))))
                Int.cast_le._simp_1)
              (Eq.symm (congrArg (LE.le |x.2|) (Nat.cast_sum._simp_1 Finset.univ d))))
            h2;
        have h1' := fun i =>
          cast
            (Eq.trans
              (congr (congrArg LE.le Int.cast_abs._simp_1)
                (Eq.trans (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl Finset.univ) fun x a => Int.cast_abs._simp_1)
                  (Int.cast_sum._simp_1 Finset.univ fun x => |g x i|)))
              Int.cast_le._simp_1)
            (h1 i);
        ⟨⟨fun i => (abs_le.mp (h1' i)).left, (abs_le.mp h2').left⟩,
          ⟨fun i => (abs_le.mp (h1' i)).right, (abs_le.mp h2').right⟩⟩

@DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.cone_iff_simplex : ∀ {n : ℕ} {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι]
  {g : ι → Fin n → ℤ} {d : ι → ℕ} {w : ι → Fin n → ℚ},
  (∀ (j : ι), 0 < d j) →
    (∀ (j : ι) (i : Fin n), ↑(g j i) = ↑(d j) * w j i) →
      ∀ (y : Fin n → ℤ) {m : ℕ},
        m ≠ 0 →
          ((∃ c, DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.Rep g d (y, ↑m) c ∧ ∀ (j : ι), 0 < c j) ↔
            (fun i => ↑(y i) / ↑m) ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.openSimplex w)
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.cone_iff_simplex.{u_2} : ∀ {n : ℕ} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype ι]
  {g : ι → Fin n → ℤ} {d : ι → ℕ} {w : ι → Fin n → ℚ},
  (∀ (j : ι), 0 < d j) →
    (∀ (j : ι) (i : Fin n), ↑(g j i) = ↑(d j) * w j i) →
      ∀ (y : Fin n → ℤ) {m : ℕ},
        m ≠ 0 →
          ((∃ c, DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.Rep g d (y, ↑m) c ∧ ∀ (j : ι), 0 < c j) ↔
            (fun i => ↑(y i) / ↑m) ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.openSimplex w) :=
fun {n} {ι} [Fintype ι] {g} {d} {w} hd hg y {m} hm =>
  have hm' := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hm;
  have hmpos := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hm);
  have hdpos := fun j => Nat.cast_pos.mpr (hd j);
  {
    mp := fun a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun c h =>
        And.casesOn h fun left hc =>
          And.casesOn left fun h2 h1 =>
            Exists.intro (fun j => c j * ↑(d j) / ↑m)
              ⟨fun j => div_pos (mul_pos (hc j) (hdpos j)) hmpos,
                ⟨Eq.mpr
                    (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = 1) (Eq.symm (Finset.sum_div Finset.univ (fun j => c j * ↑(d j)) ↑m))))
                    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a / ↑m = 1) (Eq.symm h2)))
                      (Eq.mpr (id (congrFun' (congrArg Eq (congrFun' (congrArg HDiv.hDiv (Int.cast_natCast m)) ↑m)) 1))
                        (div_self hm'))),
                  fun i =>
                  id

                        (id
                          (congrArg (fun _a => _a = ∑ j, c j * ↑(d j) / ↑m * w j i)
                            (Finset.sum_div Finset.univ (fun j => c j * ↑(g j i)) ↑m)))

                            (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.of_eq
                              (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.div_congr
                                (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.mul_congr
                                  (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.atom_pf (c j) rfl
                                    (Eq.mpr
                                      (id
                                        (congrArg
                                          (fun _a => c j ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * Nat.rawCast 1 = c j ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * _a)
                                          (Eq.symm rfl)))
                                      (Eq.refl (c j ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * Nat.rawCast 1))))
                                  (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.mul_congr
                                    (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.atom_pf (↑(d j)) rfl
                                      (Eq.mpr
                                        (id
                                          (congrArg
                                            (fun _a =>
                                              ↑(d j) ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * Nat.rawCast 1 = ↑(d j) ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * _a)
                                            (Eq.symm rfl)))
                                        (Eq.refl (↑(d j) ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * Nat.rawCast 1))))
                                    (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.atom_pf (w j i) rfl
                                      (Eq.mpr
                                        (id
                                          (congrArg
                                            (fun _a =>
                                              w j i ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * Nat.rawCast 1 = w j i ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * _a)
                                            (Eq.symm rfl)))
                                        (Eq.refl (w j i ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * Nat.rawCast 1))))
                                    (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.add_mul
                                      (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.mul_add
                                        (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.mul_pf_left (↑(d j)) (Nat.rawCast 1)

                                            (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsNat.to_raw_eq
                                              (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_mul (Eq.refl HMul.hMul)
                                                (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsNat.of_raw ℚ 1)

                                        (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.mul_zero (↑(d j) ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * Nat.rawCast 1))

                                (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.atom_pf (↑m) rfl
                                  (Eq.mpr
                                    (id

DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.objSpan_mul : ∀ (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient)
  {x y : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVBoundedRing.Ring (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxValues.base P)},
  x ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.objSpan P →
    y ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.objSpan P → x * y ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.objSpan P
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.objSpan_mul : ∀ (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient)
  {x y : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVBoundedRing.Ring (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxValues.base P)},
  x ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.objSpan P →
    y ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.objSpan P → x * y ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.objSpan P :=
fun P {x y} hx hy =>
  AddSubgroup.closure_induction
    (fun x hx =>
      Exists.casesOn hx fun k h =>
        Exists.casesOn h fun a h =>
          Eq.symm h ▸
            AddSubgroup.closure_induction
              (fun y hy =>
                Exists.casesOn hy fun l h =>
                  Exists.casesOn h fun b h =>
                    Eq.symm h ▸
                      Eq.mpr
                        (id
                          (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.objSpan P)
                            (Eq.symm (DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVBoundedRing.objectClass_product a b))))
                        (AddSubgroup.subset_closure
                          (Exists.intro (l + k)
                            (Exists.intro (DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVBoundedCharts.product a b) rfl))))
              (Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.objSpan P)
                    (mul_zero (DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVBoundedRing.objectClass a))))
                (zero_mem (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.objSpan P)))
              (fun y z hx hy hy_1 hz =>
                Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.objSpan P)
                      (mul_add (DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVBoundedRing.objectClass a) y z)))
                  (add_mem hy_1 hz))
              (fun y hx hy =>
                Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.objSpan P)
                      (mul_neg (DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVBoundedRing.objectClass a) y)))
                  (neg_mem hy))
              hy)
    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.objSpan P) (zero_mul y)))
      (zero_mem (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.objSpan P)))
    (fun x z hx hy hx_1 hz =>
      Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.objSpan P) (add_mul x z y))) (add_mem hx_1 hz))
    (fun x hx hx_1 =>
      Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.objSpan P) (neg_mul x y))) (neg_mem hx_1))
    hx

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.eta_integerPart_single.{u_1} : ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (L : Rˣ) (q : ℚ)
  (a : R),
  (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxPolynomial.eta L)

fun {R} [CommRing R] L q a =>
  id
    (if h : ∃ z, ↑z = q then
      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (Eq
              ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxPolynomial.eta L)
                ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxPolynomial.integerPart R) (AddMonoidAlgebra.single q a))))
            (dite_eq_left_of_eq_true (eq_true h))))
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            ((fun a a_1 e_a =>
                Eq.rec (motive := fun a_2 e_a => ∀ (a_3 : R), (a = a_3) = (a_2 = a_3)) (fun a_2 => Eq.refl (a = a_2))
                  e_a)
              ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxPolynomial.eta L)
                ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxPolynomial.integerPart R) (AddMonoidAlgebra.single q a)))
              ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxPolynomial.eta L)

              (Eq.trans
                (congrArg
                  (fun _a =>
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxPolynomial.eta L)
                      ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxPolynomial.integerPart R) (AddMonoidAlgebra.single _a a)))
                  (Eq.symm (Exists.choose_spec h)))
                (Eq.refl
                  ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxPolynomial.eta L)
                    ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxPolynomial.integerPart R)
                      (AddMonoidAlgebra.single (↑h.choose) a)))))
              (a * ↑(L ^ (of_eq_true (eq_true h)).choose))))
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg
                (fun _a =>
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxPolynomial.eta L) _a = a * ↑(L ^ (of_eq_true (eq_true h)).choose))
                (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxPolynomial.integerPart_single_int R h.choose a)))
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg
                  (fun _a => _a (AddMonoidAlgebra.single h.choose a) = a * ↑(L ^ (of_eq_true (eq_true h)).choose))
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxPolynomial.eta.eq_1 L)))
              (Eq.mpr

                    (fun _a =>
                      (LaurentPolynomial.eval₂ (RingHom.id R) L) _a = a * ↑(L ^ (of_eq_true (eq_true h)).choose))

                      (LaurentPolynomial.eval₂_C_mul_T (RingHom.id R) L a h.choose)))
                  (Eq.refl ((RingHom.id R) a * ↑(L ^ h.choose))))))))

      Eq.mpr

            (Eq

  (x y : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVBoundedRing.Ring (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxValues.base P)),
  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.zeta P (x + y) =
    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.zeta P x + DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.zeta P y
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.zeta_add : ∀ (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient)
  (x y : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVBoundedRing.Ring (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxValues.base P)),
  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.zeta P (x + y) =
    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.zeta P x + DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.zeta P y :=
fun P x y =>
  PowerSeries.ext fun m =>
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congr
          (congrArg Eq
            (Eq.trans (PowerSeries.coeff_mk m (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.zetaCoeff P (x + y)))
              (dite_congr (Eq.refl (m = 0)) (fun h => Eq.refl 0) fun h =>
                Eq.trans
                  (congrArg (⇑(DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxPolynomial.eta DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.Lunit))
                    (Eq.trans
                      (congrArg
                        (⇑(DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxPolynomial.integerPart DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.Rloc))
                        (map_add
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.hmLoc P ⟨m, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (Eq.mpr_not (Eq.refl (m = 0)) h)⟩)
                          x y))
                      (map_add (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxPolynomial.integerPart DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.Rloc)
                        ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.hmLoc P ⟨m, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (Eq.mpr_not (Eq.refl (m = 0)) h)⟩)
                          x)
                        ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.hmLoc P ⟨m, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (Eq.mpr_not (Eq.refl (m = 0)) h)⟩)
                          y))))
                  (map_add (DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxPolynomial.eta DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.Lunit)
                    ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxPolynomial.integerPart DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.Rloc)
                      ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.hmLoc P ⟨m, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (Eq.mpr_not (Eq.refl (m = 0)) h)⟩)
                        x))
                    ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxPolynomial.integerPart DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.Rloc)
                      ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.hmLoc P ⟨m, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (Eq.mpr_not (Eq.refl (m = 0)) h)⟩)
                        y))))))
          (Eq.trans
            (map_add (PowerSeries.coeff m) (PowerSeries.mk (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.zetaCoeff P x))
              (PowerSeries.mk (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.zetaCoeff P y)))
            (congr (congrArg HAdd.hAdd (PowerSeries.coeff_mk m (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.zetaCoeff P x)))
              (PowerSeries.coeff_mk m (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.zetaCoeff P y))))))
      (if h : m = 0 then
        Eq.mpr
          (id (congr (congrArg Eq (dite_eq_left h)) (congr (congrArg HAdd.hAdd (dite_eq_left h)) (dite_eq_left h))))
          (of_eq_true (Eq.trans (congrArg (Eq 0) (add_zero 0)) (eq_self 0)))
      else
        Eq.mpr
          (id (congr (congrArg Eq (dite_eq_right h)) (congr (congrArg HAdd.hAdd (dite_eq_right h)) (dite_eq_right h))))
          (of_eq_true
            (eq_self
              ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxPolynomial.eta DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.Lunit)
                  ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.PuiseuxPolynomial.integerPart DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.Rloc)

            _a =

@DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.Triangulation.subset_or_disjoint : ∀ {n : ℕ} {D' D : Set (Fin n → ℚ)}

  {T : DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.Triangulation n D'} {G : List (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.AffFun n)},
  T.Adapted G →
    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.Constructible G D →
      ∀ (k : T.κ),
        DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.openSimplex (T.vert k) ⊆ D ∨
          Disjoint (DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.openSimplex (T.vert k)) D :=
fun {n} {D' D} {T} {G} hT hD k =>
  if h : ∃ x ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.SimplexSeries.openSimplex (T.vert k), x ∈ D then
    Exists.casesOn h fun x h =>
      And.casesOn h fun hx hxD => Or.inl fun y hy => (hD x y fun g hg => hT k g hg x hx y hy).mp hxD
  else Or.inr (Set.disjoint_left.mpr fun x hx hxD => h (Exists.intro x ⟨hx, hxD⟩))

@DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.eulerChar_eq : ∀ {n : ℕ} {D : Set (Fin n → ℚ)}

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.eulerChar_eq : ∀ {n : ℕ} {D : Set (Fin n → ℚ)}
  (T T' : DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.Triangulation n D), T.eulerChar = T'.eulerChar :=
fun {n} {D} T T' =>
  have h :=
    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.Triangulation.hasLimit 1 T (fun x x_1 => 0) (fun x x_1 => 0) (fun x => 0)
      fun k x m a =>
      of_eq_true
        (Eq.trans
          (congrArg (Eq 0)
            (Eq.trans
              (congr
                (congrArg HAdd.hAdd
                  (Eq.trans (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl Finset.univ) fun x_1 a => zero_mul (x x_1))
                    Finset.sum_const_zero))
                (zero_mul ↑m))
              (add_zero 0)))
          (eq_self 0));
  have h' :=
    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Prism.Triangulation.hasLimit 1 T' (fun x x_1 => 0) (fun x x_1 => 0) (fun x => 0)
      fun k x m a =>
      of_eq_true
        (Eq.trans
          (congrArg (Eq 0)
            (Eq.trans
              (congr
                (congrArg HAdd.hAdd
                  (Eq.trans (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl Finset.univ) fun x_1 a => zero_mul (x x_1))
                    Finset.sum_const_zero))
                (zero_mul ↑m))
              (add_zero 0)))
          (eq_self 0));
  have this := DiamondIntegral.Section8.RationalSeries.HasLimit.unique 1 h h';
  Eq.mp neg_inj._simp_1 this

DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.fixed_iff_rational : ∀ (m : ℕ+) (f : DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Ser),
  (DiamondIntegral.Section5.puiseuxRootSystemAction (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Galois.levelRoots m)) f = f ↔
    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.IsRational m f
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.fixed_iff_rational : ∀ (m : ℕ+)
  (f : DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Ser),
  (DiamondIntegral.Section5.puiseuxRootSystemAction (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Galois.levelRoots m)) f = f ↔
    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.IsRational m f :=
fun m f =>
  {
    mp := fun h γ hγ =>
      have h1 := congrArg (fun g => DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf g γ) h;
      have h2 :=
        have this :=
          mul_right_cancel₀ hγ (Eq.trans h1 (Eq.symm (one_mul (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf f γ))));
        this;
      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Galois.char_levelRoots_eq_one_iff m γ).mp (Units.val_eq_one.mp h2),
    mpr := fun h =>
      Subtype.ext
        (HahnSeries.ext
          (funext fun γ =>
            id
              (Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg (fun _a => _a = DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf f γ)
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf_action (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Galois.levelRoots m) f γ)))
                (if hγ : DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf f γ = 0 then
                  Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg
                        (fun _a =>
                          ↑((DiamondIntegral.Section5.compatibleRootCharacter
                                    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Galois.levelRoots m))
                                  (Multiplicative.ofAdd γ)) *
                              _a =
                            _a)
                        hγ))
                    (Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congrArg (fun _a => _a = 0)
                          (mul_zero
                            ↑((DiamondIntegral.Section5.compatibleRootCharacter
                                  (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Galois.levelRoots m))
                                (Multiplicative.ofAdd γ)))))
                      (Eq.refl 0))
                else
                  Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg
                        (fun _a =>
                          ↑_a * DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf f γ = DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf f γ)
                        ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.Galois.char_levelRoots_eq_one_iff m γ).mpr (h γ hγ))))
                    (Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congrArg
                          (fun _a =>
                            _a * DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf f γ =
                              DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf f γ)
                          Units.val_one))
                      (Eq.mpr
                        (id
                          (congrArg (fun _a => _a = DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf f γ)
                            (one_mul (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf f γ))))
                        (Eq.refl (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf f γ)))))))) }

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.labelFixed_iff : ∀ (m : ℕ+)
  (r : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.RV),
  (DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.rvAction (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Galois.levelRoots m)) r = r ↔
    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.LabelRational m r :=
fun m r =>
  Option.casesOn (motive := fun t =>
    r = t →
      ((DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.rvAction (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Galois.levelRoots m)) r = r ↔
        DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.LabelRational m r))
    r

      Eq.symm h ▸
        iff_of_true rfl fun u hu =>
          absurd hu
            (of_eq_true
              (Eq.trans (congrArg Not (eq_false' fun h => False.elim (noConfusion_of_Nat Option.ctorIdx h)))
                not_false_eq_true)))

                  u' = a → Option.some.inj hu' ≍ t → ∃ z, Multiplicative.toAdd u'.1 = ↑z / ↑↑m) (Option.some.inj hu')

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mem_relation_mixed : ∀
  (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient) {n l l' : ℕ}
  (R : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed P.N n l → DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed P.N n l' → Prop)
  (x : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed P.N n l) (y : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed P.N n l'),
  Sum.elim (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues x) (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues y) ∈
      (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n l).relation (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n l')
        R ↔
    R x y :=
fun P {n l l'} R x y =>
  {
    mp := fun a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun hx h =>
        Exists.casesOn h fun hy h =>
          have e1 :=
            have this := rfl;
            Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n l).decode _a = x) this))
              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = x) (SpecialTransformations.Section4.decode_mixedValues x)))
                (Eq.refl x));
          have e2 :=
            have this := rfl;
            Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n l').decode _a = y) this))
              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = y) (SpecialTransformations.Section4.decode_mixedValues y)))
                (Eq.refl y));
          Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => R x _a) e2)
            (Eq.mp
              (congrArg
                (fun _a =>
                  R _a
                    ((SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n l').decode
                      ⟨Sum.elim (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues x)
                            (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues y) ∘
                          Sum.inr,
                        hy⟩))
                e1)
              h),
    mpr := fun h =>
      Exists.intro (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_mem_domain x)
        (Exists.intro (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_mem_domain y)
          (have e1 := SpecialTransformations.Section4.decode_mixedValues x;
          have e2 := SpecialTransformations.Section4.decode_mixedValues y;
          id
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg
                  (fun _a =>
                    R _a
                      ((SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n l').decode
                        ⟨SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues y,
                          SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_mem_domain y⟩))
                  e1))
              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => R x _a) e2)) h)))) }

DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.concrete_image_rational : ∀
  (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient) {n l l' : ℕ}

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.concrete_image_rational : ∀
  (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient) {n l l' : ℕ}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n l) ↑P.G.real}
  {B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n l') ↑P.G.real}
  (f : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map A B) (m : ℕ+)
  (p : (Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Ser) × (Fin l → DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.RV))
  (hp : DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ePoint P p ∈ A.carrier)
  (p' : (Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Ser) × (Fin l' → DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.RV)),
  ↑(f.toFun ⟨DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ePoint P p, hp⟩) = DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ePoint P p' →
    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.RationalPoint m p → DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.RationalPoint m p' :=
fun P {n l l'} {A} {B} f m p hp p' hf hrat =>
  have hmem :=
    id
      (have he :=
        funext fun k =>
          Fin.addCases
            (fun i =>
              of_eq_true
                (Eq.trans
                  (congr
                    (congrArg Eq
                      (congrArg (⇑P.e)
                        (Fin.append_left (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedRaw p)
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedRaw p') i)))
                    (Fin.append_left (⇑P.e ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedRaw p)
                      (⇑P.e ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedRaw p') i))
                  (eq_self (P.e (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedRaw p i)))))
            (fun j =>
              of_eq_true
                (Eq.trans
                  (congr
                    (congrArg Eq
                      (congrArg (⇑P.e)
                        (Fin.append_right (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedRaw p)
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedRaw p') j)))

                      (⇑P.e ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedRaw p') j))

            k;

    funext fun k =>
      Fin.addCases
        (fun i =>
          Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congr
                (congrArg Eq
                  (congrArg
                    (⇑(DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.carrierAction
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Galois.levelRoots m)))

                      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedRaw p') i)))

                  (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedRaw
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.actPoint (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Galois.levelRoots m) p'))
                  i)))
            (have this :=
              congrFun
                (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.act_mixedRaw (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Galois.levelRoots m) p) i;
            Eq.mp
              (congrArg
                (fun _a =>
                  (⇑(DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.carrierAction
                            (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Galois.levelRoots m)) ∘

            (id
              (congr
                (congrArg Eq
                  (congrArg
                    (⇑(DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.carrierAction
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Galois.levelRoots m)))
                    (Fin.append_right (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedRaw p)
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedRaw p') j)))
                (Fin.append_right (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedRaw p)
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedRaw
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.actPoint (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Galois.levelRoots m) p'))
                  j)))
            (congrFun
              (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.act_mixedRaw (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Galois.levelRoots m) p') j))

    (fun hact =>

                      (congrArg (⇑P.e)

  (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient) {n l n' l' : ℕ}
  (R : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed P.N n l → DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed P.N n' l' → Prop)
  (x : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed P.N n l) (y : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed P.N n' l'),
  Sum.elim (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues x) (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues y) ∈
      (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n l).relation (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n' l')
        R ↔
    R x y :=
fun P {n l n' l'} R x y =>
  {
    mp := fun a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun hx h =>
        Exists.casesOn h fun hy h =>
          have e1 :=
            have this := rfl;
            Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n l).decode _a = x) this))
              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = x) (SpecialTransformations.Section4.decode_mixedValues x)))
                (Eq.refl x));
          have e2 :=
            have this := rfl;
            Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n' l').decode _a = y) this))
              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = y) (SpecialTransformations.Section4.decode_mixedValues y)))
                (Eq.refl y));
          Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => R x _a) e2)
            (Eq.mp
              (congrArg
                (fun _a =>
                  R _a
                    ((SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n' l').decode
                      ⟨Sum.elim (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues x)
                            (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues y) ∘
                          Sum.inr,
                        hy⟩))
                e1)
              h),
    mpr := fun h =>
      Exists.intro (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_mem_domain x)
        (Exists.intro (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_mem_domain y)
          (have e1 := SpecialTransformations.Section4.decode_mixedValues x;
          have e2 := SpecialTransformations.Section4.decode_mixedValues y;
          id
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg
                  (fun _a =>
                    R _a
                      ((SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n' l').decode
                        ⟨SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues y,
                          SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_mem_domain y⟩))
                  e1))
              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => R x _a) e2)) h)))) }

def DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.TEq : (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient) →
  {n : ℕ} →
    ℕ+ →
      {r s : ℕ} →
        SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) ↑P.G.real →
          SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n s)
              ↑P.G.real →
            Prop :=

  ∀ (L : ℕ) (b : Fin n → ℕ) (QA : Finset (Fin r → ℤ)) (QB : Finset (Fin s → ℤ))

        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.strace P L A)))
    (hB :
      DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Invariant m b
        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.strace P L B)))
    (hQA :
      DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Covers m QA
        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.strace P L A)))

        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.strace P L B))),

          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.strace P L B)) →
        DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.fullClass m b QA ⋯ hA hQA =
          DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.fullClass m b QB ⋯ hB hQB

DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.teq_trans : ∀ (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient) {n : ℕ}
  (m : ℕ+) {r s t : ℕ}

        DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.TEq P m A B →
          DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.TEq P m B C → DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.TEq P m A C
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.teq_trans : ∀ (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient)
  {n : ℕ} (m : ℕ+) {r s t : ℕ}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) ↑P.G.real}
  {B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n s) ↑P.G.real}
  {C : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n t) ↑P.G.real},
  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Good P m A →
    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Good P m B →
      DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Good P m C →
        DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.TEq P m A B →
          DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.TEq P m B C → DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.TEq P m A C :=
fun P {n} m {r s t} {A} {B} {C} gA gB gC hAB hBC L b QA QC hA hC hQA hQC rA rC =>
  Exists.casesOn gB.low fun N hN =>
    let k := N;
    have hLk := Nat.le_add_left N L;
    Exists.casesOn (gB.cov (L + k)) fun QB hQB =>
      Exists.casesOn
        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.invariant_of_good P m gB (L + k)
          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.bL m b k))
        fun b' h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hbb' hB' =>
          have hA1 :=
            have h := DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.invariant_scale m b k hA;
            Eq.mp
              (congrArg
                (fun _a =>
                  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Invariant m (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.bL m b k) _a)
                (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet_scale_strace P A L k))
              h;
          have hC1 :=
            have h := DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.invariant_scale m b k hC;
            Eq.mp
              (congrArg
                (fun _a =>
                  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Invariant m (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.bL m b k) _a)
                (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet_scale_strace P C L k))
              h;
          have hQA1 :=
            have h := DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.covers_scale m k hQA rA;
            Eq.mp
              (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Covers m QA _a)
                (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet_scale_strace P A L k))
              h;
          have hQC1 :=
            have h := DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.covers_scale m k hQC rC;
            Eq.mp
              (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Covers m QC _a)
                (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet_scale_strace P C L k))
              h;
          have rA1 :=
            have h := DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.rationalIntegral_scale m k rA;
            Eq.mp
              (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.RationalIntegral m _a)
                (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet_scale_strace P A L k))
              h;
          have rC1 :=
            have h := DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.rationalIntegral_scale m k rC;
            Eq.mp
              (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.RationalIntegral m _a)
                (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet_scale_strace P C L k))
              h;
          have hA2 := DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.invariant_mono m hbb' hA1;
          have hC2 := DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.invariant_mono m hbb' hC1;
          have e1 :=
            DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.fullClass_strace_shift P m b A L k QA hA hQA (gA.nz L) rA hA1 hQA1;
          have e2 :=
            DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.fullClass_strace_shift P m b C L k QC hC hQC (gC.nz L) rC hC1 hQC1;
          have e3 :=
            DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.fullClass_strace_mono P m A (L + k) hbb' QA hA1 hA2 hQA1
              (gA.nz (L + k));
          have e4 :=
            DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.fullClass_strace_mono P m C (L + k) hbb' QC hC1 hC2 hQC1
              (gC.nz (L + k));
          have e5 := hAB (L + k) b' QA QB hA2 hB' hQA1 hQB rA1 (hN (L + k) hLk);
          have e6 := hBC (L + k) b' QB QC hB' hC2 hQB hQC1 (hN (L + k) hLk) rC1;
          DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Linv_cancel (n * (↑m * k))
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg
                  (fun _a =>
                    _a =
                      DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.fullClass m b QC
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.strace_definableOver P L C) hC hQC *
                        DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Linv (n * (↑m * k)))
                  (Eq.symm e1)))
              (Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg
                    (fun _a =>
                      DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.fullClass m (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.bL m b k) QA
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.strace_definableOver P (L + k) A) hA1 hQA1 =
                        _a)
                    (Eq.symm e2)))
                (Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg
                      (fun _a =>
                        _a =
                          DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.fullClass m (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.bL m b k)
                            QC (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.strace_definableOver P (L + k) C) hC1 hQC1)
                      (Eq.symm e3)))
                  (Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg
                        (fun _a =>
                          DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.fullClass m b' QA
                              (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.strace_definableOver P (L + k) A) hA2 hQA1 =
                            _a)
                        (Eq.symm e4)))
                    (Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congrArg
                          (fun _a =>
                            _a =
                              DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.fullClass m b' QC
                                (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.strace_definableOver P (L + k) C) hC2 hQC1)
                          e5))
                      (Eq.mpr
                        (id
                          (congrArg
                            (fun _a =>
                              _a =
                                DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.fullClass m b' QC
                                  (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.strace_definableOver P (L + k) C) hC2 hQC1)
                            e6))
                        (Eq.refl
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.fullClass m b' QC
                            (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.strace_definableOver P (L + k) C) hC2 hQC1))))))))

  {n : ℕ} (m : ℕ+) {r s : ℕ}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) ↑P.G.real}
  {B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n s) ↑P.G.real},
  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Good P m A →
    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Good P m B →
      (∀ (L : ℕ) (b0 : Fin n → ℕ),
          ∃ b,
            (∀ (i : Fin n), b0 i ≤ b i) ∧
              ∀ (QA : Finset (Fin r → ℤ)) (QB : Finset (Fin s → ℤ))
                (hA :
                  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Invariant m b
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.strace P L A)))
                (hB :
                  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Invariant m b
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.strace P L B)))
                (hQA :
                  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Covers m QA
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.strace P L A)))
                (hQB :
                  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Covers m QB
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.strace P L B))),
                DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.RationalIntegral m
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.strace P L A)) →
                  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.RationalIntegral m
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.strace P L B)) →
                    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.fullClass m b QA ⋯ hA hQA =
                      DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.fullClass m b QB ⋯ hB hQB) →
        DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.TEq P m A B
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.teq_of_cofinal : ∀
  (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient) {n : ℕ} (m : ℕ+) {r s : ℕ}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) ↑P.G.real}
  {B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n s) ↑P.G.real},
  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Good P m A →
    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Good P m B →
      (∀ (L : ℕ) (b0 : Fin n → ℕ),
          ∃ b,
            (∀ (i : Fin n), b0 i ≤ b i) ∧
              ∀ (QA : Finset (Fin r → ℤ)) (QB : Finset (Fin s → ℤ))
                (hA :
                  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Invariant m b
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.strace P L A)))
                (hB :
                  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Invariant m b
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.strace P L B)))
                (hQA :
                  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Covers m QA
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.strace P L A)))
                (hQB :
                  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Covers m QB
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.strace P L B))),
                DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.RationalIntegral m
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.strace P L A)) →
                  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.RationalIntegral m
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.strace P L B)) →
                    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.fullClass m b QA ⋯ hA hQA =
                      DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.fullClass m b QB ⋯ hB hQB) →
        DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.TEq P m A B :=
fun P {n} m {r s} {A} {B} gA gB h L b0 QA QB hA hB hQA hQB rA rB =>
  Exists.casesOn (h L b0) fun b h =>
    And.casesOn h fun hb heq =>
      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              _a =
                DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.fullClass m b0 QB
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.strace_definableOver P L B) hB hQB)
            (Eq.symm
              (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.fullClass_strace_mono P m A L hb QA hA
                (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.invariant_mono m hb hA) hQA (gA.nz L)))))
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.fullClass m b QA
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.strace_definableOver P L A)
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.invariant_mono m hb hA) hQA =
                  _a)
              (Eq.symm
                (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.fullClass_strace_mono P m B L hb QB hB
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.invariant_mono m hb hB) hQB (gB.nz L)))))
          (heq QA QB (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.invariant_mono m hb hA)
            (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.invariant_mono m hb hB) hQA hQB rA rB))

  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf (x * y) γ ≠ 0 →
    ∃ a b,
      DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf x a ≠ 0 ∧ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf y b ≠ 0 ∧ a + b = γ :=

  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.IsRational m (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mono m j c)
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mono_rational : ∀ (m : ℕ+) (j : ℕ) (c : ℂ),
  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.IsRational m (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mono m j c) :=
fun m j c γ h =>
  if hγ : γ = DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lev m j then
    Exists.intro (↑j)
      (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = ↑↑j / ↑↑m) hγ))
        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = ↑↑j / ↑↑m) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lev.eq_1 m j)))
          (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (Eq (↑j / ↑↑m)) (congrFun' (congrArg HDiv.hDiv (Int.cast_natCast j)) ↑↑m)))
            (Eq.refl (↑j / ↑↑m)))))
  else
    absurd rfl
      (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a ≠ 0) (if_neg hγ))
        (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a ≠ 0) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf_mono m j c γ)) h))

@DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.IsPiecewise : {σ : Type} →
  ℕ+ → ((σ → ℂ) → DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.RV) → Prop
def DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.IsPiecewise : {σ : Type} →
  ℕ+ → ((σ → ℂ) → DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.RV) → Prop :=
fun {σ} m lam =>
  ∃ n D e G,
    (∀ (a : Fin n), DiamondIntegral.Section8.RingDefinable.RDef (D a)) ∧
      (∀ (c : σ → ℂ), ∃ a, c ∈ D a) ∧
        ∀ (a : Fin n),
          ∀ c ∈ D a,

  {A : Set ((Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Ser) × (Fin l → DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.RV))}

  (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient) {k : ℕ} {G : Set (Fin k → P.N)},

        ∀ (j : Fin l),
          ↑q₂ ≤ DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.value (p.2 j) ∧
            DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.value (p.2 j) ≤ ↑q₁
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.label_bounds : ∀
  (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient) {n l : ℕ}
  (B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n l) ↑P.G.real),
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVSupportDoublyBounded B.carrier →
    ∃ q₁ q₂,
      ∀ p ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.traceRaw P B),
        ∀ (j : Fin l),
          ↑q₂ ≤ DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.value (p.2 j) ∧
            DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.value (p.2 j) ≤ ↑q₁ :=
fun P {n l} B hB =>
  let Bc := (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n l).preimage B.carrier;
  let Gup :=
    {y | SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iRV (y 0) ∧ y 0 ≠ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iRVZero} ∩
      ⋂ j,
        {y |
          ∀ w ∈ Bc,
            SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iLe ((fun v => v (Sum.inr (Sum.inr j))) (Sum.elim y w))
              ((fun v => v (Sum.inl 0)) (Sum.elim y w))};
  let Glo :=
    {y | SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iRV (y 0) ∧ y 0 ≠ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iRVZero} ∩
      ⋂ j,
        {y |
          ∀ w ∈ Bc,
            SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iLe ((fun v => v (Sum.inl 0)) (Sum.elim y w))
              ((fun v => v (Sum.inr (Sum.inr j))) (Sum.elim y w))};
  have hGup :=
    Set.Definable.inter DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.nonzeroRV_definable
      (Set.definable_iInter_of_finite fun j =>
        DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.forall_le_definable B.definable (fun v => v (Sum.inr (Sum.inr j)))
          (fun v => v (Sum.inl 0)) (Set.DefinableFun.proj SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV)
          (Set.DefinableFun.proj SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV));
  have hGlo :=
    Set.Definable.inter DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.nonzeroRV_definable
      (Set.definable_iInter_of_finite fun j =>
        DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.forall_le_definable B.definable (fun v => v (Sum.inl 0))
          (fun v => v (Sum.inr (Sum.inr j))) (Set.DefinableFun.proj SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV)
          (Set.DefinableFun.proj SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV));
  Exists.casesOn hB fun γ hγ =>
    Exists.casesOn (SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.EndpointLogic.codeValue_surjective γ) fun a₁ h =>
      And.casesOn h fun ha₁ ha₁γ =>
        Exists.casesOn (SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.EndpointLogic.codeValue_surjective γ⁻¹)
          fun a₂ h =>
          And.casesOn h fun ha₂ ha₂γ =>
            have hneup :=
              Exists.intro (fun x => a₁)
                ⟨⟨ha₁.left, ha₁.right⟩,
                  Set.mem_iInter.mpr fun j w hw =>
                    Exists.casesOn (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.decode_codes P B hw) fun p h =>
                      And.casesOn h fun hp right =>
                        Eq.ndrec (motive := fun w =>
                          w ∈ Bc →
                            SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iLe
                              ((fun v => v (Sum.inr (Sum.inr j))) (Sum.elim (fun x => a₁) w))
                              ((fun v => v (Sum.inl 0)) (Sum.elim (fun x => a₁) w)))
                          (fun hw =>
                            have h1 := (hγ p hp j).right;
                            (SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv_le_iff (p.2 j) ⟨a₁, ha₁.left⟩).mp
                              (Eq.mp
                                (congrArg (fun _a => SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv (p.2 j) ≤ _a)
                                  (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.codeValue_val P ha₁))
                                (Eq.mp
                                  (congrArg (fun _a => SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv (p.2 j) ≤ ↑_a)
                                    (Eq.symm ha₁γ))
                                  h1)))
                          right hw⟩;
            have hnelo :=
              Exists.intro (fun x => a₂)
                ⟨⟨ha₂.left, ha₂.right⟩,

                              (Eq.mp

                (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.e_sort P SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag.rv (c 0)).mp

                      fun h => h trivial)

                fun r hr =>
                have hrz := fun h =>
                  hnz
                    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => P.e _a = SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iRVZero) hr))

                Exists.casesOn (Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.mp hrz) fun u h =>
                  Eq.ndrec (motive := fun r => c 0 = Sum.inr r → r ≠ none → ∃ u, c 0 = Sum.inr (some u))
                    (fun hr hrz => Exists.intro u hr) (Eq.symm h) hr hrz;
            Exists.casesOn (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.concrete_witness P hGup hneup) fun c₁ h =>
              And.casesOn h fun left hall₁ =>
                And.casesOn left fun hrv₁ hnz₁ =>
                  Exists.casesOn (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.concrete_witness P hGlo hnelo) fun c₂ h =>

                            Exists.intro (Multiplicative.toAdd u₁.1)
                              (Exists.intro (Multiplicative.toAdd u₂.1) fun p hp j =>

                                    Set.mem_iInter.mp hall₂ j
                                      (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues
                                        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ePoint P p))

                                    (fun h1 =>

                                        (Eq.mp
                                          (congrArg
                                            (fun _a => SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iLe _a (Sum.inr (p.2 j))) hu₂)
                                          (Eq.mp
                                            (congrArg (fun _a => _a)
                                              (propext
                                                (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.e_iLe P (c₂ 0) (Sum.inr (p.2 j)))))

                                      (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues

      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.strace P L B)) :=
fun P {n l} L B hB =>
  Exists.casesOn (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.label_bounds P B hB) fun q₁ h =>
    Exists.casesOn h fun q₂ h p hp j hj =>
      have this :=
        (h (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.unscaleP L p)
            (Eq.mp
              (congrArg (fun _a => _a)
                (propext
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mem_mixedSet_scale L
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.traceRaw P B) p)))
              hp)
            j).right;
      id
        (fun this =>
          id (fun this => absurd this (not_le.mpr (WithTop.coe_lt_top q₁)))
            (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.value _a ≤ ↑q₁) hj) this))
        this

@DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.patternBox : {l : ℕ} → ℤ → ℤ → Finset (Fin l → ℤ)
def DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.patternBox : {l : ℕ} → ℤ → ℤ → Finset (Fin l → ℤ) :=

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.covers_strace : ∀
  (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient) {n l : ℕ} (m : ℕ+) (L : ℕ)
  (B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n l) ↑P.G.real),
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVSupportDoublyBounded B.carrier →
    ∃ Q,
      DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Covers m Q
        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.strace P L B)) :=
fun P {n l} m L B hB =>
  Exists.casesOn (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.label_bounds P B hB) fun q₁ h =>
    Exists.casesOn h fun q₂ h =>
      Exists.intro (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.patternBox ⌈↑↑m * q₂⌉ ⌊↑↑m * q₁⌋) fun p hp x hu =>
        have hm :=
          cast (Eq.symm (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg LT.lt (Eq.symm Nat.cast_zero)) ↑↑m) Nat.cast_lt._simp_1))
            (PNat.pos m);

          Option.casesOn (motive := fun x =>
            p.2 j = x →
              ∃ z ∈ Finset.Icc ⌈↑↑m * q₂⌉ ⌊↑↑m * q₁⌋,
                x ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Line (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.zlev m z))

DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS_pow : ∀ (x : DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Ser) (k : ℕ),
  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS (x ^ k) = k • DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS x
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS_pow : ∀ (x : DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Ser) (k : ℕ),
  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS (x ^ k) = k • DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS x :=
fun x k =>
  Nat.recAux
    (Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg
          (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS _a = 0 • DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS x)
          (pow_zero x)))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS 1 = _a)
            (zero_smul ℕ (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS x))))
        (id HahnSeries.orderTop_one)))
    (fun k ih =>
      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS _a = (k + 1) • DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS x)
            (pow_succ x k)))
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS (x ^ k * x) = _a)
              (succ_nsmul (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS x) k)))
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg
                (fun _a =>
                  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS (x ^ k * x) =
                    _a + DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS x)
                (Eq.symm ih)))
            (HahnSeries.orderTop_mul ↑(x ^ k) ↑x))))
    k
