theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mem_fullTruncSet_iff : ∀ {n : ℕ} (m : ℕ+) (b : Fin n → ℕ) {k : ℕ}
  (A : Set ((Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Ser) × (Fin k → DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.RV)))
  (r :
    Fin (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Kt b k) →
      CanonicalRV.RVSort DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.Carrier),
  r ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.fullTruncSet m b A ↔
    ∃ p ∈ A, DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.RI m p ∧ r = DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.truncOf m b p :=
fun {n} m b {k} A r =>
  {
    mp := fun a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun p h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hp right =>
          And.casesOn right fun hr right =>
            And.casesOn right fun hu hw =>
              Exists.intro p
                ⟨hp,
                  ⟨⟨hr, hu⟩,
                    funext fun i =>
                      have this := congrFun hw ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.εt b k).symm i);
                      id
                        (Eq.mpr
                          (id
                            (congrArg (fun _a => r i = DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.rvTag _a)
                              (Eq.symm
                                (Eq.mp
                                  (congrFun'
                                    (congrArg Eq
                                      (congrArg (⇑DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.taggedRVEquiv)
                                        (congrArg r
                                          (Equiv.apply_symm_apply (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.εt b k) i))))
                                    (Sum.elim (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.truncPoint m b p.1) p.2
                                      ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.εt b k).symm i)))
                                  this))))
                          (Eq.symm
                            (Equiv.symm_apply_apply DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.taggedRVEquiv (r i))))⟩⟩,
    mpr := fun a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun p h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hp right =>
          And.casesOn right fun left right =>
            And.casesOn left fun hr hu =>
              Eq.symm right ▸
                Exists.intro p
                  ⟨hp,
                    ⟨hr,
                      ⟨hu,
                        funext fun a =>
                          Eq.mpr
                            (id
                              (congrFun'
                                (congrArg Eq
                                  (congrArg (⇑DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.taggedRVEquiv)
                                    (congrArg DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.rvTag
                                      (congrArg (Sum.elim (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.truncPoint m b p.1) p.2)
                                        (Equiv.symm_apply_apply (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.εt b k) a)))))
                                (Sum.elim (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.truncPoint m b p.1) p.2 a)))
                            (Eq.refl
                              (DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.taggedRVEquiv
                                (DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.rvTag
                                  (Sum.elim (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.truncPoint m b p.1) p.2 a))))⟩⟩⟩ }

@DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.card_idx : ∀ {n l : ℕ} (b : Fin n → ℕ),
  Fintype.card (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Idx b ⊕ Fin l) = ∑ i, b i + n + l
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.card_idx : ∀ {n l : ℕ} (b : Fin n → ℕ),
  Fintype.card (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Idx b ⊕ Fin l) = ∑ i, b i + n + l :=
fun {n l} b =>
  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = ∑ i, b i + n + l) Fintype.card_sum))
    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a + Fintype.card (Fin l) = ∑ i, b i + n + l) Fintype.card_sigma))
      (of_eq_true
        (Eq.trans
          (Eq.trans
            (congrFun'
              (congrArg Eq
                (congr
                  (congrArg HAdd.hAdd
                    (Eq.trans
                      (Eq.trans (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl Finset.univ) fun x a => Fintype.card_fin (b x + 1))
                        Finset.sum_add_distrib)
                      (congrArg (HAdd.hAdd (∑ x, b x))
                        (Eq.trans (Finset.sum_const 1)
                          (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg HSMul.hSMul (Fintype.card_fin n)) 1) (mul_one n))))))
                  (Fintype.card_fin l)))
              (∑ x, b x + n + l))
            Nat.add_left_cancel_iff._simp_1)
          (eq_self l))))

  (r : (Fin K → CanonicalRV.RVSort P.N) → (Fin K' → CanonicalRV.RVSort P.N) → Prop) (z : Fin K ⊕ Fin K' → P.N),
  z ∈ (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace K).relation (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace K') r ↔
    ∃ x y,
      r x y ∧
        SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues x = z ∘ Sum.inl ∧
          SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues y = z ∘ Sum.inr :=
fun P {K K'} r z =>
  {
    mp := fun a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun hx h =>
        Exists.casesOn h fun hy h =>
          Exists.intro ((SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace K).decode ⟨z ∘ Sum.inl, hx⟩)
            (Exists.intro ((SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace K').decode ⟨z ∘ Sum.inr, hy⟩)
              ⟨h, ⟨Classical.choose_spec hx, Classical.choose_spec hy⟩⟩),
    mpr := fun a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun x h =>
        Exists.casesOn h fun y h =>
          And.casesOn h fun h right =>
            And.casesOn right fun hx hy =>
              have hx' := Exists.intro x hx;
              have hy' := Exists.intro y hy;
              Exists.intro hx'
                (Exists.intro hy'
                  (have dx :=
                    SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues_injective
                      (Eq.trans (Classical.choose_spec hx') (Eq.symm hx));
                  have dy :=
                    SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues_injective
                      (Eq.trans (Classical.choose_spec hy') (Eq.symm hy));
                  Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg
                        (fun _a => r _a ((SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace K').decode ⟨z ∘ Sum.inr, hy'⟩))
                        dx))
                    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => r x _a) dy)) h))) }

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mem_graphRV_iff : ∀
  (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient) {a b : ℕ}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace a) ↑P.G.real}
  {B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace b) ↑P.G.real}
  (f : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map A B) (x : Fin a → CanonicalRV.RVSort P.N)
  (y : Fin b → CanonicalRV.RVSort P.N),
  Fin.append (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues x) (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues y) ∈
      DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.graphRV P f ↔
    ∃ (h : x ∈ A.carrier), ↑(f.toFun ⟨x, h⟩) = y :=
fun P {a b} {A} {B} f x y =>
  id
    (Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a => _a ↔ ∃ (h : x ∈ A.carrier), ↑(f.toFun ⟨x, h⟩) = y)
          (propext
            (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.rawRV_relation_iff' P (fun x y => ∃ c, ↑c = x ∧ ↑(f.toFun c) = y)
              (Fin.append (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues x) (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues y) ∘
                ⇑finSumFinEquiv)))))
      (have h1 :=
        funext fun i =>
          of_eq_true
            (Eq.trans
              (congrFun'
                (congrArg Eq
                  (Fin.append_left (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues x)
                    (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues y) i))
                (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues x i))
              (eq_self (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues x i)));
      have h2 :=
        funext fun i =>
          of_eq_true
            (Eq.trans
              (congrFun'
                (congrArg Eq
                  (Fin.append_right (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues x)
                    (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues y) i))
                (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues y i))
              (eq_self (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues y i)));
      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              (∃ x_1 y_1,
                  (∃ c, ↑c = x_1 ∧ ↑(f.toFun c) = y_1) ∧
                    SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues x_1 = _a ∧
                      SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues y_1 =
                        (Fin.append (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues x)
                              (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues y) ∘
                            ⇑finSumFinEquiv) ∘
                          Sum.inr) ↔
                ∃ (h : x ∈ A.carrier), ↑(f.toFun ⟨x, h⟩) = y)
            h1))
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                (∃ x_1 y,
                    (∃ c, ↑c = x_1 ∧ ↑(f.toFun c) = y) ∧
                      SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues x_1 = SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues x ∧
                        SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues y = _a) ↔
                  ∃ (h : x ∈ A.carrier), ↑(f.toFun ⟨x, h⟩) = y)
              h2))
          {
            mp := fun a_1 =>
              Exists.casesOn a_1 fun x' h =>
                Exists.casesOn h fun y' h =>
                  And.casesOn h fun left right =>
                    Exists.casesOn left fun c h =>
                      And.casesOn h fun hc hfc =>
                        And.casesOn right fun hx hy =>
                          have ex := SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues_injective hx;
                          have ey := SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues_injective hy;
                          Eq.ndrec (motive := fun x =>
                            (Fin.append (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues x)
                                      (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues y) ∘
                                    ⇑finSumFinEquiv) ∘
                                  Sum.inl =
                                SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues x →
                              (Fin.append (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues x)
                                        (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues y) ∘
                                      ⇑finSumFinEquiv) ∘
                                    Sum.inr =
                                  SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues y →
                                SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues x' =
                                    SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues x →
                                  ∃ (h : x ∈ A.carrier), ↑(f.toFun ⟨x, h⟩) = y)
                            (fun h1 h2 hx =>
                              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun y =>
                                SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues y' =
                                    SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues y →
                                  (Fin.append (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues x')
                                            (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues y) ∘
                                          ⇑finSumFinEquiv) ∘
                                        Sum.inl =
                                      SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues x' →
                                    (Fin.append (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues x')
                                              (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues y) ∘
                                            ⇑finSumFinEquiv) ∘
                                          Sum.inr =
                                        SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues y →
                                      ∃ (h : x' ∈ A.carrier), ↑(f.toFun ⟨x', h⟩) = y)
                                (fun hy h1 h2 =>
                                  Exists.intro (hc ▸ c.property)
                                    (Eq.mpr
                                      (id (congrArg (fun _a => ↑(f.toFun ⟨x', hc ▸ c.property⟩) = _a) (Eq.symm hfc)))
                                      (have this := Subtype.ext (Eq.symm hc);
                                      Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ↑(f.toFun _a) = ↑(f.toFun c)) this))
                                        (Eq.refl ↑(f.toFun c)))))
                                ey hy h1 h2)
                            ex h1 h2 hx,
            mpr := fun a_1 =>
              Exists.casesOn a_1 fun h hf =>
                Exists.intro x (Exists.intro y ⟨Exists.intro ⟨x, h⟩ ⟨rfl, hf⟩, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩) })))

@DiamondIntegral.Section8.NormalForm.eta1 : ∀ {X : Type} (f : Fin 1 → X), f = ![f 0]
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.NormalForm.eta1 : ∀ {X : Type} (f : Fin 1 → X), f = ![f 0] :=
fun {X} f =>
  funext fun i =>
    List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a x => List.finRange 1 = a → Fintype.complete i ≍ x → f i = ![f 0] i)
      (Fintype.complete i)
      (fun as h =>
        List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
          Eq.ndrec (motive := fun i => ∀ (this : i ∈ Fintype.elems), [] ≍ as → this ≍ List.Mem.head as → f i = ![f 0] i)
            (fun this tail_eq =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun as =>
                this ≍ List.Mem.head as →
                  f ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl 1⟩) = ![f 0] ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl 1⟩))
                (fun h => Eq.refl (f ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl 1⟩))) (eq_of_heq tail_eq))
            (eq_of_heq head_eq) (Fintype.complete i))
      (fun b {as} a h =>
        List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
          Eq.ndrec (motive := fun b => [] ≍ as → Fintype.complete i ≍ List.Mem.tail b a → f i = ![f 0] i)
            (fun tail_eq =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {as} =>
                ∀ (a : List.Mem i as),
                  Fintype.complete i ≍ List.Mem.tail ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl 1⟩) a → f i = ![f 0] i)
                (fun a h =>
                  List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a_1 x => [] = a_1 → a ≍ x → f i = ![f 0] i) a
                    (fun as h => False.elim (noConfusion_of_Nat List.ctorIdx h))
                    (fun b {as} a_1 h => False.elim (noConfusion_of_Nat List.ctorIdx h)) (Eq.refl []) (HEq.refl a))
                (eq_of_heq tail_eq) a)
            (eq_of_heq head_eq))
      (Eq.refl (List.finRange 1)) (HEq.refl (Fintype.complete i))

@DiamondIntegral.Section8.NormalForm.qf_formula : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {α : Type} {N : ℕ} (sα : α → SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag)
  (sn : Fin N → SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag) (v : α → M)
  (R : Subring SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.VFType),
  (∀ (a : α), SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.sortEval (sα a) (v a)) →
    (∀ (a : α),
        sα a = SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag.vf →
          ∀ (h : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.sortEval SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag.vf (v a)),
            ⟨v a, h⟩ ∈ R) →
      ∀ (ψ : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.BoundedFormula α N),

@DiamondIntegral.Section8.NormalForm.definable_agree : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.NormalForm.definable_agree : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {N : ℕ} (sn : Fin N → SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag)
  (R : Subring SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.VFType) {A : Set M} {X : Set (Fin N → M)},
  SpecialTransformations.Section3.DefinableOver A sn X →
    (∀ x ∈ A,
        ∀ (h : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.sortEval SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag.vf x), ⟨x, h⟩ ∈ R) →
      ∃ F,
        ∀ (xs xs' : Fin N → M),
          (∀ (i : Fin N), SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.sortEval (sn i) (xs i)) →
            (∀ (i : Fin N), SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.sortEval (sn i) (xs' i)) →
              DiamondIntegral.Section8.NormalForm.Agree sn R F xs xs' → (xs ∈ X ↔ xs' ∈ X) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {N}
    sn R {A} {X} hX hR =>
  Exists.casesOn (SpecialTransformations.Section3.DefinableOver.quantifier_free hM hX) fun p h =>
    Exists.casesOn h fun ψ h =>
      And.casesOn h fun hqf right =>
        And.casesOn right fun hws right =>
          Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {X} =>
            SpecialTransformations.Section3.DefinableOver A sn X →
              ∃ F,
                ∀ (xs xs' : Fin N → M),
                  (∀ (i : Fin N), SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.sortEval (sn i) (xs i)) →
                    (∀ (i : Fin N), SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.sortEval (sn i) (xs' i)) →
                      DiamondIntegral.Section8.NormalForm.Agree sn R F xs xs' → (xs ∈ X ↔ xs' ∈ X))
            (fun hX =>
              Exists.casesOn
                (DiamondIntegral.Section8.NormalForm.qf_formula p.sorts sn p.values R p.sorted
                  (fun a x h => hR (p.values a) (p.mem_base a) h) ψ hqf hws)
                fun F hF =>
                Exists.intro F fun xs xs' hx hx' hA =>
                  id
                    (Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congrArg
                          (fun _a =>
                            (∀ (i : Fin N), SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.sortEval (sn i) (xs i)) ∧ _a ↔
                              (∀ (i : Fin N), SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.sortEval (sn i) (xs' i)) ∧
                                ψ.Realize p.values xs')
                          (propext (hF xs xs' hx hx' hA))))
                      { mp := fun h => ⟨hx', h.right⟩, mpr := fun h => ⟨hx, h.right⟩ }))
            (Eq.symm right) hX

DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.base_rational : ∀ (m : ℕ+) (f : DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Ser),
  DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.baseCarrier (Sum.inl f) → DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.IsRational m f
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.base_rational : ∀ (m : ℕ+) (f : DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Ser),
  DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.baseCarrier (Sum.inl f) →
    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.IsRational m f :=
fun m f hf =>
  Exists.casesOn hf fun g hg γ hγ =>
    have hmem :=
      Exists.intro g
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                (DiamondIntegral.Section5.laurentToRational
                      (Decidable.byContradiction fun a =>
                        DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.base_rational._proof_1_1 a))
                    g =
                  ↑_a)
              (Eq.symm hg)))
          (Eq.refl
            ((DiamondIntegral.Section5.laurentToRational
                (Decidable.byContradiction fun a => DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.base_rational._proof_1_1 a))
              g)));
    Exists.casesOn
      ((DiamondIntegral.Section5.laurentToRational_range_iff
            (Decidable.byContradiction fun a => DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.base_rational._proof_1_1 a) ↑f).mp
        hmem hγ)
      fun z hz =>
      have hz' :=
        Eq.mp
          (congrFun'
            (congrArg Eq
              (congrFun'
                (congrArg DFunLike.coe
                  (AddMonoidHom.mk.congr_simp
                    { toFun := fun z => ↑z / ↑1, map_zero' := DiamondIntegral.Section5.rationalExponentMap._proof_1 1 }
                    { toFun := fun z => ↑z,
                      map_zero' :=
                        (funext fun z => Eq.trans (congrArg (HDiv.hDiv ↑z) Nat.cast_one) (div_one ↑z)) ▸
                          DiamondIntegral.Section5.rationalExponentMap._proof_1 1 }
                    (ZeroHom.mk.congr_simp (fun z => ↑z / ↑1) (fun z => ↑z)
                      (funext fun z => Eq.trans (congrArg (HDiv.hDiv ↑z) Nat.cast_one) (div_one ↑z))
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section5.rationalExponentMap._proof_1 1))
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section5.rationalExponentMap._proof_2 1)))
                z))
            γ)
          hz;
      Exists.intro (z * ↑↑m)
        (have hm :=
          cast (Eq.symm (Eq.trans (congrArg (Ne ↑↑m) (Eq.symm Nat.cast_zero)) (congrArg Not Nat.cast_inj._simp_1)))
            (PNat.ne_zero m);
        Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = ↑(z * ↑↑m) / ↑↑m) (Eq.symm hz')))
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (Eq ↑z)
                (congrFun'
                  (congrArg HDiv.hDiv (Eq.trans (Int.cast_mul z ↑↑m) (congrArg (HMul.hMul ↑z) (Int.cast_natCast ↑m))))
                  ↑↑m)))
            (of_eq_true
              (Eq.trans
                (Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp.eq_eq_cancel_eq
                  (Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp.eq_mul_of_eq_eq_eq_mul rfl
                    (Eq.trans (Eq.trans (Eq.refl ↑z) (Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp.NF.atom_eq_eval ↑z))
                      (Eq.symm
                        (Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp.NF.eval_mul_eval_cons 1 (↑z)

                      (Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp.NF.cons_eq_div_of_eq_div 1 (↑z) (Eq.symm (div_one 1)))

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.RI_join : ∀ {n : ℕ} (m : ℕ+) {k k' : ℕ}
  (p : (Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Ser) × (Fin k → DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.RV))
  (p' : (Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Ser) × (Fin k' → DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.RV)),
  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.RI m (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.joinP p p') ↔
    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.RI m p ∧ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.RI m p' :=
fun {n} m {k k'} p p' =>
  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (congrFun'
        (congrArg Iff
          (congr
            (congrArg And
              (Eq.trans
                (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.RI_join._simp_1_3 fun i =>
                  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.IsRational m (Fin.append p.1 p'.1 i) ∧
                    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.IsIntegral (Fin.append p.1 p'.1 i))
                (congr
                  (congrArg And
                    (forall_congr fun i =>
                      congr
                        (congrArg And
                          (congrArg (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.IsRational m) (Fin.append_left p.1 p'.1 i)))
                        (congrArg DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.IsIntegral (Fin.append_left p.1 p'.1 i))))
                  (forall_congr fun j =>
                    congr
                      (congrArg And
                        (congrArg (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.IsRational m) (Fin.append_right p.1 p'.1 j)))
                      (congrArg DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.IsIntegral (Fin.append_right p.1 p'.1 j))))))
            (Eq.trans
              (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.RI_join._simp_1_3 fun i =>
                DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.LabelRational m (Fin.append p.2 p'.2 i))
              (congr
                (congrArg And
                  (forall_congr fun i =>
                    congrArg (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.LabelRational m) (Fin.append_left p.2 p'.2 i)))
                (forall_congr fun j =>
                  congrArg (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.LabelRational m) (Fin.append_right p.2 p'.2 j))))))
        (((∀ (i : Fin n),
              DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.IsRational m (p.1 i) ∧
                DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.IsIntegral (p.1 i)) ∧
            ∀ (i : Fin k), DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.LabelRational m (p.2 i)) ∧
          (∀ (j : Fin n),
              DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.IsRational m (p'.1 j) ∧
                DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.IsIntegral (p'.1 j)) ∧
            ∀ (j : Fin k'), DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.LabelRational m (p'.2 j))))
    {
      mp := fun a =>
        And.casesOn a fun left right =>
          And.casesOn left fun left right_1 => And.casesOn right fun left_1 right => ⟨⟨left, left_1⟩, ⟨right_1, right⟩⟩,
      mpr := fun a =>
        And.casesOn a fun left right =>
          And.casesOn left fun left right_1 =>
            And.casesOn right fun left_1 right => ⟨⟨left, left_1⟩, ⟨right_1, right⟩⟩ }

  Exists.casesOn
    (Sum.casesOn y

      Exists.intro (Sum.inr ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.εt b k').symm y))
        (of_eq_true

            (congrFun'

    h ▸
      Exists.casesOn (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.shuffle_surjective b y0) fun c h =>
        h ▸
          Exists.intro ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.εt (Fin.append b b) (k + k')) c)

  (z : Fin K → DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.Carrier),
  z ∈ (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace K).preimage A ↔

  {
    mp := fun a =>

@DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.rawRV_relation_iff : ∀ {K K' : ℕ}
  (r :
    (Fin K → CanonicalRV.RVSort DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.Carrier) →
      (Fin K' → CanonicalRV.RVSort DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.Carrier) → Prop)
  (z : Fin K ⊕ Fin K' → DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.Carrier),
  z ∈ (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace K).relation (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace K') r ↔
    ∃ x y,
      r x y ∧
        SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues x = z ∘ Sum.inl ∧
          SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues y = z ∘ Sum.inr
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.rawRV_relation_iff : ∀ {K K' : ℕ}
  (r :
    (Fin K → CanonicalRV.RVSort DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.Carrier) →
      (Fin K' → CanonicalRV.RVSort DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.Carrier) → Prop)
  (z : Fin K ⊕ Fin K' → DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.Carrier),
  z ∈ (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace K).relation (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace K') r ↔
    ∃ x y,
      r x y ∧
        SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues x = z ∘ Sum.inl ∧
          SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues y = z ∘ Sum.inr :=
fun {K K'} r z =>
  {
    mp := fun a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun hx h =>
        Exists.casesOn h fun hy h =>
          Exists.intro ((SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace K).decode ⟨z ∘ Sum.inl, hx⟩)
            (Exists.intro ((SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace K').decode ⟨z ∘ Sum.inr, hy⟩)
              ⟨h, ⟨Classical.choose_spec hx, Classical.choose_spec hy⟩⟩),
    mpr := fun a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun x h =>
        Exists.casesOn h fun y h =>
          And.casesOn h fun h right =>
            And.casesOn right fun hx hy =>
              have hx' := Exists.intro x hx;
              have hy' := Exists.intro y hy;
              Exists.intro hx'
                (Exists.intro hy'
                  (have dx :=
                    SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues_injective
                      (Eq.trans (Classical.choose_spec hx') (Eq.symm hx));
                  have dy :=
                    SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues_injective
                      (Eq.trans (Classical.choose_spec hy') (Eq.symm hy));
                  Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg
                        (fun _a => r _a ((SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace K').decode ⟨z ∘ Sum.inr, hy'⟩))
                        dx))
                    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => r x _a) dy)) h))) }

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.covers_pairs : ∀ {n l l' : ℕ} (m : ℕ+)
  {X : Set (Fin (n + l) → DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.Carrier)}
  {Y : Set (Fin (n + l') → DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.Carrier)} {Q : Finset (Fin l → ℤ)}
  {Q' : Finset (Fin l' → ℤ)},
  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Covers m Q (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet X) →
    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Covers m Q' (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet Y) →
      ∀ {W : Set (Fin (n + n + (l + l')) → DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.Carrier)},
        (∀
            (p :
              (Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Ser) × (Fin l → DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.RV))
            (p' :
              (Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Ser) ×
                (Fin l' → DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.RV)),
            DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.joinP p p' ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet W →
              DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.RI m p →
                DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.RI m p' →
                  p ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet X ∧
                    p' ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet Y) →
          DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Covers m (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.pairPatterns Q Q')
            (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet W) :=
fun {n l l'} m {X} {Y} {Q} {Q'} hQ hQ' {W} hW q hq hr hu =>
  Exists.casesOn
    (Exists.intro (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.leftP q)
      (Exists.intro (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.rightP q)
        (Eq.symm (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.join_left_right q))))
    fun p h =>
    Exists.casesOn h fun p' h =>
      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun q =>
        q ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet W →
          (∀ (i : Fin (n + n)),
              DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.IsRational m (q.1 i) ∧
                DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.IsIntegral (q.1 i)) →
            (∀ (j : Fin (l + l')), DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.LabelRational m (q.2 j)) →
              ∃ q_1 ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.pairPatterns Q Q',
                ∀ (j : Fin (l + l')),
                  q.2 j ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Line (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.zlev m (q_1 j)))
        (fun hq hr hu =>
          And.casesOn ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.RI_join m p p').mp ⟨hr, hu⟩) fun hp hp' =>
            And.casesOn (hW p p' hq hp hp') fun hX hY =>
              Exists.casesOn (hQ p hX hp.left hp.right) fun q1 h =>
                And.casesOn h fun hq1 h1 =>
                  Exists.casesOn (hQ' p' hY hp'.left hp'.right) fun q2 h =>
                    And.casesOn h fun hq2 h2 =>
                      Exists.intro (Fin.append q1 q2)
                        ⟨Finset.mem_image.mpr (Exists.intro (q1, q2) ⟨Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hq1, hq2⟩, rfl⟩), fun j =>
                          Fin.addCases
                            (fun a =>
                              Eq.mpr
                                (id
                                  (congr
                                    (congrArg Membership.mem
                                      (congrArg DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Line
                                        (congrArg (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.zlev m)
                                          (Fin.append_left q1 q2 a))))
                                    (Fin.append_left p.2 p'.2 a)))
                                (h1 a))
                            (fun a =>
                              Eq.mpr
                                (id
                                  (congr
                                    (congrArg Membership.mem
                                      (congrArg DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Line
                                        (congrArg (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.zlev m)
                                          (Fin.append_right q1 q2 a))))
                                    (Fin.append_right p.2 p'.2 a)))
                                (h2 a))
                            j⟩)
        (Eq.symm h) hq hr hu

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.RI_joinG : ∀ {n n' : ℕ} (m : ℕ+) {k k' : ℕ}

      (congrFun'

          (congr
            (congrArg And
              (Eq.trans
                (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.RI_joinG._simp_1_2 fun i =>
                  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.IsRational m (Fin.append p.1 p'.1 i) ∧
                    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.IsIntegral (Fin.append p.1 p'.1 i))
                (congr
                  (congrArg And

                      congr
                        (congrArg And

                  (forall_congr fun i =>
                    congrArg (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.LabelRational m) (Fin.append_left p.2 p'.2 i)))
                (forall_congr fun j =>
                  congrArg (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.LabelRational m) (Fin.append_right p.2 p'.2 j))))))
        (((∀ (i : Fin n),
              DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.IsRational m (p.1 i) ∧
                DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.IsIntegral (p.1 i)) ∧
            ∀ (i : Fin k), DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.LabelRational m (p.2 i)) ∧

DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.zeroExt_graph : ∀
  (X Y : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.DiagonalConstructible.Object) (ι : Fin X.arity → Fin Y.arity)
  (hι : Function.Injective ι)
  (hd :
    ∀ (y : Fin Y.arity → ℂ),
      y ∈ Y.domain ↔ y ∘ ι ∈ X.domain ∧ ∀ (k : Fin Y.arity), (∀ (a : Fin X.arity), ι a ≠ k) → y k = 0),
  DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.framedEquivGraph X.domain Y.domain

          ∀ (k : Fin Y.arity), (∀ (a : Fin X.arity), ι a ≠ k) → z (Fin.natAdd X.arity k) = 0}
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.zeroExt_graph : ∀
  (X Y : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.DiagonalConstructible.Object) (ι : Fin X.arity → Fin Y.arity)
  (hι : Function.Injective ι)
  (hd :
    ∀ (y : Fin Y.arity → ℂ),
      y ∈ Y.domain ↔ y ∘ ι ∈ X.domain ∧ ∀ (k : Fin Y.arity), (∀ (a : Fin X.arity), ι a ≠ k) → y k = 0),
  DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.framedEquivGraph X.domain Y.domain
      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.zeroExtEquiv X Y ι hι hd) =
    {z |
      (fun i => z (Fin.castAdd Y.arity i)) ∈ X.domain ∧
        (∀ (a : Fin X.arity), z (Fin.natAdd X.arity (ι a)) = z (Fin.castAdd Y.arity a)) ∧
          ∀ (k : Fin Y.arity), (∀ (a : Fin X.arity), ι a ≠ k) → z (Fin.natAdd X.arity k) = 0} :=
fun X Y ι hι hd =>
  Set.ext fun z =>
    id
      {
        mp := fun a =>
          Exists.casesOn a fun x h =>
            And.casesOn h fun hx hy =>
              ⟨Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ X.domain) hx)) x.property,
                ⟨fun a =>
                  have h1 := congrFun hy (ι a);
                  have h2 := congrFun hx a;
                  id
                    (fun h1 =>
                      Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = z (Fin.castAdd Y.arity a)) h1))
                        (Eq.mpr
                          (id (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.extZero ι (↑x) (ι a) = _a) h2))
                          (Eq.mpr
                            (id
                              (congrArg (fun _a => _a = ↑x a)
                                (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.extZero_apply hι (↑x) a)))
                            (Eq.refl (↑x a)))))
                    h1,
                  fun k hk =>
                  have h1 := congrFun hy k;
                  id
                    (fun h1 =>
                      Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = 0) h1))
                        (Eq.mpr
                          (id
                            (congrArg (fun _a => _a = 0) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.extZero_off ι (↑x) k hk)))
                          (Eq.refl 0)))
                    h1⟩⟩,
        mpr := fun a =>
          And.casesOn a fun hx right =>
            And.casesOn right fun hι' hz =>
              Exists.intro ⟨fun i => z (Fin.castAdd Y.arity i), hx⟩
                ⟨rfl,
                  funext fun k =>
                    id
                      (if hk : ∃ a, ι a = k then
                        Exists.casesOn hk fun a h =>
                          h ▸
                            Eq.mpr
                              (id
                                (congrArg (fun _a => z (Fin.natAdd X.arity (ι a)) = _a)
                                  (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.extZero_apply hι
                                    (fun i => z (Fin.castAdd Y.arity i)) a)))
                              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = z (Fin.castAdd Y.arity a)) (hι' a)))
                                (Eq.refl (z (Fin.castAdd Y.arity a))))
                      else
                        Eq.mpr
                          (id
                            (congrArg (fun _a => z (Fin.natAdd X.arity k) = _a)
                              (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.extZero_off ι (fun i => z (Fin.castAdd Y.arity i)) k
                                (Eq.mp (Mathlib.Tactic.Push.not_exists._simp_1 fun a => ι a = k) hk))))
                          (Eq.mpr
                            (id
                              (congrArg (fun _a => _a = 0)
                                (hz k (Eq.mp (Mathlib.Tactic.Push.not_exists._simp_1 fun a => ι a = k) hk))))
                            (Eq.refl 0)))⟩ }

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.shiftK_injective : ∀ {n : ℕ} (m : ℕ+) (b : Fin n → ℕ) (L : ℕ),

      DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.shiftK m b L ⟨i, j⟩ = DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.shiftK m b L x →

fun m L {x} hx γ hγ =>
  have h := DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf_tPow_mul L (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.tInv L * x) (γ + ↑L);

@DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.coeffSet_scale : ∀ {n l : ℕ} (m : ℕ+) (b : Fin n → ℕ) (L : ℕ)
  {X : Set (Fin (n + l) → DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.Carrier)} (q : Fin l → ℤ),
  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.RationalIntegral m (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet X) →
    ∀ (c : DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Idx (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.bL m b L) ⊕ Fin l → ℂ),
      c ∈
          DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.coeffSet m (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.bL m b L) q

    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.RationalIntegral m (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet X) →
      DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Covers m Q
        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.scaleRaw L X)) :=

          (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a) (propext (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mem_mixedSet_scale L X p))) hp)

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.truncClass_scale : ∀ {n l : ℕ} (m : ℕ+) (b : Fin n → ℕ) (L : ℕ)
  {X : Set (Fin (n + l) → DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.Carrier)} (q : Fin l → ℤ)
  (hX :
    SpecialTransformations.Section3.DefinableOver {c | DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.baseCarrier c}
      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSorts n l) X),

    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.truncClass m (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.bL m b L) q ⋯ =
      DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.truncClass m b q hX *
        DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Linv (n * (↑m * L)) :=
fun {n l} m b L {X} q hX hlow =>
  let ε := Fintype.equivFin (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Idx b ⊕ Fin l);
  let ε' :=
    Fintype.equivFin (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Idx (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.bL m b L) ⊕ Fin l);

    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.truncObject m (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.bL m b L) q
      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.scaleRaw_definableOver L hX) ε';
  let ι0 := fun a => ε' (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.shiftIdx m b L (ε.symm a));
  have hι0 := fun ⦃a a'⦄ h =>
    have h1 := DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.shiftIdx_injective m b L (Equiv.injective ε' h);
    Equiv.injective ε.symm h1;
  have hd0 := fun y =>
    have hY :=
      DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.truncObject_domain m (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.bL m b L) q

                          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.scaleRaw L X))} ↔

@DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.congr_polyRep : ∀ {n : ℕ} (m : ℕ+) (b : Fin n → ℕ)

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.congr_polyRep : ∀ {n : ℕ} (m : ℕ+) (b : Fin n → ℕ)

      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.polyRep m b fun k =>
        DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf (x k.fst) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lev m ↑k.snd)) :=
fun {n} m b {x} hx i γ hγ =>
  if hlev : ∃ k, γ = DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lev m ↑k then
    Exists.casesOn hlev fun k h =>
      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun γ =>
        γ ≤ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lev m (b i) →

              (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.polyRep m b
                (fun k =>
                  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf (x k.fst) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lev m ↑k.snd))

          Eq.mpr
            (id

                  i k)))

        (Eq.symm h) hγ

    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf (x i) γ = _a)
          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf_polyRep_of_not_level m b

              hlev))))

        Exists.casesOn ((hx i).left γ hne) fun z hz =>
          have hz0 :=
            Decidable.byContradiction fun hneg =>
              have hm :=
                cast (Eq.symm (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg LT.lt (Eq.symm Nat.cast_zero)) ↑↑m) Nat.cast_lt._simp_1))
                  (PNat.pos m);

                        (Eq.trans (congrArg (LT.lt z) (Eq.symm Nat.cast_zero)) (congrArg (LT.lt z) Nat.cast_zero))

                                (congrArg (LT.lt ↑z)
                                  (Eq.trans Nat.cast_zero
                                    (Eq.symm (Eq.trans (congrArg Int.cast Nat.cast_zero) Int.cast_zero))))
                                Int.cast_lt._simp_1))
                            (congrArg (LT.lt z) Nat.cast_zero))))
                      (Eq.mp not_le._simp_1 hneg))
                    hm);
              hne ((hx i).right γ this);
          have hγ' :=
            Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lev m z.toNat) hz))
              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ↑z / ↑↑m = _a) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lev.eq_1 m z.toNat)))
                ((fun {α β γ} [HDiv α β γ] a a_1 e_a =>
                    Eq.rec (motive := fun a_2 e_a => ∀ (a_3 a_4 : β), a_3 = a_4 → a / a_3 = a_2 / a_4)
                      (fun a_2 a_3 e_a => e_a ▸ Eq.refl (a / a_2)) e_a)
                  (↑z) (↑z.toNat)

                    (Eq.symm (Eq.trans (congrArg (Eq ↑z) (Eq.symm (Int.cast_natCast z.toNat))) Int.cast_inj._simp_1))
                    (Eq.symm (Int.toNat_of_nonneg hz0)))
                  (↑↑m) (↑↑m) (Eq.refl ↑↑m)));
          have hle :=
            Decidable.byContradiction fun hgt =>
              absurd (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a ≤ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lev m (b i)) hγ') hγ)

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.truncSet_pattern_eq : ∀ {n l : ℕ} (m : ℕ+) (b : Fin n → ℕ) (q : Fin l → ℤ)

    {w |
        w ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.truncSet m b A ∧
          ∀ (j : Fin l),
            w (Sum.inr j) ∈
              DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Line (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.zlev m (q j))} =
      DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.frameOf m b q '' DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.coeffSet m b q A :=

  Set.ext fun w =>
    {
      mp := fun a =>
        And.casesOn a fun left hline =>
          Exists.casesOn left fun p h =>
            And.casesOn h fun hp right =>
              And.casesOn right fun hr right =>
                And.casesOn right fun hu right =>
                  Eq.ndrec (motive := fun w =>
                    (∀ (j : Fin l),
                        w (Sum.inr j) ∈
                          DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Line (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.zlev m (q j))) →
                      w ∈

                            DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf (p.1 k.fst)

                        ⟨have hlab := funext fun j => DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.coeffRV_lineCoeff (hline j);

                                          DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf (p.1 k.fst)
                                            (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lev m ↑k.snd),
                                        _a) ∈
                                      A)
                                  hlab))
                              (hA p.1
                                (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.polyRep m b fun k =>
                                  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf (p.1 k.fst)
                                    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lev m ↑k.snd))
                                p.2 hp (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.congr_polyRep m b hr))),
                          funext fun a =>
                            Sum.casesOn (motive := fun t =>
                              a = t →
                                DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.frameOf m b q
                                    (Sum.elim
                                      (fun k =>
                                        DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf (p.1 k.fst)

                                      fun j => DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lineCoeff (p.2 j))
                                    a =

                                Eq.symm h ▸

                                      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.coeffRV_eq_linePoint
                                        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lev m ↑k.snd)
                                        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf (p.1 k.fst)
                                          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lev m ↑k.snd)))))
                              (fun j h =>
                                Eq.symm h ▸ id (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.coeffRV_lineCoeff (hline j)))
                              (Eq.refl a)⟩)
                    (Eq.symm right) hline,
      mpr := fun a =>
        Exists.casesOn a fun c h =>
          And.casesOn h fun hc right =>
            right ▸

                  (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.coeffRV_mem_line

                                      (c ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.stdPoint b).var (Fin.castAdd l i) k)))
                                  (b i + 1)))))
                          (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k x =>
                            have hk := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp k.isLt;
                            of_eq_true

@DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.truncation_definable : ∀ {n l : ℕ} (m : ℕ+) (b : Fin n → ℕ) (q : Fin l → ℤ)
  {X : Set (Fin (n + l) → DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.Carrier)},
  SpecialTransformations.Section3.DefinableOver {c | DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.baseCarrier c}
      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSorts n l) X →
    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Invariant m b (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet X) →
      ∀ {K : ℕ} (ε : DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Idx b ⊕ Fin l ≃ Fin K),
        ∃ D,
          ∀ (r : Fin K → CanonicalRV.RVSort DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.Carrier),
            r ∈ D.carrier ↔
              (fun a => DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.taggedRVEquiv (r (ε a))) ∈
                {w |
                  w ∈
                      DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.truncSet m b
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet X) ∧
                    ∀ (j : Fin l),
                      w (Sum.inr j) ∈
                        DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Line (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.zlev m (q j))}
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.truncation_definable : ∀ {n l : ℕ} (m : ℕ+) (b : Fin n → ℕ) (q : Fin l → ℤ)
  {X : Set (Fin (n + l) → DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.Carrier)},
  SpecialTransformations.Section3.DefinableOver {c | DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.baseCarrier c}
      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSorts n l) X →
    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Invariant m b (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet X) →
      ∀ {K : ℕ} (ε : DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Idx b ⊕ Fin l ≃ Fin K),
        ∃ D,
          ∀ (r : Fin K → CanonicalRV.RVSort DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.Carrier),
            r ∈ D.carrier ↔
              (fun a => DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.taggedRVEquiv (r (ε a))) ∈
                {w |
                  w ∈
                      DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.truncSet m b
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet X) ∧
                    ∀ (j : Fin l),
                      w (Sum.inr j) ∈
                        DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Line (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.zlev m (q j))} :=
fun {n l} m b q {X} hX hA {K} ε =>
  have hdef :=
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a => Set.univ.Definable FirstOrder.Language.ring {x | x ∘ ⇑ε ∈ _a})
          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.coeffSet_eq m b q X)))
      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.truncObject m b q hX ε).definable;
  have hinv :=
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg
          (fun _a =>
            DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.RationalInvariant
              (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.stdWt m b q ∘ ⇑ε.symm) {x | x ∘ ⇑ε ∈ _a})
          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.coeffSet_eq m b q X)))
      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.truncObject m b q hX ε).invariant;
  Exists.intro
    (DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.rationalDescendedSet
      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.stdWt m b q ∘ ⇑ε.symm)
      {x | x ∘ ⇑ε ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.coeffSet m b q (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet X)}
      hdef)
    fun r =>
    Iff.trans
      (DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.rationalDescent_mem_image
        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.stdWt m b q ∘ ⇑ε.symm)
        {x |
          x ∘ ⇑ε ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.coeffSet m b q (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet X)}
        hdef hinv r)
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              (∃
                  x ∈
                    {x |
                      x ∘ ⇑ε ∈
                        DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.coeffSet m b q
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet X)},
                  DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.rationalFrame
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.stdWt m b q ∘ ⇑ε.symm) x =
                    r) ↔
                (fun a => DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.taggedRVEquiv (r (ε a))) ∈ _a)
            (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.truncSet_pattern_eq m b q
              (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet X) hA)))
        (have hframe := fun x =>
          funext fun a =>
            Sum.casesOn (motive := fun t =>
              a = t →
                DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.taggedRVEquiv
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.rationalFrame
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.stdWt m b q ∘ ⇑ε.symm) x (ε a)) =
                  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.frameOf m b q (x ∘ ⇑ε) a)
              a
              (fun k h =>
                Eq.symm h ▸
                  id
                    (Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congrArg
                          (fun _a =>
                            DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.linePoint
                                (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.stdWt m b q _a) (x (ε (Sum.inl k))) =
                              DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.frameOf m b q (x ∘ ⇑ε) (Sum.inl k))
                          (Equiv.symm_apply_apply ε (Sum.inl k))))
                      (Eq.refl
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.linePoint
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.stdWt m b q (Sum.inl k)) (x (ε (Sum.inl k)))))))
              (fun j h =>
                Eq.symm h ▸
                  id
                    (Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congrArg
                          (fun _a =>
                            DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.linePoint
                                (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.stdWt m b q _a) (x (ε (Sum.inr j))) =
                              DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.frameOf m b q (x ∘ ⇑ε) (Sum.inr j))
                          (Equiv.symm_apply_apply ε (Sum.inr j))))
                      (Eq.refl
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.linePoint
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.stdWt m b q (Sum.inr j)) (x (ε (Sum.inr j)))))))
              (Eq.refl a);
        {
          mp := fun a =>
            Exists.casesOn a fun x h =>
              And.casesOn h fun hx right =>
                right ▸
                  Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg
                        (fun _a =>
                          _a ∈
                            DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.frameOf m b q ''
                              DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.coeffSet m b q
                                (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet X))
                        (hframe x)))
                    (Exists.intro (x ∘ ⇑ε) ⟨hx, rfl⟩),
          mpr := fun a =>
            Exists.casesOn a fun c h =>
              And.casesOn h fun hc he =>
                have hcomp :=
                  funext fun a =>
                    of_eq_true
                      (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg Eq (congrArg c (Equiv.symm_apply_apply ε a))) (c a))
                        (eq_self (c a)));
                Exists.intro (c ∘ ⇑ε.symm)
                  ⟨id
                      (Eq.mpr
                        (id
                          (congrArg
                            (fun _a =>
                              _a ∈
                                DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.coeffSet m b q
                                  (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet X))
                            hcomp))
                        hc),
                    have h1 := hframe (c ∘ ⇑ε.symm);
                    funext fun i =>
                      have h2 :=
                        congrFun
                          (Eq.mp
                            (congrArg
                              (fun _a =>
                                (fun a =>
                                    DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.taggedRVEquiv
                                      (DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.rationalFrame
                                        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.stdWt m b q ∘ ⇑ε.symm) (c ∘ ⇑ε.symm)
                                        (ε a))) =
                                  _a)
                              he)
                            (Eq.mp
                              (congrArg
                                (fun _a =>
                                  (fun a =>
                                      DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.taggedRVEquiv
                                        (DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.rationalFrame
                                          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.stdWt m b q ∘ ⇑ε.symm) (c ∘ ⇑ε.symm)
                                          (ε a))) =
                                    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.frameOf m b q _a)
                                hcomp)
                              h1))
                          (ε.symm i);
                      Equiv.injective DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.taggedRVEquiv
                        (Eq.mp
                          (congr
                            (congrArg Eq
                              (congrArg (⇑DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.taggedRVEquiv)
                                (congrArg
                                  (DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.rationalFrame

@DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.congrS_iff_congrV : ∀ {n : ℕ} (m : ℕ+) (b : Fin n → ℕ) (L : ℕ)
  (x x' : Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Ser),
  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.CongrS m b x x' ↔
    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.CongrV m b L (fun i => DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.tInv L * x i)
      fun i => DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.tInv L * x' i
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.congrS_iff_congrV : ∀ {n : ℕ} (m : ℕ+) (b : Fin n → ℕ) (L : ℕ)
  (x x' : Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Ser),
  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.CongrS m b x x' ↔
    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.CongrV m b L (fun i => DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.tInv L * x i)
      fun i => DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.tInv L * x' i :=
fun {n} m b L x x' =>
  forall_congr' fun i =>
    have he :=
      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a => x i - x' i = _a)
            (mul_sub (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.tPow L) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.tInv L * x i)
              (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.tInv L * x' i))))
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                x i - x' i =
                  _a - DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.tPow L * (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.tInv L * x' i))
              (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.tPow_mul_tInv L (x i))))
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun _a => x i - x' i = x i - _a) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.tPow_mul_tInv L (x' i))))
            (Eq.refl (x i - x' i))));
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg
          (fun _a =>
            ↑(DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lev m (b i)) < DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS _a ↔
              ↑(DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lev m (b i) - ↑L) <
                DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS
                  ((fun i => DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.tInv L * x i) i -
                    (fun i => DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.tInv L * x' i) i))
          he))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              _a ↔
                ↑(DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lev m (b i) - ↑L) <
                  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS
                    ((fun i => DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.tInv L * x i) i -
                      (fun i => DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.tInv L * x' i) i))
            (propext
              (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lt_ordS_tPow_mul L (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lev m (b i))
                (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.tInv L * x i -
                  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.tInv L * x' i)))))
        Iff.rfl)

    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.IsRational m (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.tPow L * x)
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.isRational_tPow : ∀ (m : ℕ+) (L : ℕ)

    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.IsRational m (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.tPow L * x) :=
fun m L {x} hx γ hγ =>
  Exists.casesOn
    (hx (γ - ↑L) (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a ≠ 0) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf_tPow_mul L x γ)) hγ))
    fun z hz =>

      (have hm :=
        cast (Eq.symm (Eq.trans (congrArg (Ne ↑↑m) (Eq.symm Nat.cast_zero)) (congrArg Not Nat.cast_inj._simp_1)))
          (PNat.ne_zero m);

    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.phiPt P L F p = p' :=

  {B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n l') ↑P.G.real}
  (F : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map A B),
  Function.Bijective F.toFun →
    ∀ {p' : (Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Ser) × (Fin l' → DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.RV)},
      p' ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.strace P L B) →
        DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.RationalPoint m p' →
          ∃ p ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.strace P L A),
            DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.RationalPoint m p ∧
              DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.phiPt P L F p = p'
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.phiPt_surj : ∀ (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient)
  {n l l' : ℕ} (m : ℕ+) (L : ℕ)
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n l) ↑P.G.real}
  {B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n l') ↑P.G.real}
  (F : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map A B),
  Function.Bijective F.toFun →
    ∀ {p' : (Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Ser) × (Fin l' → DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.RV)},
      p' ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.strace P L B) →
        DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.RationalPoint m p' →
          ∃ p ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.strace P L A),
            DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.RationalPoint m p ∧
              DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.phiPt P L F p = p' :=
fun P {n l l'} m L {A} {B} F hbij {p'} hp' hr =>
  Exists.casesOn
    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.exists_concrete_image P (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.invMap P F hbij)
      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.unscaleP L p')
      (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a) (propext (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mem_strace P L B p'))) hp'))
    fun p0 hp0 =>
    have hr0 :=
      DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.concrete_image_rational P
        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.invMap P F hbij) m (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.unscaleP L p')
        (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a) (propext (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mem_strace P L B p'))) hp') p0 hp0
        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.rationalPoint_unscale m L hr);
    have hmem :=
      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ePoint P _a ∈ A.carrier)
            (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.unscaleP_scaleP L p0)))
        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ A.carrier) (Eq.symm hp0)))
          ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.invMap P F hbij).toFun
              ⟨DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ePoint P (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.unscaleP L p'),
                Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a) (propext (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mem_strace P L B p')))
                  hp'⟩).property);
    Exists.intro (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.scaleP L p0)
      ⟨(DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mem_strace P L A (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.scaleP L p0)).mpr
          hmem,
        ⟨DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.rationalPoint_scale m L hr0,
          DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.phiPt_eq P L F hmem
            (have he :=
              Subtype.ext
                (id
                  (Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg
                        (fun _a =>
                          DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ePoint P _a =
                            ↑((DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.invMap P F hbij).toFun
                                ⟨DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ePoint P
                                    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.unscaleP L p'),
                                  Eq.mp
                                    (congrArg (fun _a => _a)
                                      (propext (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mem_strace P L B p')))
                                    hp'⟩))
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.unscaleP_scaleP L p0)))
                    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ePoint P p0 = _a) hp0))
                      (Eq.refl (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ePoint P p0)))));
            Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg
                  (fun _a =>
                    ↑(F.toFun _a) =
                      DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ePoint P (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.unscaleP L p'))
                  he))
              (Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg
                    (fun _a =>
                      ↑_a =
                        DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ePoint P
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.unscaleP L p'))

                (Eq.refl

                        (congrArg (fun _a => _a) (propext (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mem_strace P L B p')))

  {n l l' : ℕ} (L : ℕ)
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n l) ↑P.G.real}
  {B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n l') ↑P.G.real}
  (F : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map A B)
  (p : (Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Ser) × (Fin l → DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.RV))
  (p' : (Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Ser) × (Fin l' → DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.RV)),
  Fin.append (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedRaw p) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedRaw p') ∈
      DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.sgraph P L F ↔

@DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.congrS_left : ∀ {n : ℕ} (m : ℕ+) (b : Fin n → ℕ)

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.congrS_left : ∀ {n : ℕ} (m : ℕ+) (b : Fin n → ℕ)
  {x x' : Fin (n + n) → DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Ser},
  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.CongrS m (Fin.append b b) x x' →
    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.CongrS m b (fun j => x (Fin.castAdd n j)) fun j => x' (Fin.castAdd n j) :=
fun {n} m b {x x'} h j =>
  have this := h (Fin.castAdd n j);
  Eq.mp
    (congrArg
      (fun _a =>
        ↑(DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lev m _a) <
          DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.ordS (x (Fin.castAdd n j) - x' (Fin.castAdd n j)))
      (Fin.append_left b b j))
    this

      DiamondIntegral.Section6.Congruent (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.rad P m b L) (↑a).1 (↑a').1 →

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.thick_invariant : ∀
  (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient) {n l l' : ℕ} (m : ℕ+) (b : Fin n → ℕ) (L : ℕ)
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n l) ↑P.G.real}
  {B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n l') ↑P.G.real}

  (∀ (a a' : ↑A.carrier),
      DiamondIntegral.Section6.Congruent (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.rad P m b L) (↑a).1 (↑a').1 →
        (↑a).2 = (↑a').2 →
          DiamondIntegral.Section6.Congruent (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.rad P m b L) (↑(F.toFun a)).1

          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.strace P L B)) →
        DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Invariant m (Fin.append b b)
          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet
            (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.fromPair (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.thickPair P m b L F))) :=
fun P {n l l'} m b L {A} {B} F hF hXinv hYinv x x' u hx hc =>
  have hcS := (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.congr_iff_congrS m (Fin.append b b) x x').mp hc;
  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (congrArg
        (fun _a =>
          _a ∈
            DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet
              (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.fromPair (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.thickPair P m b L F)))
        (Eq.symm (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.join_left_right (x', u)))))
    (Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a => _a)
          (propext
            (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mem_fromPair (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.thickPair P m b L F)
              (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.leftP (x', u))
              (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.rightP (x', u))))))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a => _a)
            (propext
              (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mem_thickPair P m b L F
                (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.leftP (x', u))
                (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.rightP (x', u))))))
        (And.casesOn
          (Eq.mp
            (congrArg (fun _a => _a)
              (propext
                (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mem_thickPair P m b L F
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.leftP (x, u))
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.rightP (x, u)))))
            (Eq.mp
              (congrArg (fun _a => _a)
                (propext
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mem_fromPair
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.thickPair P m b L F)
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.leftP (x, u))
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.rightP (x, u)))))
              (Eq.mp
                (congrArg
                  (fun _a =>
                    _a ∈
                      DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.mixedSet
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.fromPair
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.thickPair P m b L F)))
                  (Eq.symm (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.join_left_right (x, u))))
                hx)))
          fun hp right =>
          And.casesOn right fun hp' right =>
            And.casesOn right fun hc0 hl0 =>
              have hp1 :=
                hXinv (fun i => (x, u).1 (Fin.castAdd n i)) (fun i => (x', u).1 (Fin.castAdd n i))
                  (fun j => (x', u).2 (Fin.castAdd l' j)) hp

                        fun i => (x', u).1 (Fin.castAdd n i)).mpr
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.congrS_left m b hcS));
              have hp1' :=
                hYinv (fun i => (x, u).1 (Fin.natAdd n i)) (fun i => (x', u).1 (Fin.natAdd n i))
                  (fun j => (x', u).2 (Fin.natAdd l j)) hp'
                  ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.congr_iff_congrS m b (fun i => (x, u).1 (Fin.natAdd n i))
                        fun i => (x', u).1 (Fin.natAdd n i)).mpr
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.congrS_right m b hcS));
              And.casesOn
                (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.phiPt_congr P m b L F hF hp hp1
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.congrS_left m b hcS) rfl)
                fun h1 h2 =>
                ⟨hp1,
                  ⟨hp1',

                        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.congrS_symm h1)
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.congrS_trans hc0
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.congrS_right m b hcS)),
                      Eq.mpr
                        (id

                            (Eq.symm h2)))
                        (Eq.mpr
                          (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.rightP (x', u)).2) hl0))
                          (Eq.refl (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.rightP (x, u)).2))⟩⟩⟩)))

  {n : ℕ} (m : ℕ+) (Gv : Type) [inst : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Gv]

    h =>
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.rec
    (fun {r} A hA => DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.teq_refl P m A)
    (fun {r} A hA hVF =>
      And.casesOn
        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.chain_proper P Gv hv
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.regularize A hA hVF))
        fun hA' hB' =>
        DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.teq_of_step P m
          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.good_of_proper P m Gv hv A hA')
          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.good_of_proper P m Gv hv (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularizeMap A).image
            hB')
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularization A) (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularization_bijective A)
          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.regularize_compat P m Gv hv A hA hVF))
    (fun {r} A D =>
      And.casesOn

          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.centripetal A D))
        fun hA' hB' =>
        DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.teq_of_step P m
          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.good_of_proper P m Gv hv A hA')
          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.good_of_proper P m Gv hv D.map.image hB') D.bijection
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.bijective D P.G.model00)
          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.centripetal_compat P m Gv hv A D))
    (fun {r} A D =>
      And.casesOn
        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.chain_proper P Gv hv
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.zeroCentered A D))
        fun hA' hB' =>
        DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.teq_of_step P m
          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.good_of_proper P m Gv hv A hA')
          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.good_of_proper P m Gv hv D.map.image hB') D.bijection
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.ZeroCenteredData.bijective D P.G.model00)
          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.zeroCentered_compat P m A D))
    (fun {r s t} {A} {B} {C} {f} {g} hf hg ihf ihg =>
      And.casesOn (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.chain_proper P Gv hv hf) fun hA' hB' =>

  (P : DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.PuiseuxAmbient) {n l : ℕ}
  (A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n l) ↑P.G.real)

  Exists.casesOn hz fun hdom h =>

      Exists.casesOn left fun x hx =>
        Exists.casesOn right fun u hu =>
          Fin.addCases

              have h := congrFun hx a;
              have hs :=
                of_eq_true
                  (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg Eq (Fin.addCases_left a)) SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag.vf)
                    (eq_self SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag.vf));

                      (Eq.symm
                        (propext
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.e_sort P SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag.vf

                  (id

                        (congrArg
                          (fun _a =>
                            SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.sortEval SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag.vf _a)

            (fun b =>
              have h := congrFun hu b;
              have hs :=
                of_eq_true
                  (Eq.trans

@DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf_extend_level : ∀ {n : ℕ} {b b' : Fin n → ℕ} (m : ℕ+)
  (x : Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Ser)
  (w : DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Idx b' → DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.RV) (i : Fin n)

  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.extend m b b' x w i)

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf_extend_level : ∀ {n : ℕ} {b b' : Fin n → ℕ} (m : ℕ+)
  (x : Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Ser)
  (w : DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Idx b' → DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.RV) (i : Fin n)
  (j : Fin (b' i + 1)),
  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.extend m b b' x w i)
      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lev m ↑j) =
    if b i < ↑j then DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lineCoeff (w ⟨i, j⟩)
    else DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf (x i) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lev m ↑j) :=
fun {n} {b b'} m x w i j =>
  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (congrArg
        (fun _a =>
          _a =
            if b i < ↑j then DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lineCoeff (w ⟨i, j⟩)
            else DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf (x i) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lev m ↑j))
        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf_extend m x w i (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lev m ↑j))))
    (Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg
          (fun _a =>
            DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf (x i) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lev m ↑j) + _a =
              if b i < ↑j then DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lineCoeff (w ⟨i, j⟩)
              else DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf (x i) (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lev m ↑j))
          (Finset.sum_eq_single j
            (fun k a hk =>
              Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg (fun _a => _a = 0)
                    (if_neg fun a =>
                      And.casesOn a fun left h =>

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lemma_8_5_sets : ∀ {n l : ℕ} {b b' : Fin n → ℕ} (m : ℕ+)
  (h : ∀ (i : Fin n), b i ≤ b' i)
  (A : Set ((Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Ser) × (Fin l → DiamondIntegral.Section5.PuiseuxOriginal.RV))),
  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Invariant m b A →
    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.truncSet m b' A =
      {w |
        DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.restrict h w ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.truncSet m b A ∧
          ∀ (k : DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Idx b'),
            w (Sum.inl k) ∈
              DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.Line (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lev m ↑k.snd)} :=
fun {n l} {b b'} m h A hA =>
  Set.ext fun w =>
    {
      mp := fun a =>
        Exists.casesOn a fun p h_1 =>
          And.casesOn h_1 fun hp right =>
            And.casesOn right fun hr right =>
              And.casesOn right fun hu right =>
                Eq.symm right ▸
                  ⟨Exists.intro p
                      ⟨hp,
                        ⟨hr,
                          ⟨hu,

                                k = t →
                                  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.restrict h

                                    Sum.elim (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.truncPoint m b p.1) p.2 k)

                                  Eq.symm h_2 ▸

                                      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.restrict h
                                        (Sum.elim (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.truncPoint m b' p.1) p.2)
                                        (Sum.inl k_1)))
                                (fun j h_2 =>
                                  Eq.symm h_2 ▸

                                      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.restrict h

                                        (Sum.inr j)))

                    fun k =>
                    DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.coeffRV_mem_line
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lev m ↑k.snd)
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf (p.1 k.fst)
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lev m ↑k.snd))⟩,
      mpr := fun a =>
        And.casesOn a fun left hline =>
          Exists.casesOn left fun p h_1 =>
            And.casesOn h_1 fun hp right =>
              And.casesOn right fun hr right =>
                And.casesOn right fun hu hw =>
                  have hw1 := fun k => congrFun hw (Sum.inl k);
                  have hw2 := fun j => congrFun hw (Sum.inr j);
                  let x' := DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.extend m b b' p.1 fun k => w (Sum.inl k);
                  have hcongr := fun i γ hγ =>
                    Eq.symm
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf_extend_of_not_level m p.1 (fun k => w (Sum.inl k)) i γ
                        fun j hj hγj =>
                        absurd
                          (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a ≤ DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lev m (b i)) hγj) hγ)
                          (not_le.mpr (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lev_lt_lev hj)));
                  Exists.intro (x', p.2)
                    ⟨hA p.1 x' p.2 hp hcongr,

                                      (Eq.mpr
                                        (id

                                        (Eq.mpr

                          else
                            (hr i).left γ

                                (congrArg (fun _a => _a ≠ 0)
                                  (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.cf_extend_of_not_level m p.1
                                    (fun k => w (Sum.inl k)) i γ
                                    (Eq.mp

                                          b i < ↑j ∧ γ = DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.lev m ↑j)

                                          Mathlib.Tactic.Push.not_and_eq (b i < ↑j)

  (m : ℕ+) (w : SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.Gamma),
  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.latticeFibre P (DiamondIntegral.Section4.GammaBoundedRVCharts.sharp g).toChart (↑m) w =

      DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.fib P δ :=

  Set.ext fun z =>
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg
          (Iff
            (z ∈
              DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.latticeFibre P (DiamondIntegral.Section4.GammaBoundedRVCharts.sharp g).toChart
                (↑m) w))
          (Eq.trans
            (Eq.trans
              (congrFun'
                (congrArg Membership.mem
                  (congrArg Set.iUnion
                    (funext fun δ =>
                      Set.iUnion_congr_Prop (Iff.of_eq DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.sharp_fibre._simp_1_3) fun x =>
                        Eq.refl (DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.fib P δ))))

                  DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.sharp_fibre._simp_1_2)))))
      {

            And.casesOn ((DiamondIntegral.Section8.Hm.sharp_lattice P g m z).mp hl) fun hp hδ =>
              Exists.intro (DiamondIntegral.Section4.GammaRVChartPresentation.codeValues z) ⟨⟨hδ, hw⟩, ⟨hp, rfl⟩⟩,
        mpr := fun a =>
          Exists.casesOn a fun δ h =>

              And.casesOn left fun hδ hw =>
